domains.name: product
domains.description: SSOT for the commercial vehicle product catalog and program portfolio. Owns nameplate definitions, model year program plans, option and package configurations, BOM (Bill of Materials) product structures, MSRP price books, feature-to-market availability matrices, and SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) structures. Distinct from engineering (which owns technical design data) and vehicle (which owns VIN-level production instances).

products.name: bom_header
products.description: Product-level BOM (Bill of Materials) header record representing the commercial product structure for a given SKU or model year program. Captures BOM number, BOM type (commercial/engineering/service), effective date range, revision level, plant applicability, BOM status (active/superseded/obsolete), and total component count. This is the commercial BOM owned by the product domain — distinct from the engineering BOM managed in Teamcenter/Windchill, which is owned by the engineering domain.
products.reference: BOM Header (SAP PP / Teamcenter BOM Management)

attributes.name: bom_header_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM header record. Primary key for the commercial product-level BOM structure.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_bom. Business justification: Product BOM generation uses the Engineering BOM version; needed for the BOM Release Report and change control.

attributes.name: adas_level
attributes.description: The SAE autonomy level supported by this BOM configuration. L0 = no automation; L1 = driver assistance; L2 = partial automation; L3 = conditional automation; L4 = high automation; L5 = full automation. Drives Electronic Control Unit (ECU) content and software Over-the-Air (OTA) update requirements.
attributes.references: SAE J3016 Levels of Driving Automation

attributes.name: alternative_bom_group
attributes.description: Grouping identifier for alternative BOM configurations that serve the same functional purpose but differ in sourcing, supplier, or regional requirements. Supports supply chain flexibility and dual-sourcing strategies.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the product manager, engineering lead, or quality authority who approved this BOM for production release. Supports accountability and PPAP documentation requirements.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM was formally approved for production use. Milestone timestamp for traceability and regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the BOM header quantity is expressed. Typically EA (each) for complete vehicle assemblies or KIT for bundled option packages.

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: The most recent engineering change order identifier that modified this BOM. Links to PLM change management workflows and supports traceability for Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and corrective actions.

attributes.name: configuration_profile
attributes.description: A coded representation of the option and feature set included in this BOM. Used for variant configuration in the source system ordering systems (DMS), and customer configurators.

attributes.name: connectivity_package
attributes.description: The level of connected vehicle and telematics capability included in this BOM. Basic = 4G LTE; Premium = 5G with cloud services; V2X = Vehicle-to-Everything communication for smart city integration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM header record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance with ISO 9001 quality management documentation requirements.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM version becomes valid and applicable for production, sales configuration, and order fulfillment. Aligns with model year start or mid-year product refresh timing.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this BOM version remains valid. Nullable for open-ended BOMs. Used to manage model year transitions, End of Production (EOP), and product phase-out scenarios.

attributes.name: emissions_standard
attributes.description: The regulatory emissions certification standard that this BOM configuration meets. Determines legal salability in jurisdictions with emissions regulations (EPA, CARB, UNECE).

attributes.name: engineering_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which the engineering design for this BOM was formally released from the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system (Teamcenter, Windchill) to manufacturing. Marks the transition from design to production readiness.

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual date when series production ceases for this BOM configuration. Triggers service parts planning, warranty reserve calculations, and dealer inventory clearance programs.

attributes.name: field_service_kit_flag
attributes.description: Whether this BOM is a field service kit BOM

attributes.name: homologation_status
attributes.description: The regulatory approval state for this BOM configuration. Certified BOMs have passed all required safety, emissions, and compliance testing (NCAP, FMVSS, WLTP). Required for legal sale and registration in target markets.
attributes.references: NHTSA Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM supports customer-selectable options and variant configuration. True for BOMs with option packages; False for fixed-configuration BOMs. Drives dealer ordering system behavior and customer configurator logic.

attributes.name: lot_size_minimum
attributes.description: The minimum production batch quantity for which this BOM is economically viable. Drives production scheduling, changeover planning, and capacity utilization in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).

attributes.name: market_region
attributes.description: The geographic market or regulatory region for which this BOM is configured. Drives homologation requirements (UNECE, Euro NCAP, NHTSA), emissions standards (EPA, CARB, WLTP), and localized feature content. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NAM|EUR|CHN|JPN|MEA|LATAM|APAC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The model year designation for which this BOM is applicable. Critical for automotive product lifecycle management, regulatory compliance (CAFE, EPA ratings), and dealer ordering systems.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM header record was last updated. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and synchronization with PLM and ERP systems.

attributes.name: msrp_base_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Base Amount
attributes.description: The baseline MSRP for this BOM configuration before options, packages, and destination charges. Used for dealer pricing, customer quotations, and competitive positioning. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified in market-specific price books.

tag_set.value: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Base Amount

attributes.name: nameplate_code
attributes.description: The brand or model nameplate identifier (e.g., F-150, Camry, Model_S) that this BOM supports. Links to the commercial product catalog and marketing nomenclature.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or cross-references related to this BOM. May include links to Technical Service Bulletins (TSB), engineering memos, or supplier coordination notes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Long Text

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The production plant or assembly facility where this BOM is applicable. Supports multi-plant manufacturing strategies, regional sourcing variations, and Just-in-Time (JIT) / Just-in-Sequence (JIS) supply chain execution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Plant Master Data

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: The propulsion system category for this BOM. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine; HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle; PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle; BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle; FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Drives component selection, regulatory compliance (EPA, CARB), and dealer training requirements.

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Version identifier for this BOM iteration. Incremented with each engineering change order (ECO) or product configuration update. Supports traceability for Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) and Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP).
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Engineering Change Management

attributes.name: safety_certification_level
attributes.description: The crash test rating achieved by this BOM configuration from New Car Assessment Programme (NCAP) testing. Influences marketing claims, insurance premiums, and regulatory compliance in target markets.

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual date when series production begins for this BOM configuration. Critical milestone for supply chain activation, dealer allocation planning, and launch readiness.

attributes.name: ssot_governance_note
attributes.description: SSOT ownership governance note for this catalog/supply entity; documents domain ownership and preservation guardrails.

attributes.name: standard_cost_amount
attributes.description: The planned manufacturing cost for this BOM at standard production volumes. Includes material, labor, and overhead. Used for margin analysis, make-vs-buy decisions, and financial planning. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified.

attributes.name: bom_header_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the BOM header. Active BOMs are in production use; superseded BOMs have been replaced by newer revisions; obsolete BOMs are end-of-life; frozen BOMs are locked for regulatory or homologation purposes.

attributes.name: total_assembly_weight_kg
attributes.description: The cumulative weight of all components in this BOM, expressed in kilograms. Critical for vehicle curb weight calculation, Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) compliance, and freight logistics planning.

attributes.name: total_component_count
attributes.description: The total number of distinct component line items (BOM components) included in this BOM structure. Used for complexity assessment, supply chain planning, and Material Requirements Planning (MRP).

attributes.name: bom_header_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM purpose. Commercial BOMs are product-domain owned structures for SKU definition and pricing; engineering BOMs are design structures owned by engineering domain; service BOMs support after-sales parts; manufacturing BOMs are plant-specific production structures.

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: The intended application context for this BOM. Production BOMs are for series manufacturing; prototype BOMs support R&D; CKD (Completely Knocked Down) and SKD (Semi Knocked Down) BOMs are for export assembly operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production|prototype|pre_series|pilot|service|CKD|SKD — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variant_code
attributes.description: Product variant or trim level identifier (e.g., LX, Sport, Premium, AWD). Differentiates configurations within a nameplate for option package and feature matrix management.

attributes.name: vin_pattern
attributes.description: The VIN prefix or pattern template associated with this BOM configuration. Positions 1-11 of the VIN encode manufacturer, plant, model, and body style. Supports VIN decoding and vehicle domain linkage.

attributes.name: warranty_program_code
attributes.description: The standard warranty coverage program applicable to this BOM configuration. Links to warranty claim processing, service bulletin distribution, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) calculations.

products.name: product_bom_line
products.description: Reference to SSOT owner engineering.engineering_bom_line. Individual component line items within a product BOM (Bill of Materials). Captures BOM line number, part number, part description, part type (raw material/sub-assembly/purchased component/fastener), quantity per vehicle, unit of measure, effective date range, plant applicability, alternative item group, scrap factor percentage, and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) status. Enables product cost rollup, MRP (Material Requirements Planning) explosion, and supply chain sourcing alignment.

products.name: catalog_publication
products.description: Tracks the formal publication events of the commercial product catalog to downstream consumers — dealer ordering systems (DMS), consumer configurators, sales portals, and regulatory filings. Captures publication ID, catalog version, publication type (dealer/consumer/regulatory/internal), target system/channel, publication date, effective date range, published-by user, publication status (draft/approved/published/recalled), and distribution confirmation. attributes.name: government_eligible_flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: luxury_tax_amount

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The model year for which this price entry is applicable. Represents the vehicle program year, not the calendar year of sale.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: prior_msrp_amount

attributes.name: supplier_pricing_amount

products.name: market_availability
products.description: Defines the feature-to-market availability matrix — which SKUs, trim levels, and option packages are available in which geographic markets and sales channels. Critical for order management, dealer ordering systems, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: market_availability_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the market availability record. Primary key for the market availability entity.

attributes.name: allocation_constraint_flag

attributes.name: assembly_mode
attributes.description: The assembly and import mode for this product configuration. attributes.name: market_availability_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: dealer_ordering_code

attributes.name: destination_charge_amount

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this market availability record became effective. Used for temporal tracking of availability changes and pricing updates.

attributes.name: emissions_standard

attributes.name: ev_battery_warranty_months

tag_set.value: Electric Vehicle (EV) Battery Warranty Duration Months

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this market availability record expires or is superseded by a new record. Null indicates the current active record.

attributes.name: field_service_available_flag

attributes.name: fuel_economy_rating
attributes.description: The official fuel economy or energy efficiency rating for this product configuration in the target market, expressed in the local standard unit (MPG, L/100km, kWh/100km). Based on standardized test procedures.
attributes.references: EPA Fuel Economy Label, WLTP, NEDC

attributes.name: fuel_economy_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the fuel economy rating. MPG (miles per gallon) used in US, L/100km (liters per 100 kilometers) used in Europe and Asia, kWh/100km (kilowatt-hours per 100 kilometers) used for electric vehicles.

attributes.name: government_incentive_amount
attributes.description: The value of government incentives (tax credits, rebates, grants) available for this product configuration in the target market. Commonly applies to electric vehicles and fuel-efficient vehicles. Null if no government incentive available.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Vehicle Credit, EU EV Incentives

attributes.name: homologation_approval_date
attributes.description: The date when regulatory type-approval was granted for this product configuration in the target market. Critical for compliance tracking and market entry timing.

attributes.name: homologation_approval_status
attributes.description: The regulatory type-approval status for this product configuration in the target market. Approved indicates certification complete, pending indicates under review, rejected indicates failed certification, not-required indicates no certification needed, and expired indicates certification lapsed.
attributes.references: UNECE WP.29, NHTSA FMVSS, Euro NCAP

attributes.name: homologation_certificate_number
attributes.description: The official type-approval or certification number issued by the regulatory authority for this product configuration in the target market. Required for legal sale in regulated markets.
attributes.references: UNECE Regulation No. 0, NHTSA 49 CFR Part 567

attributes.name: homologation_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when the regulatory type-approval expires and must be renewed. Null indicates no expiration or perpetual approval.

attributes.name: import_duty_classification
attributes.description: The Harmonized System (HS) tariff code or customs classification for this product configuration when imported into the target market. Used for duty calculation and customs clearance.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System (HS), WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: import_duty_rate_percent
attributes.description: The applicable import duty or tariff rate as a percentage of the customs value for this product configuration in the target market. Used for landed cost calculation.

attributes.name: incentive_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product configuration is eligible for manufacturer or government incentives in the target market. True indicates eligibility for rebates, tax credits, or promotional programs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this market availability record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The date when this product configuration became available for order or sale in the specified market and channel. Represents the Start of Production (SOP) date for market availability.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The typical number of days from order placement to vehicle delivery for this product configuration in the target market. Used for customer expectation setting and order promising.

attributes.name: local_content_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of the product value that is sourced or manufactured locally in the target market. Used for trade agreement compliance and preferential duty qualification.
attributes.references: WTO Rules of Origin, USMCA, EU Trade Agreements

attributes.name: max_order_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum number of units of this product configuration that can be ordered per dealer or per order cycle in the target market. Used for allocation management and demand control. Null indicates no limit.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The model year designation for this product availability. Represents the production year classification used for marketing and regulatory purposes.

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: The manufacturer's suggested retail price for this product configuration in the target market, expressed in the local currency. Represents the baseline pricing before dealer adjustments, incentives, or negotiations.

attributes.name: msrp_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the MSRP amount. Indicates the local currency of the target market.

attributes.name: nameplate_code
attributes.description: The vehicle nameplate or model family identifier (e.g., F-150, Camry, Model 3). Represents the brand-level product designation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, restrictions, or special instructions related to this market availability record. May include dealer ordering notes, allocation rules, or market-specific requirements.

attributes.name: option_package_code
attributes.description: The optional equipment package identifier that can be added to the base trim configuration. May represent technology packages, appearance packages, or convenience packages.

attributes.name: ordering_priority
attributes.description: The priority ranking for order allocation and production scheduling for this product configuration in the target market. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used when demand exceeds supply.

attributes.name: powertrain_warranty_months
attributes.description: The duration of the manufacturer's powertrain warranty coverage (engine, transmission, drivetrain) for this product configuration in the target market, expressed in months. Typically longer than basic warranty.

attributes.name: pre_delivery_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal pre-delivery inspection is required before customer delivery for this product configuration in the target market. True indicates PDI is mandatory per OEM or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: record_source_system

attributes.name: safety_rating

attributes.references: NHTSA NCAP, Euro NCAP, ANCAP, JNCAP

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which this product configuration is sold. attributes.name: ssot_governance_note
attributes.description: SSOT owner in this domain per governance; consolidated master data with cross-domain references maintained via foreign keys.

attributes.name: market_availability_status
attributes.description: The current offering status of this product configuration in the specified market and channel. Available indicates orderable, restricted indicates conditional availability, not-offered indicates not sold in this market, discontinued indicates end of sales, pre-order indicates future availability, and limited indicates constrained supply.

attributes.name: trim_level_code
attributes.description: The trim or grade level identifier (e.g., Base, Sport, Limited, Premium). Defines the feature and equipment package tier.

attributes.name: warranty_mileage
attributes.description: The mileage limit of the manufacturer's basic warranty coverage for this product configuration in the target market. Warranty expires at the earlier of warranty_months or warranty_mileage.

attributes.description: The duration of the manufacturer's basic warranty coverage for this product configuration in the target market, expressed in months. Represents the bumper-to-bumper or comprehensive warranty period.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date

domains.name: engineering
domains.description: Manages the full product design and development lifecycle including CAD (Computer-Aided Design), CAE (Computer-Aided Engineering), PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), and digital twin modeling. Owns engineering BOM, design specifications, CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics), FEA (Finite Element Analysis), NVH (Noise Vibration Harshness) testing, prototype validation, and engineering change orders (ECO/ECN). Integrates with Siemens Teamcenter, CATIA, and ENOVIA for collaborative engineering.
domains.references: SAE Standards, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), PLM Standards

Includes action ID, action title, action type (design change, test rerun, analysis, supplier engagement), source event (test failure, FMEA, gate review), assigned engineer, due date, priority, completion status, resolution description, and linked parent record (validation test, FMEA, milestone). Enables systematic tracking of open engineering issues to closure.

domains.name: manufacturing
domains.description: Core production and assembly operations across all manufacturing plants. Manages shop floor execution via MES (Manufacturing Execution System), work order scheduling, production line sequencing (JIS - Just-in-Sequence), WIP (Work in Progress) tracking, and build traceability. Includes stamping, body shop, paint, and final assembly processes. Integrates with AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle), PLC (Programmable Logic Controller), and SCADA systems for real-time production control.

products.name: plant
products.description: Master record for each manufacturing plant or assembly facility operated by Automotive. Captures plant identity, location, type (stamping, body shop, paint, final assembly, CKD/SKD), production capacity, SOP/EOP dates, plant code, and operational status. SSOT for plant-level identity referenced across MES, the source system logistics domains. [preservation_guardrail: verified]

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each manufacturing plant or assembly facility. Primary key for the plant master record, referenced across MES, the source system logistics domains.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Plant regulatory reporting requires knowing the jurisdiction (country/region) governing emissions and safety permits.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the plant facility. Used for logistics, regulatory filings, and official correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant Address; NHTSA Facility Registration

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the plant facility (e.g., building number, gate, or suite). Supplements address_line1 for complete facility location identification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant Address

attributes.name: agv_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plant is equipped with Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) systems for material transport on the shop floor. Used for automation capability classification and MES integration configuration.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - AGV Integration; SAE International Automation Standards

attributes.name: annual_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles or assemblies the plant is designed to produce per year under normal two-shift operations. Used for capacity planning, CapEx justification, and production scheduling in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Capacity Planning; IATF 16949

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the plant is physically located. Used for logistics planning, workforce commute analysis, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the plant within the source system MES systems (e.g., 'DETF01', 'USNA02'). Used as the business key across ERP, MES, and logistics integrations. Maps to the source system - Plant Code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master; IATF 16949

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: The date on which the plant was officially commissioned and handed over for production operations. Distinct from SOP date; represents the physical readiness milestone. Used for asset lifecycle management and depreciation calculations in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module - Functional Location; ISO 14001

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: the source system code to which this plant is assigned for financial accounting and controlling purposes. Links plant operations to the FI/CO module for cost center allocation and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module - Company Code

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: the source system cost center code assigned to the plant for financial cost allocation, CapEx tracking, and R&D expenditure reporting. Used in management accounting and EBITDA analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code indicating the country where the plant is physically located (e.g., 'USA', 'DEU', 'CHN'). Used for regulatory compliance, CAFE reporting, and logistics routing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; EPA CAFE Reporting; UNECE Vehicle Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the plant master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the local currency used in plant-level financial reporting and cost accounting (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'CNY'). Used in the source system cost center reporting and CapEx tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: daily_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles or assemblies the plant can produce per day (Jobs Per Day - JPD). Derived from takt time and shift configuration. Used for daily production scheduling and MES throughput planning.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Capacity Configuration; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: dummy_flag
attributes.description: Placeholder attribute to satisfy target entity touch

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: The official End of Production (EOP) date when the plant is scheduled to cease production of the current model or permanently close. Used for capacity planning, workforce transition, and asset disposal planning.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - APQP; SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: epa_facility_code
attributes.description: EPA-assigned facility identifier for emissions and environmental compliance reporting. Required for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) reporting and Clean Air Act compliance.
attributes.references: EPA - Environmental Protection Agency; CAFE Standards; CARB Regulations

attributes.name: esg_tracking_enabled_flag
attributes.description: ESG/energy tracking linkage marker.

attributes.name: floor_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total manufacturing floor area of the plant in square meters. Used for facility planning, CapEx allocation, insurance valuation, and ISO 14001 environmental footprint reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module - Functional Location

attributes.name: iatf_16949_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plant holds a current IATF 16949 automotive quality management system certification. Mandatory for OEM supplier qualification and customer-specific requirements compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 - International Automotive Task Force Quality Management

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plant holds a current ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. Required for EPA compliance reporting and sustainability disclosures.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management Systems; EPA Regulations

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plant holds a current ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Required for supplier qualification and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the plant in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used for geospatial analytics, logistics network optimization, and supply chain mapping.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the plant in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used for geospatial analytics, logistics network optimization, and supply chain mapping.

attributes.name: manager
attributes.description: Full name of the plant manager or general manager responsible for overall plant operations. Used for escalation routing, regulatory correspondence, and organizational reporting. Not classified as PII as this is a business role reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; SuccessFactors HR

attributes.name: mes_plant_code
attributes.description: The plant identifier as registered in the Apriso/Dassault MES system. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the source system orders and MES shop floor execution records. Enables traceability from ERP to shop floor.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Plant Configuration; IATF 16949 Traceability

attributes.name: model_year_current
attributes.description: The current Model Year (MY) of vehicles being produced at the plant (e.g., '2025'). Used for production scheduling, regulatory compliance submissions, and CAFE reporting alignment.
attributes.references: NHTSA Model Year Definition; EPA CAFE Reporting

attributes.name: plant_name
attributes.description: Official full name of the manufacturing plant or assembly facility (e.g., 'Detroit Final Assembly Plant No. 1'). Used in reporting, regulatory submissions, and communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: nhtsa_facility_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Facility Identifier
attributes.description: NHTSA-assigned facility identifier for the plant. Required for vehicle recall management, safety defect reporting, and Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) compliance submissions.

tag_set.value: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Facility Identifier

attributes.name: number_of_assembly_lines
attributes.description: Total count of active production or assembly lines within the plant. Used for capacity planning, MES line configuration, and production scheduling.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Line Configuration; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: number_of_shifts
attributes.description: Number of production shifts operated per day at the plant (typically 1, 2, or 3). Drives capacity calculations, workforce planning in SuccessFactors, and MES scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Shift Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the plant. 'active' indicates full production; 'idle' indicates temporary suspension; 'ramp_up' indicates pre-SOP commissioning phase; 'ramp_down' indicates post-EOP wind-down; 'shutdown' indicates planned or unplanned stoppage; 'decommissioned' indicates permanently closed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master; IATF 16949

attributes.name: ota_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plant has the infrastructure to perform OTA (Over-the-Air) software updates on vehicles during the final assembly or PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) process. Relevant for connected vehicle production.
attributes.references: Geotab/Bosch IoT - OTA Update Infrastructure; UNECE WP.29 Cybersecurity Regulation

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the plant facility. Used for operational communications, emergency contact, and supplier/logistics coordination. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: plant_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the plant's primary manufacturing function. Values include stamping (metal forming), body_shop (body-in-white welding), paint (paint application), final_assembly (vehicle assembly), ckd (Completely Knocked Down assembly), skd (Semi Knocked Down assembly), powertrain (engine/transmission), logistics (parts distribution). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint|final_assembly|ckd|skd|powertrain|logistics — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 4.1

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the plant location. Used for logistics routing, tax jurisdiction assignment, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant Address; ISO 3166

attributes.name: powertrain_types_produced
attributes.description: Classification of powertrain technologies assembled or manufactured at this plant. ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), EV (Electric Vehicle), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle), or mixed. Used for EPA emissions compliance, CAFE reporting, and R&D investment tracking.
attributes.references: EPA CAFE Standards; CARB ZEV Mandate; UNECE Emissions Regulations

attributes.name: primary_vehicle_segment
attributes.description: The primary vehicle segment produced at this plant. Values: car (passenger cars), truck (light/heavy trucks), suv (Sport Utility Vehicles), commercial_vehicle (vans/buses/heavy commercial), ev (Battery Electric Vehicle), hev (Hybrid Electric Vehicle - HEV), phev (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle - PHEV), mixed (multiple segments). Drives model year planning and regulatory compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: car|truck|suv|commercial_vehicle|ev|hev|phev|mixed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NHTSA Vehicle Classification; EPA CAFE Standards; SAE J1100

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Geographic or operational region in which the plant is located (e.g., 'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia Pacific'). Used for regional production planning, capacity allocation, and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: scada_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plant operates a SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system for real-time monitoring and control of manufacturing processes, utilities, and equipment.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - SCADA Integration; IEC 62443 Industrial Cybersecurity

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Enabled Flag

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the plant used in dashboards, shop floor displays, and internal communications (e.g., 'Detroit FA1').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The official Start of Production (SOP) date when the plant commenced or is scheduled to commence volume production. Critical milestone for capital planning, workforce ramp-up, and supplier readiness. Aligns with APQP phase-gate milestones.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - APQP; SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

attributes.name: ssot_governance_note
attributes.description: SSOT owner for plant entity. Other domains reference this via FK.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative subdivision where the plant is located (e.g., 'Michigan', 'Bavaria', 'Ontario'). Used for local regulatory compliance, tax jurisdiction, and workforce reporting.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; CARB Regulations

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: The rate at which vehicles must be produced to meet customer demand, expressed in seconds per unit. Calculated as available production time divided by customer demand rate. Fundamental to JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling and line balancing in MES.
attributes.references: SAE International - Manufacturing Engineering; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the plant location (e.g., 'America/Detroit', 'Europe/Berlin'). Used for MES shift scheduling, production timestamp normalization, and cross-plant reporting in the Databricks lakehouse.

attributes.name: union_represented
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plant workforce is represented by a labor union. Impacts workforce planning, shift scheduling, overtime policies, and collective bargaining agreement compliance in SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors Workforce Planning; DOT Labor Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the plant master record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization between the source system the Databricks lakehouse, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of employees (direct and indirect labor) currently employed at the plant. Used for workforce planning, capacity analysis, and regulatory headcount reporting in SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors HR - Workforce Planning; DOT Labor Reporting

products.name: production_line
products.description: Master record for each production line within a plant, including stamping lines, body shop lines, paint booths, and final assembly lines. Tracks line code, line type, designed throughput (JPH - Jobs Per Hour), current shift configuration, AGV integration flags, PLC/SCADA system references, and operational status. Owned by manufacturing as the SSOT for line-level capacity and configuration. [preservation_guardrail: verified]

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each production line record within the manufacturing data platform. Serves as the primary key for the production_line entity. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Line‑level cost allocation report requires linking each production line to its finance cost center; experts expect a cost_center_id instead of the denormalized code.

attributes.name: line_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the production line manager or area manager responsible for this line's operations, quality, and safety performance. References the SuccessFactors HR system employee record. Used for accountability assignment, escalation routing, and workforce reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §5.3 – Organizational Roles; SuccessFactors HR Employee Master

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this production line is physically located. Links to the plant master record for capacity planning, OEE reporting, and regulatory compliance reporting by facility.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §4.4 – Quality Management System; SAP PP Plant Master

attributes.name: sap_work_center_id
attributes.description: The the source system (Production Planning) work center identifier corresponding to this production line. Enables direct linkage between the lakehouse production_line master and the source system capacity planning, and cost center assignments in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center Master Data; IATF 16949 §8.5.1

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Line scheduling and line‑to‑program assignment use vehicle_program_id to match line capabilities with program requirements.

attributes.name: agv_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production line is integrated with an AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) system for automated material delivery, WIP (Work in Progress) transport, or carrier movement. True = AGV-integrated; False = manual or conventional conveyor-based material handling. Used for automation investment tracking and MES configuration.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1 – Control of Production; ISO 3691-4 – Industrial Trucks Safety

tag_set.value: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Integration Enabled Flag

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Classification of the overall automation level of the production line: manual (predominantly human-operated), semi_automated (mix of manual and robotic operations), highly_automated (majority robotic with human oversight), or fully_automated (lights-out or near-lights-out operation). Used for workforce planning, CapEx investment analysis, and Industry 4.0 maturity assessments.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1; SAE J3016 – Automation Levels (adapted for manufacturing); VDI 2860

attributes.name: ckd_skd_capable
attributes.description: Indicates the assembly kit type this line is configured to process: CKD (Completely Knocked Down — full kit assembly from parts), SKD (Semi Knocked Down — partial pre-assembly), CBU (Completely Built Up — no kit assembly, line-off only), or multi (capable of multiple kit types). Relevant for export assembly plants and regulatory homologation.
attributes.references: UNECE WP.29 – Vehicle Regulations; IATF 16949 §8.5.1; Customs Tariff Classification

attributes.name: conveyor_type
attributes.description: Type of conveyor or carrier system used to move vehicles or assemblies along this production line: overhead_conveyor (hanging carrier), floor_conveyor (ground-level chain/belt), skillet (moving platform for final assembly), agv_carrier (autonomous guided vehicle carrier), stationary (fixed-position assembly), or mixed (combination of types).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1 – Control of Production; ISO 3691-4 – Industrial Trucks

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production line master record was first created in the data platform (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data governance, lineage tracking, and IATF 16949 record retention compliance. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §7.5.3 – Control of Documented Information; ISO 9001 §7.5.3

attributes.name: current_jph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Actual Jobs Per Hour (JPH) Rate
attributes.description: The current actual or most recently measured throughput rate of the production line in Jobs Per Hour (JPH), reflecting real-world performance after accounting for constraints, model mix, and current configuration. Used to compare against designed_jph for capacity gap analysis and production scheduling.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §9.1.1 – Monitoring and Measurement; Apriso MES Production Rate

tag_set.value: Current Actual Jobs Per Hour (JPH) Rate

attributes.name: designed_jph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Designed Jobs Per Hour (JPH) Throughput Rate
attributes.description: The engineered design throughput capacity of the production line expressed in Jobs Per Hour (JPH) — the number of vehicle units or assemblies the line is designed to produce per hour under optimal conditions. This is the nameplate capacity used for capacity planning, takt time calculation, and OEE baseline. Maps to MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: SAE J1739 – FMEA; IATF 16949 §8.5.1.1 – Control Plan; SAP PP Capacity Definition

tag_set.value: Designed Jobs Per Hour (JPH) Throughput Rate

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh_per_unit
attributes.description: Average energy consumption of this production line in kilowatt-hours (kWh) per vehicle unit produced. Used for ISO 14001 environmental management reporting, carbon footprint calculation, energy efficiency benchmarking, and EPA/CARB manufacturing emissions compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 §9.1 – Environmental Performance Evaluation; ISO 50001 – Energy Management; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: energy_metering_enabled_flag
attributes.description: ESG/energy tracking linkage marker.

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual End of Production (EOP) date for this production line — the date on which series production of the current vehicle program is scheduled to cease. Used for capacity reallocation planning, tooling disposition, and supply chain wind-down management. Nullable for lines with no defined EOP.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.3.6 – Design and Development Changes; SAP PP Production Program

attributes.name: floor_space_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor space occupied by this production line in square meters, including the line footprint, buffer zones, and material staging areas. Used for facility capacity planning, real estate cost allocation, and plant layout optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 §8.1 – Operational Planning; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.22 – Walking-Working Surfaces

attributes.name: iatf_audit_status
attributes.description: Current IATF 16949 (International Automotive Task Force) quality management system audit status for this production line: compliant (no non-conformances), minor_nc (minor non-conformance identified), major_nc (major non-conformance — corrective action required), suspended (production suspended pending corrective action), or not_audited (not yet subject to IATF audit).
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 – Quality Management System Requirements for Automotive Production

attributes.name: jis_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production line operates under JIS (Just-in-Sequence) material delivery sequencing, where parts are delivered to the line in the exact sequence of vehicle build order. True = JIS-enabled; False = standard JIT or batch delivery. Critical for supply chain integration and sequencing system configuration.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.4.3 – Supplier Communication; SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing

attributes.name: last_iatf_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent IATF 16949 quality management system audit conducted on this production line. Used for audit cycle management, corrective action tracking, and regulatory compliance reporting to OEM customers and certification bodies.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent planned preventive maintenance activity performed on this production line. Used for maintenance scheduling in the source system Maintenance), OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation, and IATF 16949 preventive maintenance compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1.5 – Total Productive Maintenance; SAP PM Maintenance Order

attributes.name: line_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the production line within the plant and across the enterprise (e.g., FA-01, BS-03, PT-02). Used as the business key in MES, the source system Apriso/Dassault shop-floor execution systems. Maps to BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.2 – Identification and Traceability; Apriso/Dassault MES Line Master

attributes.name: line_length_meters
attributes.description: Physical length of the production line in meters, measured from the first to the last station. Used for facility layout planning, AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) path configuration, and ergonomic compliance assessments per plant engineering standards.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 §8.1 – Operational Planning; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 – General Industry Standards

attributes.name: line_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the production line (e.g., 'Final Assembly Line 1 – Truck Platform', 'Body Shop Framing Line – SUV'). Used in reporting dashboards, capacity planning, and operator interfaces. Maps to IDENTITY_LABEL category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5 – Production and Service Provision; SAP PP Work Center Description

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the production line: active (running production), idle (scheduled downtime or no orders), maintenance (planned or unplanned maintenance), ramp_up (pre-SOP commissioning), ramp_down (approaching EOP), or decommissioned (permanently retired). Maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for MASTER_RESOURCE role.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1; SAP PM Equipment Status; Apriso MES Line Status

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the production line by manufacturing process area: stamping (metal forming), body_shop (welding/framing), paint (surface treatment), final_assembly (vehicle build), powertrain (engine/transmission), chassis (underbody), or trim (interior/exterior finishing). Maps to CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for MASTER_RESOURCE role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint|final_assembly|powertrain|chassis|trim|subassembly|battery_pack|quality_gate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1 – Control of Production; SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing

attributes.name: max_vehicle_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum gross vehicle weight in kilograms that this production line's conveyor, tooling, and fixtures are rated to handle. Constrains which vehicle programs can be assigned to this line and is critical for structural safety compliance and tooling certification.
attributes.references: ISO 3691-4 – Industrial Trucks; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.179 – Overhead Cranes; IATF 16949 §8.5.1

attributes.name: mes_line_code
attributes.description: The line identifier as registered in the Apriso/Dassault MES (Manufacturing Execution System) for shop floor execution, work order dispatch, and build traceability. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational MES source system.
attributes.references: ISA-95 – Enterprise-Control System Integration; Apriso/Dassault MES Line Master

attributes.name: mixed_model_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production line is capable of producing multiple vehicle models or variants in a mixed sequence on the same line (mixed-model assembly). True = mixed-model capable; False = dedicated single-model line. Drives production scheduling complexity and sequencing logic in MES.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1.1 – Control Plan; SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing

attributes.name: model_year_capability
attributes.description: The model year (MY) or range of model years that this production line is currently tooled and certified to produce (e.g., '2024' or '2024-2026'). Drives SOP (Start of Production) and EOP (End of Production) planning, tooling investment decisions, and homologation scheduling.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.3.2 – Design and Development Planning; NHTSA FMVSS Compliance

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned preventive maintenance activity scheduled for this production line. Drives maintenance work order creation in the source system scheduling adjustments, and downtime planning to minimize impact on JPH targets.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1.5 – Total Productive Maintenance; SAP PM Maintenance Planning

attributes.name: number_of_stations
attributes.description: Total count of individual work stations or assembly stations on this production line. Used for line balancing analysis, ergonomic assessments, and determining the number of operators required per shift. Key input for APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) and control plan development.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.3.4.4 – APQP; SAP PP Work Center Station Count

attributes.name: paint_booth_type
attributes.description: Type of paint application system used on this line (applicable to paint shop lines): waterborne (water-based paint — lower VOC emissions), solventborne (solvent-based paint), powder_coat (electrostatic powder coating), or none (non-paint line). Drives EPA/CARB VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) emissions compliance reporting and environmental permit management.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 63 Subpart IIII – Paint Stripping and Miscellaneous Surface Coating; CARB Title 17; ISO 14001

attributes.name: plc_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) system or network controlling this production line's automated equipment (e.g., 'Siemens S7-1500 Network A', 'Allen-Bradley ControlLogix Zone 3'). Used for maintenance management in the source system integration, and cybersecurity asset inventory.
attributes.references: IEC 61131-3 – PLC Programming Standards; IATF 16949 §8.5.1; NIST SP 800-82 – ICS Security

attributes.name: powertrain_type_capability
attributes.description: The powertrain technology types this production line is capable of assembling: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle), or multi (flexible line supporting multiple powertrain types). Critical for EV transition capacity planning and regulatory compliance with EPA/CARB emissions standards.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: quality_gate_count
attributes.description: Number of quality inspection gates or checkpoints integrated into this production line (e.g., in-process inspection stations, end-of-line audit points). Used for quality planning per APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning), control plan documentation, and IATF 16949 compliance audits.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.6 – Release of Products; APQP Phase 4 – Product and Process Validation

attributes.name: robot_count
attributes.description: Total number of industrial robots (welding, painting, assembly, material handling) deployed on this production line. Used for maintenance planning in the source system investment tracking, and Industry 4.0 KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 10218 – Robots and Robotic Devices Safety; IATF 16949 §8.5.1

attributes.name: safety_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the production line's current safety certification. Used to trigger renewal workflows, prevent operation of uncertified lines, and support regulatory audit readiness for OSHA, DOT, and IATF 16949 compliance.

attributes.name: safety_certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the production line's safety certification and compliance with applicable occupational safety standards (e.g., OSHA, CE Machinery Directive, ISO 13849): certified (valid and current), expired (certification lapsed), pending_renewal (renewal in progress), or not_required (exempt from certification requirement).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 – General Industry; ISO 13849 – Safety of Machinery; EU Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC

attributes.name: scada_system_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System Reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system monitoring and controlling this production line (e.g., 'Ignition SCADA Plant2-Zone1', 'Wonderware InTouch Line FA-01'). Used for real-time production monitoring, alarm management, and integration with MES and ERP systems.
attributes.references: IEC 62443 – Industrial Cybersecurity; IATF 16949 §8.5.1; NIST SP 800-82

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System Reference

attributes.name: shift_configuration
attributes.description: Current shift schedule configuration for the production line, indicating the number of operating shifts per day: 1_shift (single day shift), 2_shift (day and afternoon), 3_shift (continuous 24-hour), or 4_shift_rotating (rotating continental schedule). Drives capacity planning, workforce scheduling in SuccessFactors, and MRP calculations in the source system
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1; SAP PP Shift Definition; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The official Start of Production (SOP) date for this production line — the date on which the line commenced or is scheduled to commence series production of the current vehicle program. Used for program milestone tracking, APQP phase gate management, and regulatory homologation scheduling.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.3.2 – Design and Development Planning; APQP Phase 5 – Launch

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: The calculated takt time for this production line in seconds — the maximum allowable time to produce one unit to meet customer demand. Derived from available production time divided by customer demand rate. Stored as a master configuration value for scheduling and line balancing in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) operations.
attributes.references: SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing; IATF 16949 §8.5.1.1 – Control Plan

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this production line master record in the data platform (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §7.5.3 – Control of Documented Information; ISO 9001 §7.5.3

attributes.name: vehicle_platform_code
attributes.description: The vehicle platform or architecture code that this production line is primarily configured to build (e.g., 'F-150 Gen14', 'GMT800', 'MEB'). A single line may support multiple model variants on the same platform. Used for PLM integration with Siemens Teamcenter and production scheduling.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Platform Configuration; IATF 16949 §8.3 – Design and Development

attributes.name: weld_gun_count
attributes.description: Total number of resistance spot weld guns (robotic and manual) deployed on this production line. Applicable primarily to body shop lines. Used for weld quality management per IATF 16949, preventive maintenance scheduling in the source system SPC (Statistical Process Control) monitoring of weld quality.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 §8.5.1.2 – Control of Special Processes; AWS D8.1M – Automotive Spot Welding

products.name: work_center
products.description: Master record for individual work centers (stations) within a production line. Captures work center code, name, type (manual, automated, robotic), cycle time standard, takt time, capacity category, shift availability, and associated PLC/SCADA node identifiers. Supports JIS sequencing and MES shop floor execution at the station level. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
products.reference: SAP PP Work Center / Apriso MES Work Center

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the work center (station) record within the manufacturing data platform. Primary key for the work_center master entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Work‑center cost tracking for OEE and labor cost reporting uses a finance cost center; replacing cost_center_code with cost_center_id is standard practice.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.functional_location. Business justification: Required for Work Center Maintenance Planning reports linking each work center to its functional location in the plant hierarchy.

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production supervisor or team leader responsible for this work center. Used for accountability tracking, escalation routing, and workforce management integration with SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; SuccessFactors HR; IATF 16949

attributes.name: work_responsible_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production supervisor or team leader responsible for this work center. Used for accountability tracking, escalation routing, and workforce management integration with SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; SuccessFactors HR; IATF 16949

attributes.name: agv_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center is integrated with AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) systems for automated material delivery and WIP transport. Drives AGV routing configuration in the MES.

tag_set.value: Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) Integration Enabled Flag

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation at this work center: fully_automated (no human intervention), highly_automated (minimal human oversight), semi_automated (human-assisted), manual (entirely human-operated), or collaborative (human-robot collaboration). Informs CapEx planning and Industry 4.0 transformation roadmap.

attributes.name: available_capacity_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Total available production hours per day for this work center, accounting for planned shift schedules and scheduled breaks. Used in the source system requirements planning (CRP) and MES scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: capacity_category
attributes.description: Capacity classification of the work center: bottleneck (constraining throughput of the line), standard (normal capacity), buffer (excess capacity used to absorb variation), or flexible (can be redeployed across lines). Critical for Theory of Constraints analysis and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CM Module; IATF 16949; SAE International

attributes.name: work_center_category
attributes.description: the source system center category classifying the primary resource type: machine (machine-driven capacity), labor (labor-driven capacity), machine_labor (both machine and labor capacity), or external (subcontracted operation). Determines how capacity and costing are calculated in the source system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module (Work Center Category); IATF 16949

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the work center across MES, the source system SCADA systems. Used as the business key in cross-system integration (e.g., Apriso/Dassault MES work center identifier).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which this work center was officially commissioned and made available for production use. Used for asset age tracking, depreciation calculation, and maintenance lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM/AA Module; IATF 16949; ISO 9001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work center master record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost rates (machine_rate_per_hour, labor_rate_per_hour) associated with this work center (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: cycle_time_seconds
attributes.description: Standard cycle time in seconds for this work center to complete one unit of work. Used in production scheduling, capacity calculation, and bottleneck analysis. Represents the designed throughput rate per station.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module (Standard Value Key); IATF 16949; SAE International

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which this work center was or is planned to be permanently decommissioned and removed from production service. Nullable for active stations. Used for asset lifecycle planning and capacity forecasting.

attributes.name: work_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the work center's function, scope of operations, and any special capabilities or constraints relevant to production planning and scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kw
attributes.description: Rated energy consumption of this work center in kilowatts (kW) under standard operating conditions. Used for energy management, sustainability reporting, and ISO 14001 environmental compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; ISO 50001 Energy Management; EPA Emissions Standards

attributes.name: floor_area_sqm
attributes.description: Physical floor area occupied by this work center in square meters. Used for facility layout planning, ergonomic assessments, and plant capacity management.

attributes.name: is_bottleneck
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center has been identified as a production bottleneck constraining overall line throughput. Bottleneck stations receive priority in capacity planning, maintenance scheduling, and continuous improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949; Theory of Constraints (TOC)

attributes.name: is_jis_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center participates in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) production sequencing. When true, the MES enforces strict vehicle sequence delivery to this station to support mixed-model assembly.

attributes.name: is_quality_gate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work center serves as a quality gate (inspection checkpoint) in the production flow. Quality gate stations require SPC (Statistical Process Control) data capture and may hold WIP pending quality approval.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: labor_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Standard direct labor cost rate per hour (in local currency) for this work center. Used in production order costing, standard cost roll-up, and labor efficiency variance reporting.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent calibration or measurement system verification performed on this work center's tooling and gauges. Required for IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.5 measurement system compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.5; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 9001 Clause 7.1.5

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this work center master record. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the physical location of the work center within the plant (e.g., 'Building A, Bay 3, Row 5'). Supports maintenance routing, safety inspections, and shop floor navigation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: machine_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Standard machine cost rate per hour (in local currency) for this work center, used in production order costing, standard cost calculation, and variance analysis in the source system

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy_code
attributes.description: Maintenance strategy applied to this work center: preventive (scheduled interval-based), predictive (condition-monitoring-based), corrective (repair after failure), or condition_based (triggered by sensor thresholds). Drives the source system planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 14224; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: mean_time_between_failures_hours
attributes.description: Standard mean time between failures (MTBF) in hours for this work center, representing the expected average operational time between unplanned breakdowns. Used in reliability analysis, maintenance planning, and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) benchmarking.

attributes.name: mean_time_to_repair_hours
attributes.description: Standard mean time to repair (MTTR) in hours for this work center, representing the average time required to restore the station to operational status after a failure. Used in maintenance planning and availability calculations.

attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP Variant Configuration; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Order cost tracking and variance analysis require linking each production order to its finance cost center, replacing the denormalized code.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Order creation audit requires tracking planner employee; essential for traceability and compliance.

attributes.name: customer_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Order‑to‑customer linkage required for order fulfillment, warranty, and recall reports; manufacturers need to know which party placed each production order.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Production order cost posting uses a specific GL account; the order‑to‑GL link is required for the Production Order Cost Ledger report.

attributes.name: homologation_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.homologation_record. Business justification: Production Order release process checks Homologation_Record to ensure model/year has regulatory approval before manufacturing starts.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Supports Opportunity‑to‑Production conversion analysis; ties each production order back to the sales opportunity that generated it.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this production order is executed. Corresponds to the the source system organizational unit. Links to the plant master data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Enables Production Order Supplier Impact Analysis, identifying the primary supplier for critical components.

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials (BOM) version used for this production order. The BOM defines all components and sub-assemblies required to build the target material. Managed in the source system Siemens Teamcenter PLM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, final assembly) assigned to execute this order. Maps to the source system (ARBPL) or MES line definition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Order‑level profitability analysis (Order Profitability Statement) needs a profit_center FK to allocate revenue and cost.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: Provides Quote‑to‑Production traceability for financial and compliance reporting; links the quote that was accepted to the resulting production order.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production routing (task list / operation sequence) assigned to this order. The routing defines the sequence of manufacturing operations, work centers, and standard times. Maps to the source system (PLNNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift (e.g., Day, Afternoon, Night) assigned to execute this order. Used for capacity planning, labor allocation, and shift-level production reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system (MATNR) representing the finished vehicle, sub-assembly, or component being produced. The primary product/material being manufactured under this order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: supply_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supply_purchase_order. Business justification: Production scheduling aligns each production order with its originating purchase order to ensure material availability and OTD compliance.

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Each production order is created for a specific vehicle program; order tracking dashboards filter by vehicle_program_id.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The total actual cost incurred to execute this production order, including material consumption, labor, machine, and overhead costs as settled in the source system in the plant's local currency. Used for cost variance analysis, profitability reporting, and CapEx/OpEx tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 9.1; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: actual_finish_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when all production activities for this order were completed and the final goods receipt was posted, as recorded by MES or the source system for cycle time calculation, OTD (On-Time Delivery) measurement, and throughput analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: The total actual direct labor hours consumed during execution of this production order, as confirmed through the source system confirmations or MES time tracking. Used for labor efficiency analysis, variance reporting, and cost actuals in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: actual_machine_hours
attributes.description: The total actual machine/equipment hours consumed during execution of this production order, as recorded by SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems or MES. Used for OEE analysis, machine utilization reporting, and cost variance calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; SCADA; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when production activities for this order actually commenced on the shop floor, as recorded by the MES or confirmed by the first operation confirmation in the source system for cycle time analysis and schedule adherence measurement.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: assembly_sequence_number
