attributes.description: The Just-in-Sequence (JIS) sequence number assigned to this production order, defining its position in the assembly line build sequence. Critical for JIS supply chain synchronization — ensures parts arrive at the line in the exact order vehicles are built. Managed by MES and communicated to tier-1 suppliers.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of vehicles or sub-assemblies that have been confirmed as successfully produced and goods-receipted against this order. Maps to the source system yield quantity (WEMNG). Used for production performance and yield tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production order record was first created in the source system (the source system for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management. Maps to the source system timestamp (ERDAT + ERZET).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard_cost and actual_cost amounts on this production order (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, MXN). Determined by the plant's controlling area currency in the source system

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production order involves the use or production of hazardous materials (e.g., battery electrolytes for EV/HEV powertrains, paint solvents, chemical treatments). True = hazardous materials involved, requiring compliance with EPA, CARB, and ISO 14001 environmental management protocols.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production order record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for change tracking, delta load processing in the lakehouse pipeline, and audit compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: mes_order_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier assigned by the Apriso/Dassault MES system for this production order. Used to correlate the source system with shop floor execution records in the MES for traceability and real-time production control.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) associated with the units being produced under this order. Critical for regulatory compliance (CAFE, EPA, NCAP), warranty tracking, and production program management. Typically a 4-digit year (e.g., 2025).
attributes.references: NHTSA; EPA; CAFE Standards; SAE International

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the production order was created and issued in the source system is the principal business event date representing when the manufacturing work order was formally raised. Maps to the source system date (ERDAT).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: order_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the production order providing additional context about the manufacturing scope, special instructions, or engineering change notes. Used by shop floor supervisors and production planners for operational clarity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the production order as assigned by the source system Planning) or Apriso MES. This is the business-facing reference used on the shop floor, in MES screens, and in cross-system communication. Maps to the source system number (AUFNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the production order within the the source system MES workflow. 'created' = order created but not yet released to shop floor; 'released' = released for execution; 'in_progress' = active manufacturing underway; 'partially_confirmed' = some operations confirmed; 'confirmed' = all operations confirmed; 'technically_completed' = TECO status in the source system complete, pending settlement; 'closed' = fully settled and archived; 'cancelled' = order voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|released|in_progress|partially_confirmed|confirmed|technically_completed|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production order indicating its manufacturing purpose. 'vehicle_build' represents a full vehicle assembly order; 'sub_assembly' covers component or module builds (e.g., powertrain, axle); 'rework' covers defect correction orders; 'repair' covers warranty or field return repairs; 'prototype' covers R&D and pre-SOP (Start of Production) builds. Maps to the source system type (AUART).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which all production activities for this order are planned to be completed. Used for delivery commitment, JIT (Just-in-Time) scheduling, and OTD (On-Time Delivery) performance tracking. Maps to the source system finish date (GLTRS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: planned_labor_hours
attributes.description: The total planned direct labor hours required to execute this production order, derived from the routing standard times and target quantity. Used for capacity planning, workforce scheduling via SuccessFactors, and standard cost calculation in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; SuccessFactors; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1

attributes.name: planned_machine_hours
attributes.description: The total planned machine/equipment hours required to execute this production order, derived from routing standard machine times. Used for equipment capacity planning, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) baseline, and standard cost calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which production activities for this order are planned to begin, as determined by MRP (Material Requirements Planning) or production scheduling. Maps to the source system start date (GSTRS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MRP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: ppap_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) approval is required before this production order can be released for full-volume production. Typically True for new part introductions, engineering changes, or supplier changes. Governed by IATF 16949 and AIAG PPAP standards.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority level assigned to this production order for shop floor scheduling and sequencing. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by MES and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) systems to determine execution order when multiple orders compete for the same resources.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS

attributes.name: production_stage
attributes.description: The manufacturing stage or shop area where this production order is executed. Reflects the physical production process: 'stamping' = metal forming; 'body_shop' = body-in-white welding; 'paint' = surface coating; 'final_assembly' = vehicle assembly; 'powertrain' = engine/transmission build; 'trim_chassis' = trim, chassis, and final fit.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5; SAE International

attributes.name: quality_inspection_lot
attributes.description: The the source system Management) inspection lot number created for quality inspection activities associated with this production order. Links production execution to quality results, usage decisions, and non-conformance records. Maps to the source system lot (QMNUM).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; ISO 9001 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production order was formally released to the shop floor for execution. Release triggers material staging, capacity reservation, and MES order activation. Maps to the source system release date/time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units that required rework (non-conforming units corrected and returned to production flow) during execution of this order. Distinct from scrap — reworked units are salvaged. Used for quality cost analysis and APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; APQP

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units scrapped or rejected during production of this order due to quality defects or process failures. Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation, scrap cost analysis, and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; SPC

attributes.name: sop_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production order is part of the SOP (Start of Production) launch phase for a new vehicle program. True = SOP launch order subject to enhanced quality monitoring and APQP controls; False = regular series production order.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: The planned standard cost to produce the target quantity under this order, calculated from the BOM (Bill of Materials) component costs and routing activity rates in the source system Expressed in the plant's local currency. Used for cost variance analysis and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 9.1; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: target_quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity of vehicles or sub-assemblies to be produced under this order, expressed in the base unit of measure (typically 'EA' for each). Maps to the source system order quantity (GAMNG). Used for capacity planning and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: technical_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production order was set to Technically Completed (TECO) status in the source system all manufacturing operations are finished and the order is pending cost settlement. Distinct from actual_finish_timestamp which records the last physical operation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for the target and confirmed quantities on this production order (e.g., EA = Each for vehicles, PC = Piece for components, SET for kits, KG for bulk materials). Maps to the source system of measure (MEINS).

attributes.name: vin_range_end
attributes.description: The last VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) in the sequential range assigned to units produced under this order. Together with vin_range_start, defines the complete set of vehicles traceable to this production order for recall, warranty, and homologation purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J272

attributes.name: vin_range_start
attributes.description: The first VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) in the sequential range assigned to units produced under this order. VINs are 17-character alphanumeric identifiers conforming to ISO 3779. Used for build traceability, recall management, and regulatory reporting to NHTSA.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J272

attributes.name: wip_posting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether WIP (Work in Progress) costs have been calculated and posted to the financial ledger for this production order in the current period. True = WIP posted; False = WIP not yet posted. Used for period-end financial closing in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP/IFRS IAS 2

products.name: build_sequence
products.description: JIS (Just-in-Sequence) build sequence record defining the ordered sequence of vehicles to be assembled on a production line for a given shift or production run. Captures sequence number, planned build date, shift, line assignment, vehicle configuration reference (model, trim, powertrain, color), sequence status, and freeze timestamp. Critical for JIS supplier call-offs and AGV routing. Sourced from Apriso MES sequencing module. [preservation_guardrail: verified]

attributes.name: build_sequence_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Just-in-Sequence (JIS) build sequence record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key generated by the Apriso/Dassault MES sequencing module upon sequence creation.

attributes.name: build_configuration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle configuration record defining the model, trim, powertrain, and option codes for the vehicle to be assembled at this sequence position.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Dassault ENOVIA; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: build_vehicle_config_configuration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle configuration record defining the model, trim, powertrain, and option codes for the vehicle to be assembled at this sequence position.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Dassault ENOVIA; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this build sequence is executed. Links to the plant master record in the enterprise data model.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific assembly or production line to which this build sequence is assigned. Drives AGV routing and JIS supplier call-off logic.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: Rename work_order_id to production_order_id to follow FK naming convention and link each build sequence to its parent production order.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this build sequence is scheduled to execute. Determines labor allocation and JIS call-off windows.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time at which assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position was completed on the production line, as recorded by the MES. Null until assembly is complete.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time at which assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position commenced on the production line, as recorded by the MES. Null until assembly begins.

attributes.name: assembly_stage
attributes.description: Current or target assembly stage for this sequence position: 'stamping' = metal forming; 'body_shop' = body-in-white welding; 'paint' = paint application; 'final_assembly' = trim and chassis assembly; 'PDI' = Pre-Delivery Inspection. Drives shop floor routing in the MES.

attributes.name: body_style_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the body style of the vehicle (e.g., sedan, SUV, truck, coupe, van). Influences stamping and body shop routing within the production sequence.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: build_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle build purpose: 'retail' = customer-ordered retail unit; 'fleet' = fleet customer order; 'stock' = dealer stock build; 'pilot' = pre-production pilot build; 'homologation' = regulatory homologation unit; 'press' = media/press fleet unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Apriso/Dassault MES; NHTSA; UNECE

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this build sequence record was first created in the MES sequencing module and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_order_number
attributes.description: Sales order number from the source system the source system associated with this build sequence position, if the vehicle is built to a specific customer or dealer order. Null for stock builds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the dealer for whom this vehicle is being built, if applicable. Sourced from the dealer master in CDK Global DMS or the source system Null for unallocated stock builds.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: destination_market_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the intended destination market for the vehicle. Determines homologation variant, regulatory compliance requirements (NHTSA, UNECE, CARB), and market-specific option content.

attributes.name: drive_configuration
attributes.description: Drivetrain configuration of the vehicle: FWD (Front-Wheel Drive), RWD (Rear-Wheel Drive), AWD (All-Wheel Drive), or 4WD (Four-Wheel Drive). Determines axle and driveshaft JIS call-off and assembly routing.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; SAE International

attributes.name: exterior_color_code
attributes.description: Paint color code for the vehicle exterior as specified in the build sequence. Drives paint shop scheduling, batch sequencing for color changeover optimization, and JIS paint material call-off.

attributes.name: freeze_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the build sequence was frozen and locked for JIS supplier call-off. After this timestamp, sequence changes are restricted and require formal change control. Critical for JIS supplier synchronization.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: interior_color_code
attributes.description: Interior trim and upholstery color code for the vehicle. Used for JIS seat and interior component call-off to tier-1 suppliers.

attributes.name: is_frozen
attributes.description: Indicates whether the build sequence record has been frozen for JIS supplier call-off. When True, sequence changes are restricted and require formal change control approval. Directly linked to freeze_timestamp.

attributes.name: is_priority_build
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle has been flagged as a priority build (e.g., executive order, critical dealer allocation, regulatory compliance unit). Priority builds may override standard JIS sequencing rules.

attributes.name: jis_call_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the JIS supplier call-off message was transmitted for this sequence position. Triggers sequenced part delivery from tier-1 JIS suppliers. Critical for supply chain synchronization and OTD measurement.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA MM; IATF 16949

attributes.name: mes_sequence_reference
attributes.description: Native sequence record identifier from the Apriso/Dassault MES sequencing module. Serves as the source system key for lineage and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational MES.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Four-digit model year (MY) of the vehicle to be assembled at this sequence position. Determines applicable BOM revision, regulatory homologation requirements, and CAFE/EPA compliance targets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; NHTSA; EPA; CAFE

attributes.name: option_package_code
attributes.description: Code representing the bundled option package (e.g., technology package, towing package, safety package) selected for the vehicle. Determines additional BOM components and JIS call-off requirements.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: planned_build_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the vehicle at this sequence position is planned to be assembled. Used for JIS supplier call-off scheduling and production planning in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position is planned to complete. Used for takt time validation and shift throughput planning.

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position is planned to begin on the production line. Drives JIS call-off timing and AGV dispatch scheduling.

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain to be assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives line routing, tooling selection, and regulatory compliance checks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; EPA; CARB; CAFE; WLTP

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this build sequence position has been placed on a quality hold, preventing progression to the next assembly stage. Triggered by MES quality gate failures or FMEA-driven stop conditions.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA QM; IATF 16949; APQP

attributes.name: regulatory_variant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory homologation variant of the vehicle (e.g., US-NHTSA, EU-UNECE, CARB-ZEV). Ensures correct BOM variant selection for emissions, safety, and market-specific compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA; UNECE; CARB; EPA; DOT FMVSS; Euro NCAP

attributes.name: sequence_change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for the most recent modification to this build sequence record (e.g., material shortage, quality hold, customer order change, line disruption). Required for change control audit trail under IATF 16949.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordered position number of this vehicle within the production run for the assigned line and shift. Drives JIS supplier call-off sequencing and AGV routing. Must be unique within a plant, line, shift, and planned build date combination.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP; IATF 16949

attributes.name: sequence_revision_number
attributes.description: Incremental revision counter tracking how many times this build sequence record has been modified since initial creation. Supports audit trail and change control compliance under IATF 16949.

attributes.name: sequence_set_number
attributes.description: Externally-known identifier for the production sequence set or run to which this record belongs, as generated by the MES sequencing module. Used for JIS call-off batch identification and supplier communication.

attributes.name: sequence_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the build sequence record within the MES workflow. 'planned' = sequence created but not yet released to shop floor; 'released' = released for production; 'in_progress' = vehicle currently being assembled; 'completed' = assembly finished; 'cancelled' = sequence removed from run; 'on_hold' = temporarily suspended pending resolution.

attributes.name: sequence_type
attributes.description: Classification of the build sequence record indicating whether it is the original planned sequence, a revised sequence after change control, an emergency insertion, or a resequenced position due to line disruption.

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Planned takt time in seconds allocated for assembly of the vehicle at this sequence position. Derived from the line rate and used for production pacing, WIP tracking, and OTD performance measurement.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP; IATF 16949

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission to be installed in the vehicle at this sequence position. Drives drivetrain component JIS call-off and assembly station routing.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; SAE International

attributes.name: trim_level_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the trim or grade level of the vehicle (e.g., base, mid, premium, sport). Determines option content, BOM variant, and JIS part call-off requirements.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Dassault ENOVIA; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to this build sequence record, as recorded in the MES or Silver Layer. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the vehicle model (e.g., platform or nameplate code) to be assembled at this sequence position. Sourced from Teamcenter PLM product structure.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; IATF 16949

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) assigned to the vehicle at this sequence position, conforming to ISO 3779 and NHTSA standards. May be pre-assigned at sequence creation or stamped during body shop operations. Critical for build traceability and regulatory compliance.

products.name: vehicle_build
products.description: Transactional record capturing the actual build event for a single vehicle unit on the shop floor, from body-in-white through final assembly. Tracks VIN assignment, production order reference, actual start and completion timestamps per build stage (stamping, body shop, paint, trim, chassis, final), build status, shift, operator team, and any hold or rework flags. SSOT for vehicle-level build traceability and genealogy in the manufacturing domain. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
products.reference: Apriso MES Vehicle Traceability / VIN Build Record

attributes.name: vehicle_build_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vehicle_build

attributes.name: build_stage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.build_stage. Business justification: Vehicle build references its current build stage; replace string column with FK to build_stage for normalization.

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Required for OTA update management: associate each built vehicle with its connected vehicle record for remote diagnostics, firmware deployment, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: homologation_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.homologation_record. Business justification: Each built vehicle must be tied to its Homologation_Record for VIN‑level compliance verification and reporting.

attributes.name: operator_team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operator team or crew responsible for executing this vehicle build. Used for workforce productivity and quality traceability.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this vehicle was assembled. Enables plant-level production reporting and capacity analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Plant / Work Center

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system order that authorized and scheduled this vehicle build. Links the build event to the manufacturing planning hierarchy.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this vehicle build was executed. Supports shift-level throughput and quality analysis.

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: Enables Build ↔ Delivery scheduling; associates each built vehicle with the sales order it fulfills for handover and logistics planning.

attributes.name: vehicle_ownership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.vehicle_ownership. Business justification: Recall and ownership analytics require tying the build record to the ownership record that stores acquisition date, purchase price, and ownership number.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: VIN Registration Integration needed for warranty, recall, and regulatory reporting linking build record to VIN registry.

attributes.name: assembly_line_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific production/assembly line within the plant on which this vehicle was built (e.g., LINE-A1, TRIM-LINE-3). Used for line-level throughput analysis, bottleneck identification, and SCADA/PLC integration.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Center / Line Assignment; SAP PP – Work Center

attributes.name: battery_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the high-voltage traction battery pack installed in this vehicle (applicable to HEV, PHEV, BEV). Null for ICE vehicles. Critical for EV battery genealogy, warranty, and end-of-life regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2; EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542; CARB ZEV Regulations

attributes.name: body_shop_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the body shop stage was completed and the body-in-white was released to the paint shop. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: body_shop_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body-in-white (BIW) entered the body shop for welding and assembly. Key milestone for build genealogy and stage cycle time tracking.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: The body style classification of the vehicle being built. Used for production line routing, tooling selection, and regulatory homologation grouping.
attributes.references: SAE J1100 – Vehicle Body Style Classification; UNECE Regulation No. 55

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: The specific BOM (Bill of Materials) version or engineering change level used to build this vehicle. Captured at build time for genealogy and recall traceability. Links to Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM management.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Management; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability

attributes.name: build_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the vehicle build was completed at the final assembly stage and signed off for PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Null if the build is still in progress. Used for cycle time, throughput, and SOP/EOP milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Order Actual Finish; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: build_sequence_number
attributes.description: The Just-in-Sequence (JIS) production sequence number assigned to this vehicle on the assembly line. Determines the order in which vehicles are built and parts are delivered to the line. Critical for JIS/JIT supply chain synchronization.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Sequence Number; SAP PP – JIS Sequencing

attributes.name: build_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the vehicle build process commenced at the first production stage (typically body-in-white or stamping entry). Principal business event timestamp for the build lifecycle. Used for cycle time calculation and OTD (On-Time Delivery) analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Order Actual Start; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: build_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vehicle build record. Drives shop floor workflow, MES gating, and production reporting. 'on_hold' indicates a quality or material hold; 'rework' indicates a defect requiring corrective action before completion.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Order Status; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: build_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle build type: standard (full local assembly), CKD (Completely Knocked Down – assembled from imported kits), SKD (Semi Knocked Down), pilot (pre-SOP trial build), or prototype (engineering validation). Affects BOM, duty classification, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PP – Order Type; WTO Customs Valuation; IATF 16949 APQP

attributes.name: chassis_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the chassis assembly stage was completed. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: chassis_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the chassis assembly stage for powertrain marriage, suspension, and drivetrain installation.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vehicle build record was first created in the MES/data platform. Represents the audit trail creation event, distinct from the build_start_timestamp which is the actual shop floor event time.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: end_of_line_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the automated end-of-line (EOL) functional test performed on the completed vehicle, covering powertrain, brakes, ADAS, and electrical systems. Distinct from quality_gate_status which covers visual/dimensional inspection.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; DOT FMVSS – Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; SAE J1739 FMEA

attributes.name: engine_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the engine unit installed in this vehicle during chassis assembly. Critical for powertrain genealogy, warranty traceability, and recall management.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability; NHTSA Recall Regulations 49 CFR Part 573

attributes.name: final_assembly_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the final assembly stage was completed and the vehicle was released for PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: final_assembly_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the final assembly stage for fluids, wheels, glass, and end-of-line checks.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle build is currently under a production hold (True = on hold). A hold may be triggered by a quality non-conformance, missing parts, engineering change, or safety concern. Drives MES gating to prevent further assembly until resolved.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs; Apriso/Dassault MES – Hold Management

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the production hold applied to this vehicle build (e.g., QUALITY_DEFECT, MISSING_PART, ECN_CHANGE, SAFETY_CONCERN). Null if hold_flag is False. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QUALITY_DEFECT|MISSING_PART|ECN_CHANGE|SAFETY_CONCERN|SUPPLIER_DEVIATION|TOOLING_FAILURE|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; Apriso/Dassault MES – Hold Reason Codes

attributes.name: homologation_market
attributes.description: The target regulatory market for which this vehicle is homologated and built (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR, CHN, AUS). Determines applicable safety, emissions, and labeling standards. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.
attributes.references: UNECE Vehicle Regulations; NHTSA 49 CFR; Euro NCAP; CARB; DOT FMVSS

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The automotive model year (MY) designation for the vehicle being built (e.g., 2025). Determines applicable regulatory standards, BOM revision, and homologation requirements. Distinct from the calendar year of production.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J1297 – Model Year Definition

attributes.name: paint_color_code
attributes.description: The manufacturer's paint color code applied to this vehicle during the paint stage (e.g., G1W – Super White, 040 – Classic White). Used for paint shop scheduling, color sequencing optimization, and customer order matching.
attributes.references: SAP PP – Configuration / Variant; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Configuration

attributes.name: paint_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the paint stage was completed and the vehicle body was released to the trim/general assembly line. Null if stage not yet completed.

attributes.name: paint_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body entered the paint shop for priming, painting, and clear-coat application.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; ISO 14001 – Environmental Management (paint VOC emissions)

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology being assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives assembly line routing, tooling, and EPA/CARB emissions compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; SAE J1715

attributes.name: quality_gate_status
attributes.description: Result of the end-of-line quality gate inspection for this vehicle build. 'conditional_pass' indicates the vehicle passed with minor deviations requiring dealer rectification. Drives release-to-shipping authorization.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.6 – Release of Products; APQP; Euro NCAP; NHTSA FMVSS

attributes.name: rework_count
attributes.description: Number of rework operations performed on this vehicle build. A count greater than zero indicates quality issues encountered during assembly. Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation and FMEA analysis.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; SPC – Statistical Process Control; APQP

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle build has been flagged for rework due to a detected defect or non-conformance (True = rework required). Distinct from hold_flag; a vehicle can be in rework while not on hold.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs; FMEA Process

attributes.name: scheduled_build_date
attributes.description: The planned calendar date on which this vehicle was scheduled to be built per the production plan (MRP/MES schedule). Used to measure schedule adherence and production plan vs. actual variance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scheduled Finish Date; MRP Planning

attributes.name: sop_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle build is part of the official Start of Production (SOP) launch batch (True = SOP vehicle). SOP vehicles are subject to enhanced quality scrutiny and PPAP sign-off requirements.
attributes.references: APQP – Advanced Product Quality Planning; PPAP – Production Part Approval Process; IATF 16949

attributes.name: stamping_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the stamping stage was completed and the body panels were released to the body shop. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: stamping_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body panels entered the stamping stage. Used for stage-level cycle time analysis and production flow monitoring.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: transmission_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the transmission unit installed in this vehicle. Used for drivetrain genealogy, warranty claims, and component-level recall traceability.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability; NHTSA Recall Regulations 49 CFR Part 573

attributes.name: trim_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the trim assembly stage was completed. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: trim_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the trim assembly stage for interior fitting, electrical harness installation, and dashboard assembly.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this vehicle build record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, audit trails, and detecting stale records in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal product/model code identifying the vehicle nameplate and variant being built (e.g., F150-XLT-4WD). Maps to the PLM product structure in Siemens Teamcenter. Used for BOM resolution and build sequence planning.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Structure; SAP PP – Material Master

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: The globally unique 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) assigned to this vehicle unit at body-in-white or VIN stamping stage. Conforms to ISO 3779 / NHTSA VIN standard. SSOT for vehicle-level traceability across manufacturing, sales, and after-sales domains.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN Requirements

products.name: build_stage
products.description: Reference master defining the standard build stages in the vehicle manufacturing process (e.g., Stamping, Body Shop, E-Coat, Paint, Trim-1, Chassis, Trim-2, Final, PDI). Captures stage code, stage name, sequence order, process area, standard cycle time, and applicable vehicle types. Used to structure vehicle_build traceability and production reporting. [preservation_guardrail: verified]

attributes.name: build_stage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each build stage record in the vehicle manufacturing process. Primary key for the build_stage reference master. [REFERENCE_LOOKUP role — canonical_skip_reason: This entity is a reference master defining standard build stages; per-role minimums for REFERENCE_LOOKUP are exempt, but all meaningful business attributes are still included for completeness.]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 — Quality Management Systems for Automotive Production

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Stage‑level cost capture for capacity planning and cost of quality uses a finance cost center; the FK replaces the string code.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_line. Business justification: Build stages are defined per production line; adding production_line_id FK groups stages under their line.

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: REQUIRED: Each build stage is overseen by a supervisor employee; needed for accountability and shift handover reports.

attributes.name: agv_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) systems are deployed at this build stage for material transport, vehicle body movement, or component sequencing. Drives AGV routing configuration and integration with SCADA and MES systems.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — AGV Integration; SCADA System Configuration

attributes.name: applicable_vehicle_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle body types or powertrain categories for which this build stage applies (e.g., Sedan, SUV, Truck, EV, HEV, PHEV, ICE, Commercial). Enables stage filtering in mixed-model assembly lines and supports model-specific production routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Sedan|SUV|Truck|EV|HEV|PHEV|ICE|Commercial|CKD|SKD — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Version; Siemens Teamcenter PLM — BOM Management

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Classification of the degree of automation at this build stage: manual (operator-driven), semi-automated (operator-assisted machinery), fully-automated (machine-driven with minimal operator oversight), or robotic (AGV/robot-cell driven). Informs CapEx planning, maintenance scheduling, and OEE benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Equipment Master; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; SAE International

attributes.name: buffer_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicle units that can be held in the buffer/queue between this build stage and the next stage. Defines the WIP (Work in Progress) inventory limit for line balancing and is used in production simulation and bottleneck analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; Apriso/Dassault MES — Buffer Management

attributes.name: co2_emission_kg
attributes.description: Standard CO2-equivalent emissions in kilograms per vehicle unit processed at this build stage. Supports EPA and CARB (California Air Resources Board) environmental compliance reporting, sustainability KPIs, and manufacturing carbon footprint tracking.
attributes.references: EPA — Greenhouse Gas Reporting Rule; CARB — Cap-and-Trade Program; ISO 14001

attributes.name: control_plan_code
attributes.description: Reference code of the APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) control plan document governing quality control activities at this build stage. Specifies product/process characteristics, control methods, and reaction plans for out-of-control conditions per IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control Plan; APQP Phase 4; AIAG Control Plan Reference Manual

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this build stage record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for master data governance and change history tracking per IATF 16949 documented information control requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this build stage definition record is valid and applicable for production use. Supports temporal versioning of the build stage master, enabling historical traceability of process changes and engineering change management.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information Control; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this build stage definition record is valid. Null indicates the record is currently active with no planned expiry. Used for managing engineering changes, process revisions, and model-year transitions in the build stage master.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information Control; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Standard energy consumption in kilowatt-hours (kWh) per vehicle unit processed through this build stage. Used for manufacturing sustainability reporting, carbon footprint calculation, and ISO 14001 environmental management compliance. Particularly significant for paint ovens and E-Coat tanks.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Clause 6.1.2 — Environmental Aspects; EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting; CARB

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: The EOP (End of Production) date on which this build stage is scheduled to be or was decommissioned. Null if the stage is currently active with no planned end date. Used for production planning horizon management and asset retirement scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Version; Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones

attributes.name: fmea_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) Reference Code
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this build stage to its corresponding FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) document. Ensures traceability between the process stage definition and its risk assessment per IATF 16949 and APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — PFMEA; APQP Phase 3; SAE J1739

tag_set.value: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) Reference Code

attributes.name: hazmat_classification
attributes.description: Classification of hazardous materials present or used at this build stage per DOT and EPA regulations (e.g., paint solvents, E-Coat chemicals, welding fumes). Drives EHS (Environmental Health and Safety) compliance, PPE requirements, and ISO 14001 environmental management reporting.
attributes.references: EPA — Hazardous Waste Regulations; DOT — Hazardous Materials Regulations; ISO 14001 Clause 6.1.2

attributes.name: iatf_process_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: IATF (International Automotive Task Force) Process Category
attributes.description: IATF 16949 process category designation for this build stage: special-characteristic (processes producing special product/process characteristics requiring enhanced control), standard-process, critical-process (safety-critical per FMVSS), or monitoring-only (observation without active control). Drives audit scope and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Special Characteristics; AIAG PPAP 4th Edition

tag_set.value: IATF (International Automotive Task Force) Process Category

attributes.name: is_quality_gate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this build stage is designated as a quality gate checkpoint where vehicles must pass defined quality criteria before advancing to the next stage. Quality gates are mandatory hold points per IATF 16949 and APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; APQP Phase Gate Reviews; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: is_rework_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether vehicles failing quality checks at this build stage are eligible for rework and re-entry into the production flow, as opposed to being routed to scrap or offline repair. Drives rework routing logic in MES and quality management workflows.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 — Control of Nonconforming Outputs; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: labor_headcount_standard
attributes.description: The standard number of direct labor operators assigned to this build stage per shift under normal production conditions. Used for workforce planning, capacity balancing, and labor cost standard costing in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Standard Value Key; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable ambient or process temperature in degrees Celsius for this build stage. Exceeding this threshold triggers a quality hold and SCADA alarm. Particularly relevant for paint curing ovens, E-Coat baths, and weld quality control.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Characteristics; SCADA

attributes.name: mes_stage_code
attributes.description: The native stage identifier as defined in the Apriso/Dassault MES system. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational MES, ensuring traceability of production events back to the source system of record.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 — Traceability

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable ambient or process temperature in degrees Celsius for this build stage to operate within specification. Critical for paint shop, E-Coat, and adhesive curing stages where temperature directly affects product quality. Used in SPC (Statistical Process Control) monitoring.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production Processes; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: model_year_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of MY (Model Year) designations for which this build stage definition is applicable (e.g., MY2024,MY2025) or ALL if applicable across all model years. Supports model-year-specific production routing and engineering change management.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Engineering Change Management; SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Version

attributes.name: plant_area_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific plant area or shop within the manufacturing facility where this build stage is physically located (e.g., SH01 for Stamping Hall 1, BS02 for Body Shop 2). Aligns with the source system center and plant layout master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center; SAP S/4HANA PM — Functional Location

attributes.name: plc_program_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) program controlling the automated equipment at this build stage. Used for change management, version control of control programs, and traceability of equipment configuration changes per IATF 16949 requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production Equipment; SCADA System

attributes.name: ppm_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: PPM (Parts Per Million) Defect Rate Target
attributes.description: Target defect rate for this build stage expressed in PPM (Parts Per Million). Defines the quality performance benchmark used in IATF 16949 supplier and process quality reporting, SPC control limit setting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.1 — Monitoring and Measurement; AIAG PPAP; SAP S/4HANA QM

tag_set.value: PPM (Parts Per Million) Defect Rate Target

attributes.name: preceding_stage_code
attributes.description: Stage code of the immediately preceding build stage in the standard production sequence. Defines the upstream dependency for production flow control, WIP (Work in Progress) tracking, and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling. Null for the first stage in the sequence.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Sequence; Apriso/Dassault MES — Stage Dependency

attributes.name: process_area
attributes.description: The physical or functional manufacturing area where this build stage is executed (e.g., Stamping Plant, Body Shop, Paint Shop, General Assembly, Chassis Line, PDI Bay). Maps to plant layout zones and is used for capacity planning and SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) integration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Stamping|Body Shop|Paint Shop|E-Coat|General Assembly|Chassis Line|Trim Line|PDI Bay|Quality Gate|Logistics — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center

attributes.name: quality_inspection_plan_code
attributes.description: Reference code of the the source system Management) inspection plan associated with this build stage. Defines the inspection characteristics, sampling procedures, and acceptance criteria applied during quality gate checks. Linked to FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and APQP documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Plan (QP01); IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; APQP

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: Safety risk classification of this build stage per DOT and OSHA standards: standard (routine operations), elevated-risk (requires additional PPE or safety protocols), critical-safety (safety-critical operations with mandatory sign-off), or restricted-access (limited to certified personnel only).
attributes.references: DOT — Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS); OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: sap_operation_code
attributes.description: The the source system routing operation code corresponding to this build stage. Enables direct linkage between the build stage reference master and the source system routing operations for cost allocation, scheduling, and confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing (CA01/CA02); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: sequence_order
attributes.description: Integer defining the sequential position of this build stage within the overall vehicle assembly process flow. Used to enforce JIS (Just-in-Sequence) ordering, production line scheduling, and WIP (Work in Progress) traceability. Lower values indicate earlier stages.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Production Order Routing; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Standard shift pattern under which this build stage operates: single (one shift per day), double (two shifts), triple (three shifts), or continuous (24/7 operation). Used for capacity planning, labor scheduling in SuccessFactors, and production throughput calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Sequence; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The SOP (Start of Production) date on which this build stage was first commissioned and became operational for regular production. Used for asset lifecycle tracking, warranty baseline calculations, and production history reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Version; Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones

attributes.name: spc_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether SPC (Statistical Process Control) monitoring is active for this build stage. When true, process parameters are continuously monitored against control limits and deviations trigger automated alerts in the MES and the source system per IATF 16949 requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — SPC; AIAG SPC Reference Manual; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: stage_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the build stage within the manufacturing process (e.g., STAMP, BODY, ECOAT, PAINT, TRIM1, CHAS, TRIM2, FINAL, PDI). Used as the business key in MES (Manufacturing Execution System) integrations and production reporting.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: stage_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the manufacturing activities, operations, and objectives performed at this build stage. Provides context for production engineers, quality auditors, and training documentation. Sourced from PLM and MES configuration documentation.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Process Description; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information

attributes.name: stage_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the build stage as used in production planning and reporting (e.g., Stamping, Body Shop, E-Coat, Paint, Trim-1, Chassis, Trim-2, Final Assembly, PDI — Pre-Delivery Inspection). Displayed in MES dashboards and production schedules.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: stage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the build stage definition: active (in production use), inactive (temporarily not in use), pilot (under validation/trial), suspended (halted due to quality or safety issue), or decommissioned (permanently retired from the process). Controls whether the stage is available for new production orders.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Stage Configuration; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: stage_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the build stage by its primary manufacturing function: assembly (joining components), fabrication (forming/stamping metal), coating (E-Coat/paint application), inspection (quality gate checks), testing (functional/NVH testing), or logistics (material staging/sequencing).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5; SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Process Classification

attributes.name: standard_cycle_time_sec
attributes.description: The engineered standard cycle time for this build stage measured in seconds. Represents the designed takt-aligned duration for one vehicle unit to complete the stage under normal operating conditions. Used for production scheduling, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation, and bottleneck analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Standard Value Key; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; SAE International J4000

attributes.name: succeeding_stage_code
attributes.description: Stage code of the immediately succeeding build stage in the standard production sequence. Defines the downstream handoff point for production flow control and vehicle build traceability. Null for the final stage (PDI) in the sequence.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Sequence; Apriso/Dassault MES — Stage Dependency

attributes.name: takt_time_sec
attributes.description: The customer-demand-driven takt time for this build stage in seconds, calculated as available production time divided by required production volume. Defines the rhythm of production and is used to balance line capacity and identify over/under-capacity stages.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; SAE International

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this build stage record. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trail maintenance, and engineering change management workflows per IATF 16949 documented information control.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: the source system center identifier associated with this build stage. Links the build stage to capacity planning, cost center allocation, and production order routing in the ERP system. Enables integration between MES stage execution and the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center Master (CR01/CR02); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

products.name: shop_floor_event
products.description: Granular transactional record capturing real-time shop floor events generated by MES, PLC, and SCADA systems during production. Includes event type (station entry, station exit, torque confirmation, weld completion, paint cure, AGV arrival, hold trigger, alarm), event timestamp, work center, production order reference, VIN reference, operator ID, and event payload. Enables real-time production monitoring and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation. [preservation_guardrail: verified]

attributes.name: shop_floor_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shop floor event record generated by MES, PLC, or SCADA systems during production operations.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the event occurred. Supports multi-plant OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shop floor operator or technician who performed or acknowledged the event. Sourced from SuccessFactors workforce records.

attributes.name: primary_equipment_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific machine, robot, or automated equipment (e.g., welding robot, torque tool, paint gun, AGV unit) that generated or is associated with this event. Sourced from the source system master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Equipment Master; IATF 16949

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system order under which this shop floor event was generated. Links the event to the scheduled manufacturing work order.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this event was recorded. Enables shift-level OEE and throughput analysis.

attributes.name: shop_equipment_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific machine, robot, or automated equipment (e.g., welding robot, torque tool, paint gun, AGV unit) that generated or is associated with this event. Sourced from the source system master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Equipment Master; IATF 16949

attributes.name: shop_operator_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shop floor operator or technician who performed or acknowledged the event. Sourced from SuccessFactors workforce records.

attributes.name: shop_tool_tooling_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific hand tool or automated tool (e.g., torque wrench, weld gun tip, drill bit) used during this event. Enables tool traceability for PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) and tool wear monitoring.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Tool Management; PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)

attributes.name: shop_tooling_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific hand tool or automated tool (e.g., torque wrench, weld gun tip, drill bit) used during this event. Enables tool traceability for PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) and tool wear monitoring.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Tool Management; PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle unit being processed at the time of this event. Enables full build traceability from stamping through final assembly per NHTSA VIN requirements.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system center (station, cell, or line segment) where this event occurred. Identifies the physical production resource.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center; IATF 16949

attributes.name: agv_unit_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) unit involved in this event. Populated only for AGV arrival, departure, or fault events. Enables AGV fleet utilization and route efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – AGV Integration; ISO 3691-4 – AGV Safety

attributes.name: assembly_area
attributes.description: Major manufacturing area where the event occurred. Supports area-level OEE reporting and quality gate management across stamping, body shop, paint, and final assembly. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint_shop|final_assembly|powertrain|chassis|trim — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Process Control Plan; Apriso MES

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shop floor event record was first ingested into the Databricks Silver layer. Distinct from event_timestamp (real-world event time). Used for data pipeline latency monitoring and audit trail.

attributes.name: event_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the event type for reporting and analytics. Enables aggregated OEE loss categorization (availability, performance, quality) and safety incident tracking.

attributes.name: event_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the shop floor event in seconds (e.g., station cycle time, weld duration, paint cure time). Principal quantitative measurement for cycle time analysis and OEE performance rate calculation.

attributes.name: event_payload
attributes.description: Structured JSON string containing the full event-specific payload from the MES, PLC, or SCADA system. Stores additional context-specific parameters not captured in dedicated columns (e.g., weld schedule parameters, paint recipe ID, torque angle). Stored as STRING to comply with Silver layer no-complex-type constraint.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Event Payload; ISA-95 Manufacturing Operations

attributes.name: event_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating control system that generated this event (MES, PLC, SCADA, AGV controller, or manual entry). Critical for data lineage and root-cause analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MES|PLC|SCADA|AGV|TPMS|OBD|MANUAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; IEC 61131 – PLC Standards; ISA-95

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shop floor event record. Indicates whether the event has been acknowledged, confirmed by the operator, placed on hold, or escalated for quality review.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the shop floor event occurred as recorded by the MES, PLC, or SCADA system. This is the principal real-world event time used for OEE calculation and production sequencing.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Discriminator classifying the kind of shop floor event. Drives downstream routing, OEE calculation, and quality gate logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: station_entry|station_exit|torque_confirmation|weld_completion|paint_cure|agv_arrival|hold_trigger|alarm|inspection_pass|inspection_fail|rework_start|rework_complete — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fault_code
attributes.description: Machine or process fault code generated by the PLC or SCADA system when an alarm or hold event occurs. Used for root-cause analysis, FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) updates, and maintenance work order creation.
attributes.references: IEC 61131 – PLC Fault Codes; IATF 16949 FMEA; SAP PM

attributes.name: fault_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the fault or alarm condition associated with this event. Populated from the PLC/SCADA alarm dictionary. Null for non-alarm events.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for a production hold triggered by this event (e.g., QUAL-FAIL, TORQUE-OOC, WELD-MISS, PART-MISSING). Populated only for hold_trigger event types. Drives quality containment and corrective action workflows.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Nonconforming Product Control; SAP QM

attributes.name: is_rework
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event is associated with a rework operation (True) rather than a first-pass production operation (False). Used to calculate first-time quality (FTQ) and rework cost metrics.

attributes.name: is_within_spec
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured value falls within the defined process control limits (True) or represents an out-of-specification condition (False). Drives automatic quality hold triggers and PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Process Control; AIAG FMEA Manual

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Lower statistical process control limit for the measured value at this station. Used in SPC (Statistical Process Control) to detect process drift and trigger quality holds.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – SPC; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Principal numeric measurement captured during the event (e.g., torque value in Nm, weld current in A, paint film thickness in µm, temperature in °C, pressure in bar). Null when the event type does not produce a measurement.

attributes.name: measured_value_unit
attributes.description: Engineering unit of measure for the measured_value field (e.g., Nm for torque, A for weld current, µm for paint film thickness). Ensures dimensional correctness in SPC and quality analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Nm|A|V|bar|°C|µm|mm|kg|kN|rpm|% — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: mes_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique event reference number assigned by the Apriso/Dassault MES system. Used for cross-system traceability and audit correlation.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Four-digit model year (MY) of the vehicle being produced at the time of this event. Supports model-year-level production analytics and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: oee_loss_category
attributes.description: Classifies this event's contribution to OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) loss: availability loss (unplanned downtime), performance loss (speed reduction), quality loss (defects/rework), or no_loss (normal production). Enables direct OEE waterfall analysis per ISO 22400.

attributes.name: planned_cycle_time_seconds
attributes.description: Standard planned cycle time in seconds for this process step as defined in the the source system Compared against event_duration_seconds to calculate performance rate for OEE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing Standard Values; ISO 22400-2 OEE

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology type of the vehicle being produced (ICE – Internal Combustion Engine, HEV – Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV – Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, BEV – Battery Electric Vehicle, FCEV – Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives process routing differences and regulatory compliance checks.
attributes.references: SAE J1715 – Hybrid Vehicle Terminology; EPA Emissions Standards

attributes.name: process_step_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific manufacturing process step (e.g., STAMP-001, BODY-WELD-045, PAINT-CURE-010, ASSY-TORQUE-120) within the routing. Aligns with the source system operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing; IATF 16949 Process Control

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific production line (e.g., BODY-LINE-1, PAINT-LINE-A, FINAL-ASSY-2) where the event occurred. Supports line-level throughput and OEE analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Line; Apriso MES

attributes.name: program_number
attributes.description: Version-controlled program number loaded on the PLC or robot controller at the time of this event. Critical for traceability of process parameter changes and engineering change management.
attributes.references: IEC 61131 – PLC Programming; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Engineering Change

attributes.name: quality_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the quality check associated with this event. Determines whether the vehicle unit proceeds to the next station, requires rework, or is scrapped. Feeds into IATF 16949 quality records and PPM reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Quality Gate; APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning)

attributes.name: rework_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of rework attempts for this vehicle unit at this station. A value greater than 1 indicates repeated failures and triggers escalation per IATF 16949 nonconforming product procedures.

attributes.name: scrap_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for scrapping a component or vehicle unit at this event. Populated only when quality_result is 'scrap'. Feeds into the source system cost reporting and IATF 16949 quality records.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Scrap Management; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Production sequence number assigned to the vehicle unit in the JIS (Just-in-Sequence) build schedule. Used to validate correct part delivery sequencing and detect sequence deviations.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – JIS Sequencing; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: station_code
attributes.description: Unique code of the specific work station or assembly point within the production line where the event was triggered. Enables station-level cycle time and downtime analysis.

attributes.name: station_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the work station (e.g., 'Underbody Weld Station 3', 'E-Coat Oven Exit', 'Engine Dress Final'). Used in operator dashboards and quality reports.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this shop floor event record in the Silver layer (e.g., when quality result or hold status was updated post-event). Supports change data capture and audit compliance.

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Upper statistical process control limit for the measured value at this station. Used in SPC (Statistical Process Control) to detect process drift and trigger quality holds.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – SPC; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal code identifying the vehicle model or platform being assembled (e.g., F-150, RAV4, Model-3-LR). Enables model-mix production analysis and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Material Master; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: vin_number
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number of the vehicle unit being processed. Denormalized here for direct event-level traceability without requiring a join. Conforms to ISO 3779 and NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; ISO 3779 – VIN Structure

products.name: wip_inventory
products.description: Snapshot and movement record for Work-in-Progress (WIP) inventory on the shop floor. Tracks WIP item identity, associated VIN or sub-assembly ID, current location (work center, buffer zone, AGV carrier), quantity, WIP status (in-process, on-hold, awaiting inspection, scrapped), entry and exit timestamps per location, and production order reference. Supports real-time WIP visibility and JIT material flow management. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
products.reference: SAP PP WIP / Apriso MES WIP Tracking

attributes.name: wip_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each WIP inventory snapshot or movement record on the shop floor. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: WIP valuation and inventory accounting require a direct FK to the finance cost center for accurate period‑end reporting.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_shipment. Business justification: WIP traceability requires linking inventory records to the inbound shipment that delivered the parts, supporting recall and quality investigations.
