attributes.description: the source system identifying the specific manufacturing facility where this mBOM is used for production (e.g., 'P001' for Detroit Assembly, 'P002' for Osaka Plant). Determines plant-specific routing, work centers, and local regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM – Plant Master; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology for which this BOM is defined. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Determines applicable emissions regulations (EPA, CARB, WLTP) and BOM component sets.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; CAFE Standards; SAE J1711

attributes.name: ppap_status
attributes.description: Status of the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) for the components in this BOM. PPAP is the AIAG/IATF 16949 process that verifies supplier components meet design and specification requirements before production launch. 'approved' is required before the BOM can be released to production.
attributes.references: AIAG PPAP 4th Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1; SAP QM – Quality Notifications

attributes.name: predecessor_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the previous manufacturing BOM version that this BOM supersedes. Enables backward navigation in the BOM version chain for change impact analysis and quality investigations. Null for the initial BOM version.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific production line or assembly line within the plant for which this BOM is configured (e.g., 'LINE-A', 'TRIM-CHASSIS-1'). Used in Apriso/Dassault MES for shop floor routing and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shop Floor Execution; SAP PP Work Center; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: regulatory_market_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the target regulatory market for which this BOM is homologated (e.g., 'US-FEDERAL', 'US-CARB', 'EU-EURO6', 'JP-JC08', 'CN-CHINA6'). Determines applicable emissions standards (EPA, CARB, Euro 6, WLTP), safety regulations (NHTSA FMVSS, UNECE), and CAFE compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR – FMVSS; EPA 40 CFR Part 86; CARB Title 13; Euro NCAP; UNECE WP.29; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manufacturing BOM was formally released to production (status changed to 'released'). Marks the point at which the BOM is authorized for use in production orders and MRP planning. Corresponds to the the source system date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Release; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; APQP Phase 4

attributes.name: released_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the manufacturing engineer or release authority who formally released this BOM to production in the source system Teamcenter PLM. Required for audit trail and change control compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP PP Authorization; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Alphanumeric revision level of the BOM (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C' or '01', '02'). Used in conjunction with bom_version to track incremental changes within a version. Aligns with the source system level and Teamcenter PLM revision management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Revision; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: the source system linking this manufacturing BOM to the associated production routing (sequence of operations, work centers, and standard times). The BOM and routing together define the complete manufacturing recipe for the vehicle. Corresponds to the source system header (CA01).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing (CA01/CA02); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle program associated with this BOM. Marks the milestone when serial production begins using this BOM configuration. Critical for program management, supplier readiness, and PPAP completion tracking.
attributes.references: APQP Phase 4 – Product and Process Validation; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3; SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: superseded_by_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the newer manufacturing BOM that has replaced this one (populated when bom_status = 'superseded'). Enables forward navigation in the BOM version chain for traceability and historical analysis. Null when this is the current active BOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: vehicle_configuration_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific vehicle configuration (variant) for which this BOM is defined, including body style, drivetrain, trim level, and market variant (e.g., 'SUV-AWD-PREMIUM-NA'). Used in the source system (VC) to select the correct BOM components for a specific vehicle order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Variant Configuration; Dassault ENOVIA Configuration Management; IATF 16949

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM code identifying the vehicle model (nameplate) for which this mBOM is defined (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL3'). Used to associate the BOM with the correct vehicle program in PLM and the source system.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Structure; SAP PP Material Master

products.name: manufacturing_bom_component
products.description: Reference to SSOT owner engineering.engineering_bom_component. Line-item record within a manufacturing BOM representing a single component or sub-assembly required to build a vehicle. Captures component part number, description, quantity per vehicle, unit of measure, installation work center, installation sequence, alternative part references, effectivity start/end dates, and scrap factor. Supports JIT/JIS material call-offs and shop floor assembly instructions. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
products.reference: SAP PP BOM Item / Teamcenter BOM Line

attributes.name: manufacturing_bom_component_id
attributes.description: Primary key for local manufacturing_bom_component reference

attributes.name: engineering_bom_component_id
attributes.description: FK reference to SSOT engineering.engineering_bom_component

products.name: material_consumption
products.description: Transactional record capturing actual material consumption (goods issue) against a production order on the shop floor. Tracks consumed part number, quantity consumed, unit of measure, consumption timestamp, work center, production order reference, storage location, batch number, and variance from planned BOM quantity. Feeds the source system movement and cost accounting for production variance reporting. [preservation_guardrail: verified]

attributes.name: material_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each material consumption (goods issue) transaction record on the shop floor. Primary key of this table.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – Goods Movement

attributes.name: confirmed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the shop floor operator or MES user who confirmed or posted the material consumption. Used for accountability, audit trail, and operator-level quality traceability per IATF 16949.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – User (USNAM); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2; SuccessFactors

attributes.name: inbound_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_part. Business justification: Material consumption reports must reference the specific inbound part receipt to calculate usage rates and supplier performance metrics.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the material consumption occurred. Aligns with the source system for plant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Plant Organizational Unit

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order against which this material was consumed. Links consumption to the manufacturing work order in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – Production Order

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the consumed part or component. Corresponds to the the source system (MM) object.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location (bin, supermarket, line-side buffer) from which the material was issued for consumption.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (assembly station, stamping cell, paint booth, etc.) on the shop floor where the material was consumed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: assembly_station_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific assembly station or line position (JIS – Just-in-Sequence station) where the material was consumed. More granular than work center; used for shop floor traceability.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Supplier or internal batch/lot number of the consumed material. Critical for traceability, recall management, and IATF 16949 batch traceability requirements. Nullable for non-batch-managed materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Batch Management (CHARG); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: bom_item_number
attributes.description: The BOM line item number identifying the specific component position within the production BOM. Links the consumption record back to the engineering BOM structure in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Item (STPO-POSNR); Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version or revision of the BOM used at the time of consumption. Supports engineering change management and ensures consumption is reconciled against the correct BOM revision.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Version; SAP S/4HANA PP – Alternative BOM

attributes.name: consumption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material consumption record. 'posted' = goods issue confirmed in the source system; 'reversed' = goods issue reversed (movement type 262); 'blocked' = held for quality review; 'pending' = awaiting MES confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Goods Movement Status; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: consumption_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the material was physically issued from stock and consumed at the work center on the shop floor. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Posting Date/Time; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the consumption variance (actual cost minus planned cost) in plant currency. Positive = cost overrun; negative = cost saving. Key metric for production cost variance reporting in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Production Variance (KKBC_ORD); IATF 16949

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this material consumption record was first created in the source system (the source system MES). Audit trail field for data lineage and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Creation Timestamp; IATF 16949 Record Retention

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the material cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Supports multi-currency manufacturing operations across global plants.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 – Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: goods_movement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible the source system number generated when the goods issue (movement type 261) is posted. Serves as the business-facing transaction identifier traceable in the source system

attributes.name: goods_movement_type
attributes.description: the source system code indicating the nature of the goods movement (e.g., 261 = goods issue to production order, 262 = reversal, 291 = goods issue to cost center). Drives inventory and cost accounting postings.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this material consumption record in the source system. Used for incremental data load detection and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Change Timestamp; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: material_cost_amount
attributes.description: Standard cost value of the consumed material quantity at the time of goods issue, expressed in the plant currency. Calculated as quantity consumed × standard price from the source system Feeds production cost accounting and variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Standard Cost; FI Goods Issue Valuation

attributes.name: mes_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the Apriso/Dassault MES system that triggered or confirmed this material consumption event. Enables cross-system reconciliation between MES shop floor execution and the source system movements.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Transaction ID; SAP S/4HANA MM Integration

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The model year (MY) of the vehicle being assembled (e.g., '2025'). Used for model-year-level consumption analysis, BOM alignment, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Model Year; NHTSA MY Definition

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: The routing operation number within the production order at which the material was consumed (e.g., operation 0010 = body shop, 0020 = paint, 0030 = final assembly). Enables process-step-level consumption analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing Operation (VORNR); Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: original_goods_movement_number
attributes.description: Reference to the original the source system number that this record reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Enables audit trail for reversed consumption transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Reversal Reference Document

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity of this material as specified in the Bill of Materials (BOM) for the production order. Used to calculate consumption variance against actual quantity consumed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Component Quantity; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting posting date for the goods issue in the source system, which may differ from the physical consumption timestamp. Used for period-end cost accounting and production variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO – Posting Date; IATF 16949

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain type of the vehicle being assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), EV (Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives BOM variant selection and consumption expectations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Configuration; CAFE/EPA Powertrain Classification

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production line (e.g., 'LINE-A', 'TRIM-2', 'PAINT-EAST') where the material was consumed. Used for line-level consumption analysis and capacity planning.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Production Line; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: quality_inspection_lot
attributes.description: the source system lot number associated with the consumed material batch, if the material is subject to incoming or in-process quality inspection. Links consumption to quality results for IATF 16949 traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM – Inspection Lot (QMEL); IATF 16949 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: quantity_consumed
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the material consumed (goods issued) against the production order. Expressed in the base unit of measure of the material. Core quantitative fact for this transaction.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: Difference between actual quantity consumed and planned BOM quantity (actual minus planned). Positive value indicates over-consumption; negative indicates under-consumption. Key input for production variance reporting and cost accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Production Variance; IATF 16949 SPC

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this consumption record is a reversal (cancellation) of a previously posted goods issue. True = this is a reversal document; False = original consumption posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Reversal Document (STORNO); Goods Movement

attributes.name: scrap_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the consumed material was scrapped (True) rather than incorporated into the vehicle assembly. Scrap consumption is tracked separately for waste reporting, IATF 16949 scrap analysis, and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scrap; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; ISO 14001

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for material scrap when scrap_indicator is True (e.g., 'DAMAGE', 'DEFECT', 'WRONG_PART', 'PROCESS_LOSS'). Used for scrap root cause analysis and PPM defect rate reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAMAGE|DEFECT|WRONG_PART|PROCESS_LOSS|HANDLING_ERROR|SUPPLIER_DEFECT|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scrap Reason; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; FMEA

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Individual serial number of the consumed component where serial number management is active (e.g., ECU, battery module, transmission). Enables unit-level traceability for safety-critical parts. Nullable for non-serialized materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Serial Number Management; NHTSA Traceability Requirements

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Production shift during which the material was consumed (DAY, AFTERNOON, NIGHT). Used for shift-level consumption analysis, variance trending, and workforce productivity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this consumption record originated (the source system S/4HANA MM goods movement, MES_APRISO = Apriso/Dassault MES, the source system Production Planning, MANUAL = manual entry). Supports data lineage in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer – Data Lineage; SAP S/4HANA Integration

attributes.name: supplier_number
attributes.description: the source system of the supplier who provided the consumed material. Used for supplier-level consumption analysis, PPAP traceability, and supply chain variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Vendor Master (LFA1); IATF 16949 Supplier Management

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the consumed quantity (e.g., EA = each, KG = kilogram, L = litre, M = metre, PC = piece). Aligns with the source system from Material Master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|PC|SET|ROL|BOX — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); ISO 80000

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Quantity variance expressed as a percentage of the planned BOM quantity ((actual - planned) / planned × 100). Used for threshold-based alerting and PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Variance Analysis; IATF 16949

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM code identifying the vehicle model or platform being assembled (e.g., 'F150', 'CAMRY-HEV', 'SILVERADO-EV'). Used for model-level consumption aggregation and BOM variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Material (Finished Vehicle); Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: vehicle_vin
attributes.description: The 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) of the vehicle being assembled when the material was consumed. Enables vehicle-level build traceability and recall management. Nullable for non-vehicle-specific consumption (e.g., consumables).
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN Standard; ISO 3779; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: wip_order_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential position of this consumption event within the production order's WIP (Work in Progress) processing sequence. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) ordering analysis and shop floor flow traceability.

products.name: rework_order
products.description: Transactional record for rework or repair operations initiated on a vehicle or sub-assembly that failed an in-process quality check. Captures rework order number, originating production order, VIN reference, defect description, rework type (in-line repair, offline rework, teardown), assigned work center, planned and actual rework hours, rework status, and disposition (repaired, scrapped, concession). Integrates with quality domain defect records. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
products.reference: Apriso MES Rework / SAP QM Rework Order

attributes.name: rework_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the rework order record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7 - Control of Nonconforming Outputs

attributes.name: defect_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality defect record in the quality domain that triggered this rework order. Links rework traceability to the originating inspection finding or defect notification.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Defect Record

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce employee or technician assigned to perform the rework operation. Links to the workforce domain for skill and certification validation.
attributes.references: SAP HR / SuccessFactors Employee Record; IATF 16949 Section 7.2

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the rework operation is being executed. Aligns with the source system organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure; IATF 16949 Section 4.1

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating production order from which this rework order was raised. Links the rework event back to the scheduled manufacturing work order in the source system MES.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Order; IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or repair station assigned to execute the rework operation. Corresponds to the source system Center or MES work station definition.
attributes.references: SAP PP Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES Work Station

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the rework operation was completed and the unit was released for re-inspection or returned to the production line. Recorded by MES upon order closure.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Time Tracking; SAP PM Order Confirmation

attributes.name: actual_rework_hours
attributes.description: Actual labor hours consumed to complete the rework operation, recorded upon order completion in MES or the source system against planned hours for efficiency analysis and cost variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PM Actual Costs; Apriso/Dassault MES Time Tracking; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the rework technician began executing the rework operation, as recorded by MES shop floor data collection or operator confirmation.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Time Tracking; SAP PM Order Confirmation

attributes.name: assembly_stage_code
attributes.description: Code representing the specific assembly stage or station within the production line where the nonconformance was detected (e.g., body framing, paint primer, trim line, chassis marriage). Supports JIS (Just-in-Sequence) traceability.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Station Configuration; IATF 16949 Section 8.5.2

attributes.name: bom_component_number
attributes.description: The BOM (Bill of Materials) component or part number of the specific sub-assembly or component requiring rework. References the engineering BOM managed in Siemens Teamcenter or the source system
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management; SAP MM Material Master; IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1

attributes.name: corrective_action_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the corrective action (CAR) or 8D problem-solving report raised in response to this rework event. Links the rework order to the formal quality improvement process.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2.1 - Corrective Action; SAP QM Corrective Action; APQP 8D Report

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rework order record was first created in the source system (MES or the source system trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 7.5 - Documented Information; ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary cost fields on this rework order (rework_labor_cost, rework_material_cost). Typically the plant's local operating currency (e.g., USD, EUR, MXN).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: defect_code
attributes.description: Standardized defect classification code identifying the type of nonconformance that triggered the rework order. Aligns with the plant defect code catalogue maintained in the source system MES quality module.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Defect Code Catalogue

attributes.name: defect_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the defect or nonconformance identified during in-process quality inspection that initiated this rework order. Captured by the quality inspector or MES operator.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Notification Long Text

attributes.name: defect_location_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the physical location or zone on the vehicle or sub-assembly where the defect was found (e.g., body zone, paint zone, chassis area). Used for spatial defect analysis and NVH (Noise Vibration Harshness) correlation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; Euro NCAP Defect Zone Classification

attributes.name: detection_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the method by which the defect was detected prior to rework order creation (e.g., visual inspection, automated gauge check, functional test, quality audit, customer feedback). Supports FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) detection ranking analysis.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6; FMEA Detection Ranking; SAP QM Inspection Method

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the nonconformance was originally detected during in-process quality inspection, triggering the creation of this rework order. The principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6; SAP QM Inspection Lot Creation Date; Apriso MES Quality Event

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the nonconforming unit after rework evaluation. Repaired indicates successful correction; scrapped indicates the unit is unrecoverable; concession (use-as-is) indicates acceptance of the nonconformance with documented deviation; return to supplier applies to purchased components.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7.1 - Disposition of Nonconforming Product; ISO 9001:2015 Section 8.7

attributes.name: inspection_point_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific quality inspection checkpoint or gate (e.g., body-in-white audit, paint final audit, end-of-line check) at which the defect was detected and the rework order was initiated.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6; SAP QM Inspection Lot; Apriso MES Quality Gate

attributes.name: is_regulatory_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle or sub-assembly is placed on a regulatory hold pending rework completion and re-inspection. A regulatory hold prevents the unit from advancing to the next production stage or shipping.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 573; CARB Compliance; DOT FMVSS; IATF 16949 Section 8.7

attributes.name: is_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the defect triggering this rework order is classified as safety-critical, requiring escalation per NHTSA, DOT, or internal safety reporting protocols. Safety-related rework orders may trigger FMEA review and potential field action assessment.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 573 - Defect and Noncompliance Reports; DOT FMVSS; IATF 16949 Section 9.1.3

attributes.name: line_stoppage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rework event caused a production line stoppage (Andon pull or line stop). Used for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) impact analysis and production downtime reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1; Apriso/Dassault MES Andon Event; SAP PP Downtime Recording

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) of the unit undergoing rework. Used for regulatory compliance reporting, warranty analysis, and production quality trending by model year.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAP PP Production Version

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the rework operation is planned to be completed. Used to calculate planned rework cycle time and assess impact on downstream production sequencing.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Scheduling; SAP PP Scheduling

attributes.name: planned_rework_hours
attributes.description: Estimated labor hours planned to complete the rework operation, as defined in the rework routing or standard repair time (SRT) catalogue. Used for capacity planning and cost estimation.
attributes.references: SAP PP Routing Standard Values; IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the rework operation is planned to begin, as determined by the MES scheduler or production planner. Used for shop floor capacity planning and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Scheduling; SAP PP Scheduling

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the rework order to drive scheduling and resource allocation on the shop floor. Critical priority typically indicates a safety-related or regulatory nonconformance requiring immediate resolution.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Notification Priority

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific production line (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, final assembly) where the defect was originally detected and the rework order was raised.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Production Line Configuration; SAP PP Work Center Hierarchy

attributes.name: re_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal re-inspection is required after rework completion before the unit can be released to the next production stage or shipped. Mandatory for safety-related or regulatory nonconformances.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7.1; SAP QM Re-Inspection Trigger

attributes.name: re_inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the quality re-inspection performed after rework completion. Pass indicates the unit meets specification; fail triggers a secondary rework or scrap decision; conditional pass indicates acceptance with documented deviation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6; SAP QM Usage Decision; Apriso MES Quality Gate Result

attributes.name: rework_attempt_count
attributes.description: Number of rework attempts made on this unit or component for the same defect. Multiple rework attempts on the same unit indicate a chronic quality issue and may trigger escalation or scrap decision per quality policy.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7.1; SAP QM Notification Recurrence

attributes.name: rework_instruction_reference
attributes.description: Document number or reference to the approved rework instruction, repair standard, or Technical Service Bulletin (TSB) that governs the rework procedure. Ensures traceability to authorized repair methods.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1; SAP DMS Document Reference; Siemens Teamcenter Document Management

attributes.name: rework_labor_cost
attributes.description: Total internal labor cost incurred for the rework operation, calculated from actual rework hours and the applicable labor rate. Expressed in the plant's operating currency. Used for quality cost (Cost of Poor Quality - COPQ) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Object Controlling; IATF 16949 Section 9.1; APQP Cost of Poor Quality

attributes.name: rework_material_cost
attributes.description: Cost of replacement parts and materials consumed during the rework operation. Sourced from the source system issue postings against the rework order. Contributes to total Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) calculation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Issue; SAP CO Cost Object; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: rework_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the rework order, typically generated by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or the source system Format: RWK-{PlantCode}-{Year}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Notification Number

attributes.name: rework_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rework order within the shop floor execution workflow. Tracks progression from creation through completion or cancellation as managed in MES or the source system
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; Apriso/Dassault MES Order Status

attributes.name: rework_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rework operation method. Inline repair is performed on the moving assembly line; offline rework removes the unit from the line; teardown involves partial or full disassembly; subassembly rework targets a component before vehicle integration; cosmetic repair addresses surface or finish defects. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inline_repair|offline_rework|teardown|subassembly_rework|cosmetic_repair|field_return_rework — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7.1; APQP Phase 4 - Product and Process Validation

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the root cause of the defect as determined through root cause analysis (e.g., 5-Why, Ishikawa). Populated upon rework completion. Supports FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and SPC (Statistical Process Control) improvement actions.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2; FMEA Methodology; SAP QM Cause Code

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Number of components or sub-assemblies scrapped as a result of this rework order where repair was not feasible. Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation and scrap cost reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP PP Scrap Posting; PPM Defect Rate Reporting

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this rework order record was sourced (e.g., the source system MES, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer ingestion traceability.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance - Data Lineage Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Conventions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rework order record was last modified in the source system. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 7.5 - Documented Information; ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.5

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal product/model code identifying the vehicle nameplate or platform (e.g., truck, SUV, EV, HEV) associated with the rework order. Aligns with PLM product structure in Siemens Teamcenter.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Product Structure; SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) of the vehicle or vehicle body on which rework is being performed. Nullable for sub-assembly rework not yet associated with a VIN. Conforms to ISO 3779 standard.
attributes.references: ISO 3779 - Vehicle Identification Number; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565

products.name: production_confirmation
products.description: Transactional record confirming the completion of a production order or a partial operation within a production order. Captures confirmation number, production order reference, confirmed quantity (yield and scrap), actual activity times (setup, machine, labor), confirmation timestamp, shift, work center, and operator. Triggers the source system settlement and inventory goods receipt. SSOT for actual production output reporting. [preservation_guardrail: verified]

attributes.name: production_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the production confirmation record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity. Entity Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete business event (completion of a production order or partial operation) with a clear lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — CO11N/CO15 Confirmation Object

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this production confirmation was posted. Enables plant-level production output reporting, capacity utilization analysis, and multi-plant benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Plant (WERKS); ISO 14001 Facility Identification

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production operator (employee/personnel number) who posted or was responsible for this confirmation. Used for traceability, quality accountability, and workforce productivity analysis. Maps to the source system number (PERNR) or MES operator badge ID.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Personnel Number (PERNR); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability; SuccessFactors Employee Record

attributes.name: production_operator_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production operator (employee/personnel number) who posted or was responsible for this confirmation. Used for traceability, quality accountability, and workforce productivity analysis. Maps to the source system number (PERNR) or MES operator badge ID.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Personnel Number (PERNR); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability; SuccessFactors Employee Record

attributes.name: reversed_confirmation_production_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original production confirmation record that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Enables audit trail reconstruction and net quantity calculation when reversals are present. Self-referencing within the production_confirmation product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO13 Reversal Reference; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this confirmation was recorded. Enables shift-level production output analysis, yield comparison across shifts, and workforce productivity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift (SCHICHT); Apriso MES Shift Management

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (the source system the confirmed operation was executed. Work centers represent physical production resources such as stamping presses, welding stations, paint booths, or assembly lines. Used for capacity reporting and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center (ARBPL); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3 Infrastructure

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: the source system type (LSTAR) used to record the confirmed actual activities (setup, machine, labor) against the production order. Drives cost settlement rates and actual cost calculation in the source system Costing). Required for standard vs. actual cost variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC — Activity Type (LSTAR); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.3

attributes.name: assembly_stage
attributes.description: The manufacturing assembly stage at which this confirmation was recorded. Reflects the major production process area within the vehicle manufacturing flow. Used for stage-level throughput analysis, WIP (Work in Progress) tracking, and process bottleneck identification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint|final_assembly|powertrain|chassis|trim — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Stage; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 Production Control Plan

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which yield, scrap, and rework quantities are expressed. Typically 'EA' (Each) for vehicles and assemblies, 'PC' (Piece) for components, 'KG' for weight-based materials. Maps to the source system unit of measure (MEINS). Required for correct inventory posting and quantity reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|L|M|SET|VH — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: the source system (CHARG) assigned to the confirmed production output. Used for batch-managed materials to enable full forward and backward traceability of components and finished vehicles. Critical for recall management, warranty analysis, and regulatory compliance with NHTSA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP — Batch Number (CHARG); NHTSA 49 CFR Part 573 Recall Traceability; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: confirmation_entry_mode
attributes.description: Method by which this production confirmation was entered into the source system = entered by operator via CO11N; 'automatic' = system-generated via PP-PI or SCADA integration; 'mes_interface' = posted via Apriso/Dassault MES interface; 'backflush' = automatic backflush confirmation triggered by goods issue. Used for data quality auditing and process automation tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Confirmation Entry Mode; Apriso MES Integration; SCADA Interface

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric confirmation number assigned by the source system at the time of posting. This is the business-facing identifier used in shop floor reporting, MES integration, and order settlement reconciliation. Maps to the source system (Confirmation Number).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO11N Confirmation Number (RUECK); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production confirmation record. 'created' = confirmation entered but not yet posted; 'posted' = successfully posted to the source system inventory updated; 'reversed' = confirmation reversed via CO13; 'cancelled' = voided before posting; 'partial' = partial quantity confirmed, order still open; 'final' = final confirmation closing the production order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Confirmation Status (CO11N/CO13); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp recording when the production operation or order was confirmed as complete on the shop floor. This is the business event time (not the system posting time) and represents the actual completion moment. Maps to the source system BUDAT (posting date) + ISDD/ISDZ (actual execution date/time). Used for takt time analysis, shift output reporting, and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO11N Actual Execution Timestamp (ISDD/ISDZ); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: confirmation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the confirmation indicating whether it is a partial confirmation (interim progress), final confirmation (order completion), automatic system-generated confirmation, milestone-based confirmation, or a reversal entry. Determines downstream the source system logic including order closure and goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Confirmation Category (STOKZ); Apriso MES Confirmation Type

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: the source system center (KOSTL) associated with the work center where this confirmation was posted. Used for actual cost allocation, activity-based costing, and manufacturing cost variance reporting. Enables EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization) analysis at the plant and cost center level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Center (KOSTL); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.3 Management Review

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this production confirmation record was first created in the source system (the source system MES). Represents the system audit creation time, distinct from the confirmation_timestamp (business event time). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of confirmation posting latency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Record Creation Timestamp; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 Documented Information

attributes.name: downtime_duration_min
attributes.description: Total unplanned downtime duration recorded during this production confirmation period, in minutes. Captured from SCADA/PLC systems or MES downtime tracking. Used for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) availability calculation, maintenance planning, and production loss analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Downtime Tracking; SCADA Integration; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: downtime_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for any downtime recorded during this confirmation period. Maps to the plant's downtime reason catalog (e.g., 'MECH' = Mechanical Failure, 'MATL' = Material Shortage, 'QUAL' = Quality Hold, 'CHNG' = Changeover). Used for root cause analysis, maintenance prioritization, and production loss reporting.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Downtime Reason Catalog; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3; SAP PM Integration

attributes.name: final_confirmation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this confirmation is the final confirmation for the production order (the source system — Final Confirmation Indicator). When True, the source system closes the production order, triggers goods receipt for the finished product, and initiates order settlement to CO (Controlling). Critical for order lifecycle management and inventory accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Final Confirmation Indicator (IEDD); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: goods_receipt_posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the automatic goods receipt (GR) to inventory has been successfully posted as a result of this production confirmation. True = inventory has been updated with the confirmed yield quantity. Used for inventory reconciliation and to identify confirmations where GR posting failed or is pending.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM — Goods Receipt (MIGO/MB31); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: labor_time_actual_min
attributes.description: Actual direct labor time consumed for this production operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to the source system type for labor (ISRLA — Actual Labor Time). Used for labor cost settlement to the production order, workforce productivity analysis, and standard vs. actual cost variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Actual Labor Time (ISRLA); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2 People

attributes.name: labor_time_planned_min
attributes.description: Planned direct labor time for this operation as defined in the the source system recorded in minutes. Baseline for labor efficiency variance analysis and standard cost calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Routing Planned Labor Time; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this production confirmation record was last modified in the source system. Tracks reversals, corrections, and status updates. Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and change data capture (CDC) processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Record Change Timestamp; Databricks Delta Lake CDC; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: machine_time_actual_min
attributes.description: Actual machine runtime consumed for this production operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to the source system type for machine time (ISRÜT — Actual Machine Time). Core input for OEE calculation, takt time variance analysis, and capacity utilization reporting. Compared against planned machine time from the routing to identify bottlenecks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Actual Machine Time (ISRÜT); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3; OEE Standard

attributes.name: machine_time_planned_min
attributes.description: Planned machine time for this operation as defined in the the source system recorded in minutes. Baseline for actual vs. planned machine time variance analysis and takt time adherence reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Planned Machine Time; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: the source system (MATNR) of the finished or semi-finished product being confirmed. Identifies the vehicle model, sub-assembly, or component produced in this confirmation. Essential for inventory goods receipt posting and BOM (Bill of Materials) reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP — Material Master (MATNR); ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: mes_confirmation_reference
attributes.description: The confirmation or transaction reference number from the Apriso/Dassault MES system that corresponds to this the source system confirmation. Enables cross-system traceability between the MES shop floor execution record and the the source system posting. Critical for audit trails and discrepancy resolution.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution Traceability; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) of the product being confirmed. Used for production output reporting by model year, regulatory compliance tracking (CAFE, EPA emissions), and alignment with SOP (Start of Production) and EOP (End of Production) milestones. Retained as a denormalized attribute for direct reporting without joining to vehicle configuration.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — Model Year; CAFE Standards; EPA Emissions Reporting

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: Routing operation number (VORNR) within the production order being confirmed. Identifies the specific manufacturing step (e.g., 0010 = Stamping, 0020 = Body Weld, 0030 = Paint, 0040 = Final Assembly) for partial confirmation scenarios. Maps to the source system operation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Operation (VORNR); Apriso/Dassault MES Operation Sequence

attributes.name: order_settlement_status
attributes.description: Status of the the source system order settlement triggered by this final confirmation. 'pending' = settlement not yet executed; 'settled' = actual costs fully settled to cost objects; 'partially_settled' = partial settlement completed; 'not_required' = non-final confirmation, settlement not applicable. Used for period-end closing and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC — Order Settlement (KO88); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.3

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting/inventory posting date (the source system which the production confirmation is financially posted. May differ from the confirmation timestamp when confirmations are entered retroactively. Drives inventory valuation, cost object settlement, and financial period assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Posting Date (BUDAT); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: The powertrain technology type of the vehicle or assembly being confirmed. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Used for regulatory reporting (CAFE, EPA, CARB), EV production mix analysis, and R&D investment tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act — Powertrain Classification; CARB ZEV Mandate; CAFE Standards; UNECE Regulations

attributes.name: production_order_number
attributes.description: the source system order number (AUFNR) to which this confirmation is posted. Links the confirmation to the originating manufacturing order for order settlement, cost collection, and goods receipt triggering. Retained as a business attribute for direct shop floor reporting without requiring a join.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Order (AUFNR); ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: quality_inspection_lot
attributes.description: the source system lot number (PRUEFLOS) created automatically upon goods receipt posting from this confirmation. Links the production output to the quality inspection record for in-process and final inspection results. Used for quality traceability and IATF 16949 inspection record management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Lot (PRUEFLOS); IATF 16949 Clause 8.6 Release of Products

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this confirmation record is a reversal entry (CO13 reversal in the source system = this record reverses a previously posted confirmation. Used to identify correction entries in production output reporting and to exclude reversed confirmations from yield and time aggregations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO13 Confirmation Reversal (STOKZ); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units requiring rework (reprocessing to meet specification) identified during this confirmation. Distinct from scrap (which is permanently rejected). Used for quality cost analysis, rework labor tracking, and process capability assessment per APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Rework Quantity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7.1; APQP

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units scrapped (rejected as non-conforming) during this production operation. Maps to the source system XMNGA (Scrap Quantity). Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation, scrap cost reporting, and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) input. Triggers quality notification creation when thresholds are exceeded.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/QM — Scrap Quantity (XMNGA); IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 Nonconforming Outputs; SPC

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for scrap recorded against this confirmation. Maps to the source system codes or MES scrap reason catalog (e.g., 'DIM' = Dimensional Non-conformance, 'WLD' = Weld Defect, 'PNT' = Paint Defect, 'ASY' = Assembly Error). Required for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect analysis, FMEA updates, and quality improvement initiatives per IATF 16949.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Defect Code (FEHLERNR); IATF 16949 Clause 8.7.1; APQP Control Plan

attributes.name: setup_time_actual_min
attributes.description: Actual machine/workstation setup time consumed for this operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to the source system type for setup (ISRST — Actual Setup Time). Used for capacity planning, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation, and comparison against planned setup time from the routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Actual Setup Time (ISRST); SAE J4000 Lean Manufacturing Assessment

attributes.name: setup_time_planned_min
attributes.description: Planned setup time for this operation as defined in the the source system recorded in minutes. Provides the baseline for actual vs. planned setup time variance analysis. Sourced from the routing master data at the time of production order creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Planned Setup Time; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: the source system (LGORT) to which the confirmed yield quantity is posted as a goods receipt. Identifies the physical inventory location within the plant (e.g., finished goods area, WIP buffer, sequencing area). Required for inventory management and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) delivery coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM — Storage Location (LGORT); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.4 Preservation

attributes.name: takt_time_actual_sec
attributes.description: Actual takt time achieved for this production confirmation, expressed in seconds per unit. Calculated as total operation time divided by yield quantity. Used for production line balancing, bottleneck identification, and comparison against the planned takt time to assess line efficiency. Key metric in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) production management.
attributes.references: SAE J4000 Lean Manufacturing; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; Apriso MES Takt Time Monitoring

attributes.name: teardown_time_actual_min
attributes.description: Actual teardown/cleanup time consumed after the production operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to the source system type for teardown. Included in total operation time for accurate takt time and capacity utilization calculations. Relevant for paint booth cleaning, tooling changeover, and AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) repositioning cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Actual Teardown Time; SAE J4000

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number assigned to the vehicle unit confirmed in this production record. Populated for final assembly confirmations where a specific vehicle unit is produced. Null for sub-assembly or component-level confirmations. Enables full build traceability from production confirmation to vehicle delivery.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — VIN Standard; ISO 3779 Vehicle Identification Number; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: yield_quantity
attributes.description: The confirmed good quantity (yield) produced in this confirmation, expressed in the base unit of measure of the material. Represents the number of units that passed quality inspection and are accepted into inventory. Maps to the source system LMNGA (Yield Quantity). Core metric for production output reporting and OTD (On-Time Delivery) tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Yield Quantity (LMNGA); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.1 Monitoring and Measurement

products.name: manufacturing_tooling_usage
products.description: Transactional record tracking the usage of production tooling (dies, fixtures, jigs, welding guns, torque tools) against specific production orders and work centers. Captures tool ID, tool type, usage start and end timestamps, production order reference, work center, stroke count or cycle count, cumulative usage against tool life limit, and tool condition at usage. Supports predictive tooling maintenance and PPAP tooling traceability. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
products.reference: SAP PM Tool Management / Apriso MES Tooling

attributes.name: manufacturing_tooling_usage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the manufacturing_tooling_usage data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: add column production_order_id (BIGINT) with FK to manufacturing.production_order.production_order_id - tooling usage occurs during specific production orders

attributes.name: tooling_registry_id
attributes.description: add column tooling_registry_id (BIGINT) with FK to asset.tooling_registry.tooling_registry_id - manufacturing tooling usage must reference the specific tool from the asset registry

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: FK to manufacturing.work_center

products.name: process_parameter
products.description: Transactional record capturing actual process parameter readings collected from PLC/SCADA systems during manufacturing operations. Includes parameter type (weld current, weld time, torque value, paint film thickness, oven temperature, press force, adhesive bead width), measured value, upper and lower control limits (UCL/LCL), pass/fail status, timestamp, work center, production order, and VIN reference. Supports SPC (Statistical Process Control) and IATF 16949 process monitoring requirements. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
products.reference: SCADA/PLC Process Data / SPC Parameter Record

attributes.name: process_parameter_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each process parameter reading record captured from PLC/SCADA systems during manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production and Service Provision

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this process parameter reading was collected.

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the operator or technician responsible for the work center at the time of this parameter reading. Used for operator-level quality analysis and IATF 16949 traceability requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.2 — Identification and Traceability; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: primary_equipment_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific machine, robot, or tooling equipment that performed the operation and generated this parameter reading (e.g., welding gun ID, torque wrench serial, press machine ID). Supports equipment-level SPC and predictive maintenance analysis.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PM — Equipment Master

attributes.name: process_equipment_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific machine, robot, or tooling equipment that performed the operation and generated this parameter reading (e.g., welding gun ID, torque wrench serial, press machine ID). Supports equipment-level SPC and predictive maintenance analysis.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PM — Equipment Master

attributes.name: process_operator_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the operator or technician responsible for the work center at the time of this parameter reading. Used for operator-level quality analysis and IATF 16949 traceability requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.2 — Identification and Traceability; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: process_tool_tooling_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific tool or fixture used during the operation (e.g., torque bit ID, weld electrode ID, press die ID). Distinct from equipment_id; a single machine may use multiple interchangeable tools.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PM — Tool Management

attributes.name: process_tooling_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific tool or fixture used during the operation (e.g., torque bit ID, weld electrode ID, press die ID). Distinct from equipment_id; a single machine may use multiple interchangeable tools.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PM — Tool Management

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order (the source system order) under which this process parameter reading was captured.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Production Order

attributes.name: vehicle_build_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle build record associated with this process parameter reading, enabling full build traceability per VIN.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (the source system center / Apriso MES station) where the process parameter was measured.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: assembly_stage
attributes.description: Manufacturing assembly stage during which this process parameter was captured. Aligns with the major shop areas: stamping, body shop, paint, trim, chassis, final assembly, or powertrain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint|trim|chassis|final_assembly|powertrain — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; Apriso/Dassault MES Shop Floor Execution

attributes.name: control_plan_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the APQP Control Plan that defines the monitoring requirements, specification limits, and reaction plan for this process parameter. Links process execution to the approved quality plan.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual — Control Plan

attributes.name: control_plan_revision
attributes.description: Revision level of the control plan in effect at the time of this parameter reading. Ensures traceability to the correct engineering specification version.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Engineering Change

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Method by which this process parameter reading was collected: 'automatic' = fully automated PLC/SCADA capture with no operator intervention; 'semi_automatic' = automated measurement with operator confirmation; 'manual' = operator-entered value.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; Apriso/Dassault MES — Data Collection

attributes.name: deviation_from_nominal
attributes.description: Calculated difference between the measured value and the nominal (target) value (measured_value minus nominal_value). Positive values indicate above-nominal readings; negative values indicate below-nominal. Stored as a raw field to support SPC trend analysis without requiring a join.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: gauge_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the measurement instrument or gauge used for this reading is due for recalibration. Readings taken after the calibration due date may be flagged as suspect for quality audit purposes.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.1.5.1 — Measurement System Analysis; ISO 10012 — Measurement Management Systems

attributes.name: is_out_of_control
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reading triggered an SPC out-of-control signal based on Western Electric or Nelson rules applied to the control chart. True = out-of-control signal detected; False = in statistical control. Distinct from pass_fail_status which checks specification limits.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; ISO 7870-2 — Control Charts; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Statistical Lower Control Limit (LCL) for this process parameter as defined by SPC methodology. Readings below this value indicate the process is out of statistical control.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; ISO 7870-2 — Control Charts

attributes.name: lower_spec_limit
attributes.description: Engineering Lower Specification Limit (LSL) for this process parameter as defined in the control plan or engineering drawing. Readings below LSL result in a non-conformance. Distinct from LCL which is a statistical control boundary.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual numeric value of the process parameter as measured by the PLC/SCADA sensor at the time of the reading (e.g., 8500.0 amperes for weld current, 25.5 Nm for torque, 120.0 µm for paint film thickness).
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: measurement_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the measurement system (gauge, sensor, or instrument) used to capture this reading. Supports Measurement System Analysis (MSA) / Gauge R&R traceability per AIAG MSA manual.
attributes.references: AIAG MSA Manual 4th Edition — Measurement System Analysis; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.1.5

attributes.name: mes_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the Apriso/Dassault MES system when this process parameter reading was recorded. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the MES operational system.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution and Traceability

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model Year (MY) of the vehicle being built when this process parameter was captured (e.g., 2025). Supports model-year-level SPC trending and quality reporting.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Order

attributes.name: nominal_value
attributes.description: The engineering-specified nominal or target value for this process parameter as defined in the control plan. Used as the centre line for SPC charting and deviation calculation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

attributes.name: non_conformance_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) raised in the quality management system (the source system this parameter reading resulted in a fail disposition. Null when pass_fail_status is 'pass'.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.7 — Control of Nonconforming Outputs; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the specific process parameter definition (e.g., WELD_CURR_01, TORQUE_BOLT_A, PAINT_FILM_T). Sourced from the PLC/SCADA parameter catalogue in Apriso MES.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAE J4001 — Manufacturing Process Audit

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the process parameter being measured (e.g., 'Weld Current', 'Torque Value', 'Paint Film Thickness', 'Oven Temperature', 'Press Force', 'Adhesive Bead Width').

attributes.name: parameter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the process parameter by its physical or process nature. Drives SPC charting rules and control limit interpretation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weld_current|weld_time|torque|paint_film_thickness|oven_temperature|press_force|adhesive_bead_width|coolant_pressure|cure_time|voltage|current|speed|flow_rate|humidity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Result of the automated conformance check comparing the measured value against the specification limits. 'pass' = within LSL/USL; 'fail' = outside LSL/USL; 'warning' = within spec but outside UCL/LCL (statistically out of control); 'rework_required' = fail with rework disposition; 'inconclusive' = sensor error or missing reference limits.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: plc_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique tag identifier from the Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) or SCADA system that is the source of this parameter reading. Enables traceability back to the originating control system data point.
attributes.references: IEC 61131-3 — PLC Programming Standards; SCADA System Integration

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain type of the vehicle being built: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Certain process parameters (e.g., battery cell compression) are powertrain-specific.
attributes.references: SAE J1715 — Hybrid Electric Vehicle Terminology; IATF 16949:2016

attributes.name: reaction_plan_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control plan reaction plan was triggered as a result of this parameter reading (True = reaction plan activated due to out-of-spec or out-of-control condition). Supports IATF 16949 audit evidence.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual — Control Plan Reaction Plan

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the process parameter value was measured by the PLC/SCADA system. This is the principal business event timestamp for this record, representing the real-world moment of measurement.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this process parameter record was first ingested into the data platform (silver layer). Distinct from reading_timestamp which represents the actual measurement event time.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time Formats; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this process parameter record in the data platform. Used for incremental load tracking and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time Formats; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Sequential sample number within the SPC subgroup or sampling plan for this parameter at this work center. Used to construct X-bar/R charts and other SPC control charts.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: scada_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the SCADA system instance that collected and transmitted this process parameter reading to the MES/data platform.
attributes.references: IEC 62443 — Industrial Automation and Control Systems Security; Apriso/Dassault MES Integration

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System ID

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production shift during which this parameter reading was captured (e.g., 'SHIFT_A', 'SHIFT_B', 'SHIFT_C'). Supports shift-level SPC analysis and quality reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Planning

attributes.name: spc_rule_violated
attributes.description: Identifies the specific SPC detection rule that was violated when is_out_of_control is True (e.g., 'RULE_1_BEYOND_3SIGMA', 'RULE_2_NINE_CONSECUTIVE', 'RULE_3_SIX_TRENDING'). Null when no rule is violated.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition — Western Electric Rules; ISO 7870-2

attributes.name: subgroup_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the SPC rational subgroup to which this reading belongs. Subgroups are used to calculate control limits and assess process variation in X-bar/R or X-bar/S charts.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition — Rational Subgrouping; ISO 7870-2

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Engineering unit of measure for the measured value (e.g., 'A' for amperes, 'Nm' for Newton-metres, 'µm' for micrometres, '°C' for Celsius, 'kN' for kilonewtons, 'mm' for millimetres, 'ms' for milliseconds). Follows SI unit conventions.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-1 — Quantities and Units; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Statistical Upper Control Limit (UCL) for this process parameter as defined by SPC methodology. Readings above this value indicate the process is out of statistical control.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; ISO 7870-2 — Control Charts

attributes.name: upper_spec_limit
attributes.description: Engineering Upper Specification Limit (USL) for this process parameter as defined in the control plan or engineering drawing. Readings above USL result in a non-conformance. Distinct from UCL which is a statistical control boundary.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal vehicle model or platform code for the vehicle being built (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL_3'). Supports model-level process capability analysis and SPC stratification.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Material Master

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) of the vehicle being processed at the time of this parameter reading. Enables full build traceability from process parameter to finished vehicle per NHTSA requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — VIN Requirements; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.2

products.name: agv_movement
products.description: Transactional record capturing Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) movement events on the shop floor. Tracks AGV unit ID, movement type (load, transport, unload, charge, idle), origin location, destination location, carried load (part number, VIN, carrier ID), movement start and end timestamps, route taken, and any fault or exception codes. Supports real-time material flow visibility and AGV fleet utilization reporting. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
