attributes.name: data_freshness_lag_minutes
attributes.description: Time difference in minutes between when data was last updated in the OEM system and when it was synchronized to the dealer DMS. Key metric for monitoring data currency.

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned unique code identifying the dealership. Used for business reporting and dealer network management.

attributes.name: dealer_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the dealership. Denormalized for reporting convenience and to support historical tracking if dealer names change.

attributes.name: dms_endpoint_url
attributes.description: The specific CDK Global DMS API endpoint URL used for this synchronization event. Identifies the dealer system instance and integration point.

attributes.name: dms_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier generated by the CDK Global DMS for this sync event. Used for end-to-end traceability and support escalation.

attributes.name: dms_version
attributes.description: Version number of the CDK Global DMS software running at the dealership. Used to track compatibility and feature availability.

attributes.name: encryption_protocol
attributes.description: Security protocol used to encrypt data during transmission between OEM platform and dealer DMS. Ensures data confidentiality and integrity.

attributes.name: error_category
attributes.description: Classification of the error type encountered during synchronization. Used for root cause analysis and troubleshooting dealer connectivity issues.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message or description returned by the DMS or integration middleware. Provides technical details for troubleshooting failed sync events.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this failed sync event requires escalation to dealer support or OEM integration team for manual intervention.

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this sync failure was escalated to support teams. Null if no escalation occurred or sync succeeded.

attributes.name: integration_batch_reference
attributes.description: Unique batch identifier assigned to group related synchronization events. Used to correlate multiple sync operations within a single integration cycle.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this integration log record was last updated. Tracks changes to sync status, retry attempts, or resolution information.

attributes.name: max_retry_attempts
attributes.description: Maximum number of retry attempts configured for this sync event type before escalation or manual intervention is required.

attributes.name: next_retry_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for the next automatic retry attempt if the current sync failed. Null if no retry is scheduled or sync succeeded.

attributes.name: oem_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier generated by the OEM integration platform for this sync event. Used for internal traceability and audit.

attributes.name: payload_size_kb
attributes.description: Size of the data payload transmitted during this sync event measured in kilobytes. Used to monitor bandwidth utilization and identify large transfers.

attributes.name: record_count_failed
attributes.description: Number of records that failed to synchronize due to validation errors, connectivity issues, or data quality problems.

attributes.name: record_count_received
attributes.description: Total number of records successfully received and acknowledged by the dealer DMS. Used to validate completeness of data transfer.

attributes.name: record_count_sent
attributes.description: Total number of records transmitted from the OEM platform to the dealer DMS during this sync event. Applicable for push operations.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code where the dealership is located. Used for regional performance analysis and connectivity monitoring.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the root cause and resolution steps taken for failed sync events. Used for knowledge management and trend analysis.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a failed sync event was resolved and data synchronization completed successfully. Used to calculate mean time to resolution.

attributes.name: retry_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which retry attempt this represents for a failed synchronization. Zero indicates the initial attempt.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this synchronization event met the defined SLA target for duration and success rate. Used for dealer performance scorecards.

attributes.name: sla_target_duration_seconds
attributes.business_glossary_term: SLA (Service Level Agreement) Target Duration in Seconds
attributes.description: Target synchronization duration in seconds as defined in the dealer integration SLA. Used to measure performance against contractual commitments.

tag_set.value: SLA (Service Level Agreement) Target Duration in Seconds

attributes.name: sync_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from sync initiation to completion or failure. Used to monitor DMS performance and identify slow connections.

attributes.name: sync_event_type
attributes.description: Type of data synchronization event between OEM platform and CDK Global DMS. Indicates the direction and nature of data flow (push from OEM or pull from dealer).

attributes.name: sync_status
attributes.description: Current status of the synchronization event indicating whether data transfer completed successfully, partially succeeded, or failed.

attributes.name: sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the synchronization event was initiated. This is the principal business event timestamp for the integration log entry.

products.name: facility_standard
products.description: OEM facility and brand standards compliance records for each dealership. Tracks facility standard type (CI — Corporate Identity, signage, showroom, service drive, EV charging infrastructure), assessment date, compliance status, deficiency items, remediation deadline, and compliance score. Used for franchise renewal decisions and facility investment planning.

attributes.name: facility_standard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the facility standard compliance record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the OEM assessor. Links to HR system for auditor qualification tracking.

attributes.name: facility_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership being assessed for facility standards compliance.

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the franchise agreement under which this facility standard assessment is conducted. Links to contract terms and compliance obligations.

attributes.name: primary_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership being assessed for facility standards compliance.

attributes.name: allocation_eligibility_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether non-compliance with this facility standard affects the dealer's vehicle allocation eligibility. True = may reduce allocation, False = no allocation impact.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility standards assessment was conducted. Primary business event timestamp for this compliance record.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to conduct the facility standards assessment. On_site = physical inspection, remote = video/virtual tour, hybrid = combination, photographic_evidence = dealer-submitted photos reviewed by OEM, self_assessment = dealer self-evaluation with OEM verification.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the facility standards assessment. Unique reference number used in communications and reporting.

attributes.name: assessment_report_url
attributes.description: Link to the detailed facility standards assessment report document stored in the document management system. Contains photos, detailed findings, and recommendations.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Purpose and context of the facility standards assessment. Initial = new dealer onboarding, annual = scheduled yearly review, renewal = franchise renewal evaluation, spot_check = unscheduled compliance verification, post_remediation = follow-up after deficiency correction, franchise_application = pre-approval assessment.

attributes.name: assessor_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification number of the assessor, demonstrating qualification to conduct facility standards audits.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the OEM representative or third-party auditor who conducted the facility standards assessment.

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: Quantitative compliance rating expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Calculated based on weighted assessment criteria and deficiency severity. Used for franchise renewal decisions and dealer performance scorecards.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state for this facility standard. Compliant = meets all requirements, non_compliant = fails to meet standards, conditional = compliant with minor exceptions, pending_review = assessment submitted awaiting approval, remediation_required = deficiencies identified requiring correction, waived = exemption granted by OEM.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility standard compliance record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: critical_deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of critical deficiencies identified. Critical deficiencies are those that pose safety risks, violate regulatory requirements, or severely impact brand image.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record.

attributes.name: dealer_response_notes
attributes.description: Dealer's formal response to the assessment findings, including planned remediation actions, timelines, and any disputes or clarifications.

attributes.name: deficiency_count
attributes.description: Total number of deficiency items identified during the assessment. Includes all severity levels (critical, major, minor).

attributes.name: deficiency_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of all deficiency items identified during the assessment. Includes specific observations, locations, and non-compliance details.

attributes.name: dms_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of data synchronization with the dealer's DMS system (CDK Global). Indicates whether facility standards compliance data has been successfully shared with the dealer's operational system.

attributes.name: dms_last_sync_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: DMS (Dealer Management System) Last Sync Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful data synchronization with the dealer's DMS system.

tag_set.value: DMS (Dealer Management System) Last Sync Timestamp

attributes.name: estimated_investment_amount
attributes.description: Estimated cost for the dealer to achieve full compliance with this facility standard. Used for facility investment planning and franchise renewal negotiations.

attributes.name: franchise_renewal_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this facility standard assessment result will be considered in the next franchise renewal decision. True = impacts renewal, False = informational only.

attributes.name: incentive_eligibility_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether non-compliance with this facility standard affects the dealer's eligibility for OEM incentive programs. True = may disqualify from incentives, False = no incentive impact.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility standard compliance record was most recently updated. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: major_deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of major deficiencies identified. Major deficiencies significantly impact customer experience or operational efficiency but are not safety-critical.

attributes.name: minor_deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of minor deficiencies identified. Minor deficiencies are cosmetic or procedural issues with minimal business impact.

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next facility standards assessment. Frequency determined by standard type, compliance history, and franchise agreement terms.

attributes.name: oem_reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Internal OEM notes regarding the assessment, remediation progress, or special considerations. Used for franchise management and dealer relationship tracking.

attributes.name: passing_threshold_score
attributes.description: Minimum compliance score required to achieve compliant status for this standard type. Threshold may vary by standard category and dealer tier.

attributes.name: photographic_evidence_url
attributes.description: Link to photographic documentation of facility conditions at time of assessment. Used for compliance verification and historical tracking.

attributes.name: remediation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all required corrective actions were completed by the dealer. Verified through post-remediation assessment or photographic evidence.

attributes.name: remediation_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which all identified deficiencies must be corrected. Failure to meet this deadline may result in franchise penalties or suspension.

attributes.name: remediation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required to address identified deficiencies. True = remediation mandatory, False = no action required or waived.

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current state of corrective action for identified deficiencies. Tracks progress from identification through verification of completion.

attributes.name: remediation_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when OEM verified that remediation actions were completed satisfactorily. May involve on-site re-inspection or remote verification.

attributes.name: standard_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the facility standard type for reporting and analysis purposes.

attributes.name: standard_type
attributes.description: Category of facility standard being assessed. CI = Corporate Identity (brand visual standards), signage (exterior/interior signage compliance), showroom (sales floor layout and presentation), service_drive (service reception area standards), ev_charging (Electric Vehicle charging infrastructure), parts_department (parts storage and display), body_shop (collision repair facility standards), customer_lounge (waiting area amenities), digital_experience (digital tools and kiosks). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CI|signage|showroom|service_drive|ev_charging|parts_department|body_shop|customer_lounge|digital_experience — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Franchise Agreement Standards

attributes.name: waiver_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the granted waiver expires and full compliance is required. Null indicates permanent waiver.

attributes.name: waiver_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OEM granted a waiver or exemption for this facility standard. True = waiver approved, False = no waiver.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for granting a facility standards waiver. May include market conditions, dealer financial hardship, facility constraints, or strategic considerations.

products.name: used_vehicle_appraisal
products.description: Trade-in and used vehicle appraisal records conducted at the dealership. Captures appraisal date, VIN, year/make/model, mileage, condition grade, appraiser, appraisal tool used (e.g., Manheim, Black Book, KBB), appraised value, trade-in allowance offered, and disposition decision (accepted trade, declined, wholesale). Supports F&I deal structuring and used vehicle inventory acquisition.
products.reference: CDK Global DMS Used Vehicle Appraisal

attributes.name: used_vehicle_appraisal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the used vehicle appraisal record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: appraiser_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the dealership staff member who conducted the appraisal.

attributes.name: primary_dealership_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the dealership where the appraisal was conducted.

attributes.name: primary_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who owns the vehicle being appraised for trade-in or sale.

attributes.name: used_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who owns the vehicle being appraised for trade-in or sale.

attributes.name: used_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the dealership where the appraisal was conducted.

attributes.name: accident_history_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle has a reported accident history based on vehicle history report or customer disclosure.

attributes.name: appraisal_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle appraisal was conducted at the dealership.

attributes.name: appraisal_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the appraisal transaction, typically generated by the DMS (Dealer Management System) or appraisal tool.

attributes.name: appraisal_source_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the appraisal was initiated: walk_in (customer walked into dealership), appointment (scheduled appraisal), online_submission (customer submitted online), phone_inquiry (customer called), service_drive (initiated during service visit).

attributes.name: appraisal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the appraisal: pending (in progress), completed (appraisal finished), accepted (customer accepted trade-in offer), declined (customer declined offer), expired (offer validity period lapsed).

attributes.name: appraisal_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the appraisal was completed, including time zone information.

attributes.name: appraisal_tool_used
attributes.description: Third-party valuation tool or system used to determine vehicle value: Manheim MMR (Manheim Market Report), Black Book, KBB (Kelley Blue Book), NADA (National Automobile Dealers Association), Galves, or internal proprietary tool.

attributes.name: appraised_value_amount
attributes.description: Final appraised value determined by the dealer after considering market value, vehicle condition, and local market factors.

attributes.name: appraiser_name
attributes.description: Full name of the dealership employee who performed the appraisal.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this appraisal record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this appraisal (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: customer_requested_amount
attributes.description: Trade-in value amount initially requested or expected by the customer, if disclosed during appraisal.

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: Final decision on the disposition of the appraised vehicle: accepted_trade (customer accepted trade-in offer), declined_trade (customer declined offer), wholesale (vehicle to be sent to auction), retail_inventory (vehicle to be added to dealer used inventory), pending (decision not yet made).

attributes.name: equity_amount
attributes.description: Calculated equity in the vehicle (appraised value minus payoff amount). Positive equity means the vehicle is worth more than owed; negative equity means the customer owes more than the vehicle is worth.

attributes.name: exterior_condition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes on the exterior condition, including paint quality, body damage, dents, scratches, rust, and glass condition.

attributes.name: interior_condition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes on the interior condition, including upholstery wear, dashboard condition, electronics functionality, and cleanliness.

attributes.name: linked_deal_number
attributes.description: Deal or sales transaction number in the DMS (Dealer Management System) if this appraisal was linked to a new or used vehicle purchase.

attributes.name: market_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated market value of the vehicle based on the appraisal tool, representing the fair market price for retail or wholesale.

attributes.name: mechanical_condition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes on the mechanical condition of the vehicle, including engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, and other systems.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle being appraised, representing the year designation assigned by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: odometer_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the odometer reading: miles or kilometers.

attributes.name: offer_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade-in offer expires and is no longer valid, typically 3-7 days from appraisal date.

attributes.name: payoff_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding loan or lease payoff amount owed by the customer on the vehicle being appraised, if applicable. This is customer financial information.

attributes.name: reconditioning_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated cost to recondition the vehicle for resale, including repairs, detailing, and PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) work.

attributes.name: retail_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Estimated retail asking price if the vehicle were to be added to dealer used vehicle inventory.

attributes.name: service_records_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer provided documented service and maintenance records for the vehicle.

attributes.name: tire_condition
attributes.description: Assessment of tire condition and remaining tread life: excellent (like new), good (adequate tread), fair (moderate wear), poor (low tread), replacement_needed (below safe threshold).

attributes.name: title_status
attributes.description: Legal title status of the vehicle: clean (no issues), salvage (total loss), rebuilt (repaired salvage), lemon (manufacturer buyback), flood (flood damage), hail (hail damage).

attributes.name: trade_in_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Trade-in allowance amount offered to the customer, which may differ from appraised value due to negotiation or deal structuring in F&I (Finance and Insurance) process.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this appraisal record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number uniquely identifying the vehicle being appraised. VIN is considered PII as it can be traced to an individual owner.

attributes.name: wholesale_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Estimated wholesale auction value if the vehicle were to be sent to wholesale rather than retailed.

products.name: dealer_order

attributes.name: dealer_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer for whom this order is placed. Populated for retail (customer-specific) orders; null for stock orders.

attributes.name: primary_dealership_id

attributes.name: primary_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer for whom this order is placed. Populated for retail (customer-specific) orders; null for stock orders.

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: otd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was delivered on or before the confirmed delivery date. True = delivered on time; False = delivered late. Core metric for OTD performance reporting and dealer satisfaction.

attributes.name: pdi_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed at the dealership. Null if PDI has not yet been performed.

attributes.name: pdi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) is required before the vehicle is handed over to the customer. True = PDI mandatory; False = PDI not required.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; IATF 16949 PDI Standards

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority classification assigned to the order for production scheduling and allocation purposes. Higher priority orders are scheduled earlier in the production sequence.

attributes.name: production_plant_code
attributes.description: the source system identifying the manufacturing facility assigned to produce the vehicle for this order. Determined during production scheduling.

attributes.name: production_week
attributes.description: ISO 8601 production week (e.g., 2025-W23) in which the vehicle is scheduled to be built. Used for production scheduling, capacity planning, and OTD tracking.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the dealer has requested the vehicle to be delivered to the dealership. Used for On-Time Delivery (OTD) target setting and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; OTD KPI Framework

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: OEM sales region code associated with the ordering dealer. Used for regional sales performance reporting, allocation management, and incentive program eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: sap_sales_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known the source system order number assigned by the OEM ERP system upon order confirmation. Used for cross-system traceability between the lakehouse and the source system

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: The logistics mode used to transport the vehicle from the production plant to the dealership: rail, truck (auto carrier), ocean vessel, or a combination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping; DOT Transportation Regulations

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: The transmission type specified for the ordered vehicle: automatic, manual, Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT), or Dual-Clutch Transmission (DCT).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the dealer order record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse.

products.name: dealer_contact
products.description: Key personnel contacts at a dealership including dealer principal, general manager, sales manager, service manager, parts manager, and F&I manager. Tracks role, contact details, tenure, certification status, and active flag. Supports OEM communications, training enrollment, and dealer portal access management.

attributes.name: dealer_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership where this contact is employed. Links to the dealer master record.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact is currently active and employed at the dealership. True if active; False if terminated, retired, or on extended leave.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact's current OEM certification expires and recertification is required. Null if certification is not required or not yet obtained.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: The current status of the contact's OEM certification or training requirements. Certified indicates all required certifications are current; in_progress indicates training underway; expired indicates recertification needed; not_required indicates role does not require certification; not_certified indicates certification required but not yet obtained.

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: The contact's preferred method of communication for OEM notifications and updates. Options include email, phone, mobile, fax, or portal messaging.

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: The functional role or position of the contact at the dealership. Includes dealer principal, general manager, sales manager, service manager, parts manager, and F&I (Finance and Insurance) manager.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dealer contact record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this dealer contact record originated. Typically CDK Global DMS (Dealer Management System), the source system or other dealer management platforms.

attributes.name: dealer_portal_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has been granted access to the OEM dealer portal for ordering, inventory management, warranty claims, and communications. True if access is granted; False if not.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The department or functional area within the dealership where the contact works. Includes sales, service, parts, F&I (Finance and Insurance), administration, and management.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the dealer contact. Used for OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) communications, training enrollment, and dealer portal access.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the person to contact in case of an emergency involving this dealer contact.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the emergency contact person for this dealer contact.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the dealer contact, if still in use for document transmission.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: The given name of the dealer contact person.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact was hired or started employment at the dealership. Used to calculate tenure and eligibility for OEM programs.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title or designation of the contact at the dealership, which may differ from the standardized contact role.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: The preferred language for communications with the contact. Uses ISO 639-2 three-letter language codes (ENG=English, SPA=Spanish, FRE=French, GER=German, ITA=Italian, POR=Portuguese, CHI=Chinese, JPN=Japanese, KOR=Korean, ARA=Arabic). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ENG|SPA|FRE|GER|ITA|POR|CHI|JPN|KOR|ARA — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: The family name or surname of the dealer contact person.

attributes.name: last_training_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact last completed an OEM training course or certification program.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The middle name or initial of the dealer contact person, if applicable.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the dealer contact, used for urgent communications and field operations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the dealer contact. May include communication preferences, special requirements, or historical context.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the dealer contact. Includes country code, area code, and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: portal_last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the contact last logged into the OEM dealer portal. Used to monitor engagement and identify inactive users.

attributes.name: portal_user_code
attributes.description: The unique user identifier or login name for the contact in the OEM dealer portal system. Used for authentication and access management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the primary point of contact for their role at the dealership. True if primary; False if secondary or backup contact.

attributes.name: tenure_years
attributes.description: The number of years the contact has been employed at the dealership, calculated from hire date. Used for experience assessment and program eligibility.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact's employment at the dealership ended. Null if the contact is still active.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for the contact's departure from the dealership. Includes resignation, retirement, termination, transfer to another location, or other reasons.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dealer contact record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: dealer_region
products.description: OEM regional and zone organizational hierarchy for dealer network management. Defines region name, zone, district, regional manager assignment, geographic boundaries, and the set of dealerships within each region. Used for regional performance aggregation, allocation management, and field sales team alignment.

attributes.name: dealer_region_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer region. Primary key for the dealer region entity.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Regional performance and compliance metrics are governed by jurisdiction; the link supports region‑level regulatory analytics.

attributes.name: allocation_quota_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total OEM production allocated to this region. Sum of all region percentages equals 100%. Used for production planning and dealer inventory distribution.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the current region configuration or most recent change was formally approved by management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the executive who approved the current region configuration or most recent change.

attributes.name: city_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of major cities included in this dealer region for reference and marketing purposes.

attributes.name: competitive_intensity_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of competitive pressure from other OEMs in this region. Influences incentive programs and marketing investment.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country for this region (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: county_region_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of county or regional administrative divisions included in this dealer region for granular territory definition.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dealer region record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dealer_count
attributes.description: Total number of active dealerships assigned to this region. Used for capacity planning and regional performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: district_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the district within the region. Districts are sub-regional organizational units that group dealerships for field management.

attributes.name: district_name
attributes.description: Full name of the district within the region.

attributes.name: dms_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of integration between this region and the CDK Global DMS. Active indicates successful data synchronization; error indicates integration issues requiring attention.

attributes.name: dms_last_sync_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dealer Management System (DMS) Last Sync Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful data synchronization between this region and the CDK Global DMS. Used for monitoring integration health.

tag_set.value: Dealer Management System (DMS) Last Sync Timestamp

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this region configuration ceased to be effective. Null for currently active regions. Used for historical analysis and territory reorganization tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this region configuration became effective. Used for historical tracking and territory change management.

attributes.name: geographic_boundary_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic boundaries defining this region (e.g., bordered by Interstate 5 to the west, state line to the east). Used when precise coordinates are not available.

attributes.name: household_count_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of households within the region. Used for market penetration and vehicle ownership forecasting.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau / National Statistical Agencies

attributes.name: incentive_program_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealers in this region are eligible for special OEM incentive programs. True if eligible, false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dealer region record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal review of this regions boundaries, performance targets, and organizational alignment.

attributes.name: market_segment_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the regions primary market segment based on population density and economic characteristics. Influences product mix and marketing strategy.

attributes.name: modification_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the most recent change to this regions configuration (e.g., market consolidation, dealer network expansion, territory realignment).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this regions configuration and performance. Used for governance and planning cycles.

attributes.name: performance_benchmark_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the peer group used for performance benchmarking. Regions in the same group are compared for scorecard evaluation.

attributes.name: population_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total population within the geographic boundaries of this region. Used for market sizing and sales potential analysis.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau / National Statistical Agencies

attributes.name: postal_code_range
attributes.description: Description of postal code ranges covered by this region (e.g., 90000-93999 for Southern California). Used for territory assignment and customer routing.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the region within the OEM organizational hierarchy. Used for reporting and system integration.

attributes.name: region_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the dealer region (e.g., Northeast Region, California Coastal, Mid-Atlantic).

attributes.name: region_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dealer region. Active regions are operational; inactive regions are temporarily suspended; pending regions are being established; consolidating regions are merging with others; dissolved regions have been permanently closed.

attributes.name: region_type
attributes.description: Classification of the region based on organizational structure: geographic (physical territory), market (customer segment focus), strategic (special initiative), or operational (functional alignment).

attributes.name: regional_manager_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the regional manager for business communication and escalation.

attributes.name: regional_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the regional manager assigned to oversee dealer performance, allocation, and field operations in this region.

attributes.name: regional_manager_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number of the regional manager for dealer support and escalation.

attributes.name: sales_potential_index
attributes.description: Indexed score (0-100) representing the relative sales potential of this region compared to national average. Used for allocation planning and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: salesforce_region_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this region in the the source system system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and dealer portal integration.

attributes.name: sap_sales_org_code
attributes.description: the source system organization code mapped to this dealer region. Used for order processing, billing, and financial reporting integration.

attributes.name: special_program_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing any special programs, initiatives, or considerations applicable to this region (e.g., EV infrastructure pilot, fleet sales focus).

attributes.name: state_province_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of state or province codes covered by this region (e.g., CA,NV,AZ for a Western US region).

attributes.name: vehicle_allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking (1=highest) for vehicle allocation to this region during supply constraints. Based on market size, strategic importance, and historical performance.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the parent zone to which this region belongs. Zones are higher-level organizational units that aggregate multiple regions.

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Full name of the parent zone (e.g., Eastern Zone, Western Zone, Central Zone).

domains.name: aftersales
domains.description: Post-sale customer support including warranty management, service campaigns, recall execution, and parts distribution. Manages service appointments, repair orders, TSB (Technical Service Bulletin) distribution, DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Code) analysis, and labor time standards. Tracks warranty claims, parts consumption, service revenue, and customer retention. Includes field service operations and authorized service center network management. Integrates with CDK Global DMS and OBD (On-Board Diagnostics) systems.
domains.references: Warranty Standards, Service Standards, OBD-II, NHTSA

products.name: feature_content
products.description: Defines the commercial feature content associated with a trim level or option package — the consumer-facing feature descriptions used in marketing, window stickers, and configurators. Captures feature code, feature name, feature category (safety/technology/comfort/performance/exterior/interior), feature description, standard vs. optional flag, ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) classification flag, EV/HEV-specific flag, regulatory-mandated flag, and content source system reference. Bridges the commercial product catalog to consumer-facing communications.

attributes.name: feature_content_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the feature content record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aftersales_trim_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.trim_level. Business justification: Feature content is defined per trim level; linking provides a proper hierarchy and removes any need for duplicate trim identifiers in feature_content.

attributes.name: design_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.design_specification. Business justification: Feature‑to‑Design traceability matrix requires linking each product feature to its engineering design specification for validation and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feature content record was approved for publication. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the product manager or marketing manager who approved this feature content for publication. Used for accountability and content governance.

attributes.name: availability_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the feature is included as standard equipment, available as a standalone option, only available within a package, or not available for a given trim or market.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feature content record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_demand_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0-100) representing customer demand or take-rate for this feature based on market research, configurator analytics, and sales data. Used for product planning and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: dealer_cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: The incremental dealer invoice cost when this feature is included. Used for dealer margin calculations and incentive program design.

attributes.name: ecu_dependency_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature requires specific ECU (Electronic Control Unit) hardware or software configuration. Used for manufacturing planning and service diagnostics.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this feature content record is no longer effective. Null if the record is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this feature content record becomes effective and available for use in configurators, ordering systems, and marketing materials.

attributes.name: feature_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the feature grouping for marketing segmentation and consumer navigation. Categories align with consumer decision-making patterns.

attributes.name: feature_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the feature within the product catalog system. Used for cross-system integration and configurator mapping.

attributes.name: feature_description_long
attributes.description: Comprehensive consumer-facing description of the feature including benefits, technical highlights, and usage scenarios. Used in brochures, website detail pages, and dealer training materials.

attributes.name: feature_description_short
attributes.description: Brief consumer-facing description of the feature, typically 50-100 characters, used in configurator tooltips and mobile applications.

attributes.name: feature_name
attributes.description: Consumer-facing marketing name of the feature as displayed in brochures, window stickers, and online configurators.

attributes.name: feature_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the feature content record. Active features are available for configuration; discontinued features are retained for historical reference; pending features are awaiting approval; under_review features are being evaluated for changes.

attributes.name: feature_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the feature category for granular filtering and reporting (e.g., within safety: active safety, passive safety, driver assistance).

attributes.name: fuel_economy_impact_percent
attributes.description: The estimated percentage impact on fuel economy (positive or negative) when this feature is included. Used for EPA fuel economy label calculations and CAFE compliance.

attributes.name: installation_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to install this feature on the production line. Used for manufacturing capacity planning and line balancing in MES (Manufacturing Execution System).

attributes.name: is_adas_feature
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Feature Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is classified as an ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) technology, such as adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist, or automated emergency braking.
attributes.references: SAE International J3016 Levels of Driving Automation

tag_set.value: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Feature Flag

attributes.name: is_ev_specific
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is specific to electric vehicle (EV) or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) powertrains, such as regenerative braking display, charging port, or battery thermal management.

attributes.name: is_hev_specific
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) Specific Feature Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is specific to hybrid electric vehicle (HEV) powertrains, such as hybrid system display, EV mode selector, or hybrid battery cooling.

tag_set.value: Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) Specific Feature Flag

attributes.name: is_regulatory_mandated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is mandated by regulatory requirements such as NHTSA Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS), EPA emissions standards, or regional safety regulations (e.g., backup camera, tire pressure monitoring system).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feature content record was last modified. Used for change tracking and synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: market_availability_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market where this feature is available, using standardized region codes (e.g., NAM for North America, EUR for Europe, CHN for China). Multiple regions may be pipe-separated.

attributes.name: marketing_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numerical ranking indicating the marketing priority of this feature for promotional campaigns and sales emphasis. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: model_year_discontinued
attributes.description: The model year (MY) when this feature was discontinued or phased out. Null if the feature is still active in the current lineup.

attributes.name: model_year_introduced
attributes.description: The model year (MY) when this feature was first introduced into the product lineup. Used for product evolution tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: msrp_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the MSRP impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: msrp_impact_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Impact Amount
attributes.description: The incremental MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) value added when this feature is included as an option. Zero for standard features. Used for pricing calculations and configurator display.

tag_set.value: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Impact Amount

attributes.name: ota_updateable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature can be enabled, updated, or modified via OTA (Over-the-Air) software updates post-production.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory standard or requirement that mandates this feature, such as FMVSS number, EPA regulation code, or Euro NCAP protocol. Populated only when is_regulatory_mandated is true.
attributes.references: NHTSA, EPA, UNECE, Euro NCAP Standards

attributes.name: safety_rating_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the level of impact this feature has on vehicle safety ratings such as NCAP (New Car Assessment Programme) star ratings or IIHS Top Safety Pick awards.
attributes.references: Euro NCAP, IIHS Safety Rating Protocols

attributes.name: source_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this feature content record in the source system, used for traceability and data lineage.

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary supplier or OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) partner providing the component or system that delivers this feature. Used for supply chain traceability and warranty management.

attributes.name: technology_level
attributes.description: Classification of the feature's technology sophistication level, used for market positioning and trim-level differentiation strategies.

attributes.name: warranty_extension_months
attributes.description: Number of additional warranty months provided specifically for this feature beyond the base vehicle warranty. Zero if no extension applies.

attributes.name: weight_impact_kg
attributes.description: The incremental vehicle weight in kilograms added by this feature. Used for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) calculations, performance modeling, and engineering analysis.

products.name: program_milestone
products.description: Tracks key program milestones and gate reviews for each MY program (e.g., Program Approval, Design Freeze, PPAP completion, SOP, Job 1, EOP). Captures milestone type, planned date, actual date, milestone status (pending/achieved/delayed/waived), responsible function, gate review outcome, and variance days. Enables program management tracking, cross-functional alignment, and executive reporting on program health.
products.reference: Program Gate / APQP Milestone (APQP Phase Gate)

attributes.name: program_milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the program milestone record. Primary key for the program milestone entity.

attributes.name: aftersales_model_year_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent MY (Model Year) program to which this milestone belongs. Links to the program master entity.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: nameplate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle nameplate (brand/model) associated with this program milestone. Links to nameplate master data in the product domain.
attributes.references: SAE J1979 - E/E Diagnostic Test Modes

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this milestone applies. Relevant for production-related milestones (SOP, Job 1, EOP). Null for program-level milestones. Links to plant master data.

attributes.name: predecessor_milestone_program_milestone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding milestone that must be achieved before this milestone can begin. Null for the first milestone in the program sequence. Enables critical path analysis.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or program manager accountable for delivering this milestone. Links to workforce/employee master data.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: program_responsible_person_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or program manager accountable for delivering this milestone. Links to workforce/employee master data.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: Actual date the milestone was achieved. Populated when milestone_status transitions to achieved. Used for variance analysis and lessons learned.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Approved baseline date after program approval or re-baseline. Used as the official target for performance measurement and variance calculation.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: budget_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact (in base currency) if this milestone is delayed. Used for prioritization and executive escalation. Null if no quantified impact.

attributes.name: program_milestone_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the milestone type (e.g., PROG_APPR, DESIGN_FREEZE, PPAP_COMP, SOP, JOB1, EOP). Used for system integration and reporting.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of work completed toward achieving this milestone (0.00 to 100.00). Updated during program reviews. 100.00 when milestone_status is achieved.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_path_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is on the program critical path. True if any delay to this milestone will delay the overall program SOP date. Used for prioritization and risk management.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for budget_impact_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Null if budget_impact_amount is null.

attributes.name: deliverable_completed_count
attributes.description: Number of deliverables that have been completed and approved. Used to calculate completion_percentage and assess readiness for gate review.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: deliverable_count
attributes.description: Number of formal deliverables (documents, approvals, test results) required to achieve this milestone. Used to track completion progress.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: external_dependency_description
attributes.description: Description of external dependencies, including supplier names, partner organizations, or regulatory agencies. Null if external_dependency_flag is false.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: external_dependency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone depends on external parties (suppliers, partners, regulatory agencies) for completion. True if external coordination required, false if fully internal.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: Current forecast date for milestone achievement based on latest program status. Updated regularly during program reviews. Null if milestone already achieved.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: gate_review_comments
attributes.description: Executive comments, conditions, or action items resulting from the gate review meeting. Captures key decisions and follow-up requirements.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: gate_review_date
attributes.description: Date the formal gate review meeting was held. Null if gate_review_required is false or review not yet conducted.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: gate_review_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the formal gate review meeting: approved (proceed to next phase), approved_with_conditions (proceed with action items), deferred (reschedule review), rejected (do not proceed). Null if gate_review_required is false or review not yet held.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: gate_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal gate review (executive approval meeting) is required before this milestone can be marked as achieved. True for major program gates (e.g., Program Approval, SOP), false for intermediate checkpoints.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Action plan to address identified risks and recover schedule. Includes specific actions, owners, and target dates. Null if risk_level is low.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model Year for which this program milestone applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with automotive industry MY planning cycles.
attributes.references: SAE J1979 - E/E Diagnostic Test Modes

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this milestone record. Audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking.

Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) event record captured from OBD-II (On-Board Diagnostics) systems during a vehicle service visit or via connected vehicle telematics. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Needed for program-level financial reporting and cost allocation: linking each invoice to its vehicle program enables revenue tracking per engineering program.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Invoices for vehicle sales need to reference the exact vehicle VIN; adding vin_id creates a direct link between billing and the vehicle master.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address to which the invoice is sent.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (suite, building, department).

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the legal entity or business unit issuing the invoice (e.g., regional sales company, parts distribution center, service center).

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing address.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for invoice cancellation (order cancelled, billing error, duplicate invoice).

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice was cancelled, if applicable. Null for active invoices.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: credit_memo_reference
attributes.description: Reference to a credit memo document number if this invoice has been partially or fully credited.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in which the invoice is denominated.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the invoice (volume discounts, promotional discounts, early payment discounts).

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice was flagged as disputed by the customer or internal review.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for dispute if the invoice status is disputed (pricing error, quantity mismatch, quality issue, delivery issue).

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is expected per the agreed payment terms.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when the invoice was issued.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the invoice was issued, used for financial reporting and period closing.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before taxes, discounts, and adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP SD Billing Document Net Value

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was formally issued to the customer. Principal business event timestamp for the billing transaction.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique invoice document number issued to the customer. Business identifier for the invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the billing and collection workflow.

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice based on the customer segment and transaction nature (dealer wholesale, retail customer, fleet account, parts sale, service work, warranty claim).

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle or product being invoiced, providing context for pricing and product configuration.

attributes.name: msrp_based_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Based Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice pricing is based on MSRP (true) or negotiated/contracted pricing (false).

tag_set.value: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Based Flag

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final invoice amount payable after applying taxes, discounts, and all adjustments. This is the amount due from the customer.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the invoice (special instructions, payment arrangements, delivery notes).

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice (net_amount minus paid_amount).

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid against this invoice to date. Used to track partial payments.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method expected or used for settling this invoice.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the full or final payment was received for this invoice. Null if not yet fully paid.

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order or service order that this invoice bills for.

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the sales region or territory to which this invoice is attributed for revenue reporting.

attributes.name: sap_billing_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system document number from which this invoice was generated. System of record identifier.

attributes.name: ssot_governance_note
attributes.description: SSOT owner for invoice_line entity. Other domains reference this via FK.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the invoice (sales tax, VAT, GST, etc.).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was last modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number of the vehicle being invoiced, if applicable (for vehicle sales invoices).

products.name: billing_invoice_line
products.description: Individual line item on a billing invoice representing a specific charge for a vehicle unit, parts SKU, labor operation, accessory, or service fee. Captures line number, item type (vehicle/part/labor/accessory/fee), item code, item description, VIN reference for vehicle lines, part number for parts lines, quantity, unit price, MSRP, negotiated price, discount amount, tax code, tax amount, line total, and revenue category. Supports multi-line invoices for mixed vehicle and parts/service billing.

attributes.name: billing_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the invoice line item. Primary key for the invoice_line product.

attributes.name: aftersales_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.service_appointment. Business justification: REQUIRED: Service appointments generate billable items; linking appointment to invoice line provides appointment‑level financial reporting.

attributes.name: billing_price_condition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.price_condition. Business justification: Invoice line items can be priced by a pricing condition; linking to price_condition normalizes pricing logic.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Needed to allocate line‑level costs to the correct cost center for internal cost tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the salesperson who completed this transaction. Used for sales commission calculation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: equipment_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_registry. Business justification: Invoice line items for parts/labor need equipment reference to allocate charges to the correct asset.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for General Ledger posting of each invoice line revenue to the appropriate GL account for financial reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent invoice header. Links this line item to the billing invoice document.

attributes.name: part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.part_master. Business justification: Required for warranty claim and recall tracking: each invoice line must reference the engineering part master to associate sold parts with design, compliance, and cost data.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Supports profit‑center profitability analysis by linking each sales line to its profit center.

attributes.name: rep_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the salesperson who completed this transaction. Used for sales commission calculation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: repair_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.repair_order_line. Business justification: REQUIRED: Each invoice line originates from a repair‑order line; the link supports detailed cost‑to‑service analysis.

attributes.name: service_contract_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.service_contract_claim. Business justification: REQUIRED: Claims under service contracts are billed; linking claim to invoice line enables claim settlement and audit.

attributes.name: service_subscription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.service_subscription. Business justification: Needed for the 'Usage‑Based Service Billing' report, linking each invoice line to the subscription that produced the charge.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Invoice line items represent sold SKUs; linking each invoice_line to the product SKU provides traceability from billing to product catalog.

attributes.name: supply_po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supply_po_line. Business justification: Invoice line validation against PO line items is required for accurate cost allocation and audit; standard in automotive AP.

attributes.name: tax_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.tax_code. Business justification: Invoice line tax details should reference the tax_code master; the tax rate can be derived, so the string code and rate columns are redundant.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Invoice line items are allocated to a specific vehicle for warranty and service charge tracking; linking ensures accurate vehicle‑level financial reporting.

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: Date when this line item was billed. Represents the accounting date for revenue recognition and the invoice document date.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if this line was cancelled. Provides audit trail for cancelled billing lines and supports dispute analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center responsible for this revenue line. Used for internal cost accounting and profitability analysis by organizational unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was first created in the billing system. Provides audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: credit_memo_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the credit memo document if this line was credited. Links to the reversing document for returns, adjustments, or billing corrections.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line. Indicates the currency in which the line is billed (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Dealer or distribution partner code responsible for this sale. Identifies the selling dealer location for dealer network reporting and commission calculation.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery document that fulfilled this line. Links the billing to the physical shipment or service delivery event.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this line item. Represents the monetary reduction from the base unit price, including promotional discounts, volume discounts, and negotiated reductions.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Discount expressed as a percentage of the unit price. Provides the rate of discount applied to calculate the discount_amount.

attributes.name: item_code
attributes.description: Universal item identifier for the billed product or service. May represent a vehicle model code, part number, labor operation code, accessory SKU (Stock Keeping Unit), or fee code depending on line_item_type.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the billed item. Provides detailed text explaining the product, service, or charge represented by this line.

attributes.name: labor_operation_code
attributes.description: Standardized labor operation code for service work. Identifies the specific repair or maintenance task performed. Populated only when line_item_type is labor.

attributes.name: line_item_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice line item. Distinguishes between vehicle units, parts, labor operations, accessories, service fees, freight charges, warranty products, and insurance products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vehicle|part|labor|accessory|fee|freight|warranty|insurance — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the invoice. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items on the invoice document.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the invoice line. Tracks the lifecycle state from initial billing through payment or dispute resolution.

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount for this line item including all charges and taxes. Calculated as subtotal_amount + tax_amount. Represents the final billable amount for this line.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that last modified this invoice line record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to the record for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price for the item. The list price recommended by the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer). Primarily applicable to vehicle and accessory line items.

attributes.name: negotiated_price
attributes.description: Final negotiated price per unit after dealer or customer negotiations. May differ from MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) based on market conditions, promotions, or customer agreements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this invoice line. Captures special instructions, explanations, or additional context for the billing line item.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center for internal P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting. Enables profitability analysis by business segment, product line, or geographic region.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Marketing promotion or incentive program code applied to this line. Tracks the specific promotional campaign that influenced the pricing or discount.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of items or units billed on this line. For vehicles typically 1, for parts the number of units, for labor the number of hours.

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Revenue classification for financial reporting and analytics. Categorizes the line item into major revenue streams for P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting and business intelligence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_vehicle|used_vehicle|parts|service|warranty|finance|insurance — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sales_order_line_number
attributes.description: Line number on the originating sales order. Provides traceability from the invoice line back to the specific sales order line item.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order Line Item

attributes.name: sales_order_number
