attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order document. Links the invoice line back to the sales order that authorized this billing.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date when the service or delivery occurred. For labor lines, the date the work was performed; for parts, the date the parts were delivered; for vehicles, the delivery date.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Line subtotal before taxes. Calculated as (quantity × unit_price) - discount_amount. Represents the net selling amount before tax.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charged on this line item. Calculated by applying the tax_rate to the subtotal_amount. Includes sales tax, VAT (Value Added Tax), or GST (Goods and Services Tax) as applicable.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity. EA=Each (for countable items), HR=Hour (for labor), KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, L=Liter, GAL=Gallon, M=Meter, FT=Foot. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|HR|KG|LB|L|GAL|M|FT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit before discounts and taxes. Represents the base selling price for one unit of the item.

attributes.name: warranty_code
attributes.description: Warranty program code if this line represents warranty coverage. Identifies the specific warranty plan or extended service contract being billed.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that created this invoice line record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: payment
products.description: Record of a payment received against an invoice or account balance from a dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account. Captures payment date, payment method (wire/ACH/check/credit_card/floorplan/dealer_draft), payment amount, currency, applied invoice references, bank reference number, clearing date, payment status (pending/cleared/returned/reversed), the source system document reference, and payer entity type. SSOT for all inbound payment receipts in the billing domain.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment record. Primary key for the payment entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Payments are charged to a cost center for cash‑flow and expense tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Cash receipt posting requires a GL account to record the payment in the ledger.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice against which this payment is applied. Links payment to the billing document.

attributes.name: payment_payer_entity_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the entity making the payment (dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account).

attributes.name: primary_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the entity making the payment (dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account).

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center reporting of cash receipts requires linking payments to the responsible profit center.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary value of the payment received before any adjustments or fees.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that has been successfully applied to outstanding invoices or account balances.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code provided by the payment processor or bank confirming approval of the payment transaction.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number from which the payment originated. Masked or tokenized for security. Used for reconciliation and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: bank_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the bank or financial institution for the payment transaction. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or group of payments processed together. Used for bulk payment processing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Interface or channel through which the payment was submitted. Distinguishes between online portal, mobile app, bank transfer, mail, and in-person payments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: online_portal|mobile_app|bank_transfer|mail|in_person|automated_system|dealer_system — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was cleared and funds were confirmed as received in the company bank account.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system that created the payment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount amount granted for early payment according to payment terms (e.g., 2% discount for payment within 10 days).

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment is currently under dispute or has been disputed by the payer or payee.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for payment dispute. Populated only when dispute_flag is true.

attributes.name: lockbox_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the bank lockbox service used to receive and process the payment. Applicable for check and mail payments.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used to make the payment. Includes wire transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), check, credit card, floorplan financing, and dealer draft. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wire_transfer|ach|check|credit_card|debit_card|floorplan_financing|dealer_draft|electronic_funds_transfer|cash|promissory_note — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the payment. May include remittance advice, special instructions, or reconciliation notes.

attributes.name: payer_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity making the payment. Distinguishes between dealer payments, retail customer payments, fleet operator payments, and corporate account payments.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was initiated or received by the payer. Represents the business event date of the payment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the payment transaction. Used for customer communication and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment. Tracks whether the payment is pending, cleared, returned, reversed, or cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|cleared|returned|reversed|cancelled|on_hold|partially_applied — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: processor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party payment processor or gateway used to process the payment (e.g., the source system, PayPal, bank name).

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was reconciled with bank statements and confirmed in the accounting system.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the payment has been successfully reconciled with bank statements and accounting records.

attributes.name: remittance_advice
attributes.description: Detailed remittance information provided by the payer indicating which invoices or charges this payment is intended to cover.

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was returned or reversed by the bank or payment processor. Populated only when payment status is returned or reversed.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for payment return or reversal (e.g., insufficient funds, account closed, stop payment). Populated only when payment status is returned or reversed.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number or SWIFT code for the payer financial institution. Used for wire transfers and ACH (Automated Clearing House) transactions.

attributes.name: sap_clearing_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Clearing Document Number
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system document that records the application of this payment to open invoices. Links payment to financial accounting records.

tag_set.value: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Clearing Document Number

attributes.name: sap_payment_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Payment Document Number
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system document that records the receipt of this payment. Primary link to ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) financial records.

tag_set.value: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Payment Document Number

attributes.name: terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms under which this payment was made (e.g., net 30, net 60, immediate). Links to master payment terms reference.

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment processor or gateway. Used for tracking and reconciliation with external systems.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that remains unapplied and is held as credit on the payer account.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system that last modified the payment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Association record linking a payment to one or more invoice lines, capturing how a single payment is distributed across multiple invoices or partial invoice settlements. Tracks allocated amount per invoice, allocation date, allocation type (full/partial/advance/overpayment), remaining balance after allocation, and clearing status. Enables accurate accounts receivable aging and open item management aligned with the source system item clearing.

attributes.name: payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment allocation record. Primary key for the payment allocation entity.

attributes.name: billing_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific invoice line item being settled. Enables line-level payment allocation for partial settlements and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice receiving the payment allocation. Links to the invoice document being settled or partially settled by this allocation.

attributes.name: payment_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the supervisor or manager who approved the allocation. Required for allocations requiring management approval due to amount thresholds or exception handling.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment transaction being allocated. Links to the payment record that is being distributed across one or more invoices.

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created or approved the allocation. Used for audit trail and accountability in manual allocation scenarios.

attributes.name: primary_payment_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created or approved the allocation. Used for audit trail and accountability in manual allocation scenarios.

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment that is allocated to this specific invoice or invoice line. Represents the portion of the total payment applied to settle this receivable.

attributes.name: allocated_amount_base_currency
attributes.description: The allocated amount converted to the company base currency using the exchange rate. Enables consolidated financial reporting and accounts receivable aging in a single currency.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment was allocated to the invoice. Represents the business event date for accounts receivable clearing and aging calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to create the allocation. Automatic indicates system-matched allocation, manual indicates user-created allocation, system_proposed indicates system suggestion requiring approval, batch_clearing indicates mass clearing process.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the payment allocation. Used for tracking and reference in accounts receivable operations and customer communications.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority sequence for applying payment when multiple invoices are eligible. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used in automatic allocation rules and aging calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment allocation. Pending indicates awaiting confirmation, cleared indicates successfully applied, reversed indicates allocation has been undone, disputed indicates under investigation, reconciled indicates confirmed and balanced, voided indicates cancelled allocation.

attributes.name: allocation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment allocation was recorded in the system. Used for audit trail and transaction sequencing.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation method. Full indicates complete invoice settlement, partial indicates partial payment, advance indicates prepayment before invoice, overpayment indicates excess payment requiring refund or credit, credit_memo indicates credit note application, adjustment indicates manual correction.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation was approved. Null for automatic allocations not requiring approval. Used for workflow tracking and compliance audit.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: the source system for segment reporting. Enables revenue and receivables analysis by business unit, product line, or geographic region.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: the source system document number that records the open item clearing transaction. Links the payment allocation to the financial accounting clearing entry.

attributes.name: clearing_status
attributes.description: Status of the open item clearing in the source system indicates invoice not yet settled, cleared indicates fully settled, partially_cleared indicates partial payment applied, reset indicates clearing was reversed.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: the source system representing the legal entity receiving the payment. Enables multi-entity financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the payment allocation record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated amount. Supports multi-currency billing and payment scenarios common in global automotive sales and dealer networks.

attributes.name: customer_account_number
attributes.description: Customer account number in the accounts receivable system. Used for customer-level payment tracking and credit management.

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer or customer account associated with this payment allocation. Enables dealer-level accounts receivable reporting and performance tracking.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount applied during this allocation. Common in automotive dealer invoicing where prompt payment terms offer percentage discounts.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate of the cash discount applied. Typically defined in payment terms and calculated based on payment timing relative to invoice date.

attributes.name: dispute_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this allocation is under dispute. True indicates customer has contested the invoice or payment application.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the dispute reason. Captures customer explanation for contesting the allocation or invoice amount.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied when payment currency differs from invoice currency. Used for cross-currency allocation calculations and financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the allocation occurred. Supports monthly financial close and period-based reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the payment allocation occurred. Used for period-based financial reporting and accounts receivable aging analysis.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the payment allocation record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the payment allocation. Used for documenting special circumstances, manual adjustments, or customer communications.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the allocation was posted to the general ledger. May differ from allocation date due to period-end processing or backdated corrections.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center responsible for this revenue transaction. Used for internal management accounting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the allocation in the accounts receivable reconciliation process. Pending indicates awaiting reconciliation, reconciled indicates confirmed and balanced, exception indicates discrepancy requiring investigation, under_review indicates active reconciliation in progress.

attributes.name: remaining_invoice_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding balance remaining on the invoice after this allocation is applied. Zero indicates full settlement. Used for open item management and accounts receivable aging.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation was reversed. Null if allocation has not been reversed. Used for audit trail and accounts receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this allocation has been reversed. True indicates the allocation was subsequently undone, typically due to payment failure or correction.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for allocation reversal. Examples include payment failure, incorrect allocation, duplicate payment, or customer dispute.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date for cash flow and liquidity management. Represents when funds are actually available in the bank account.

products.name: credit_memo
products.description: Formal credit note issued to a dealer, retail customer, or fleet account to reverse or reduce a previously issued invoice charge. Captures credit memo number, originating invoice reference, credit reason code (return/pricing_error/warranty_adjustment/recall_allowance/volume_rebate/goodwill), credit amount, tax credit amount, issue date, approval status, approver, and the source system memo document reference. Supports dealer volume rebates, vehicle return credits, and service charge reversals.

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit memo record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aftersales_warranty_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warranty claim that this credit memo is compensating, if applicable.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved the credit memo. Supports audit trail and authorization compliance.

attributes.name: credit_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (dealer, retail customer, or fleet account) receiving the credit memo.

attributes.name: credit_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer receiving the credit memo, if applicable. Used for dealer-specific credits such as volume rebates or vehicle return credits.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer incentive program (e.g., volume rebate, promotional allowance) that this credit memo fulfills, if applicable.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Credit memos need a GL account for reversal entries in the ledger.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice that this credit memo is reversing or adjusting.

attributes.name: primary_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer receiving the credit memo, if applicable. Used for dealer-specific credits such as volume rebates or vehicle return credits.

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved the credit memo. Supports audit trail and authorization compliance.

attributes.name: primary_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (dealer, retail customer, or fleet account) receiving the credit memo.

attributes.name: recall_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recall campaign for which this credit memo provides dealer or customer compensation, if applicable.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Credit memos may be issued for a specific vehicle (e.g., warranty reimbursement); FK links credit adjustments to the vehicle record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was approved by the authorized approver. Distinct lifecycle event from issue and posting.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person who approved the credit memo. Provides human-readable audit information.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the credit memo was cancelled, if status is cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit memo record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the credit memo, typically following format CM followed by 10 digits. Used for customer communication and the source system reference.
attributes.references: SAP SD Credit Memo Document Standard

attributes.name: credit_memo_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit memo in the approval and posting workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|issued|posted|cancelled|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: credit_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the business reason for issuing the credit memo. Supports financial analysis and dispute resolution tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: return|pricing_error|warranty_adjustment|recall_allowance|volume_rebate|goodwill|service_reversal|parts_return|quality_claim|promotional_allowance — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Credit Memo Reason Codes

attributes.name: credit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit memo by its financial treatment and business purpose.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit memo transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: dispute_id
attributes.description: The dispute id of the credit memo.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: the source system channel through which the original sale and credit were processed (e.g., dealer network, fleet sales, direct retail).

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: the source system representing the product line or business unit (e.g., passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, parts, service).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the credit memo was posted. Supports monthly financial close and reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the credit memo was issued or posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: gross_credit_amount
attributes.description: Total credit amount before tax adjustments. Represents the base value being credited to the customer or dealer.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was officially issued to the customer or dealer. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle associated with this credit memo, if applicable. Supports product-line analysis of credits.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who last modified the credit memo record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit memo record was last modified. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: net_credit_amount
attributes.description: Total credit amount including tax. This is the final amount credited to the customer or dealer account.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments explaining the credit memo circumstances, approver rationale, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code from the source system how the credit will be applied (e.g., immediate credit, offset against future invoices).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was posted to the financial ledger in the source system for period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number provided by the customer or dealer for their internal tracking (e.g., dealer claim number, customer case number).

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the credit memo was rejected during approval workflow, if status is rejected.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: the source system organization responsible for the credit memo. Supports regional and organizational reporting.

attributes.name: sap_accounting_document
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP (Systems Applications and Products) Accounting Document Number
attributes.description: the source system document number generated when the credit memo was posted to the general ledger.

tag_set.value: SAP (Systems Applications and Products) Accounting Document Number

attributes.name: sap_billing_document
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP (Systems Applications and Products) Billing Document Number
attributes.description: the source system document number associated with this credit memo. Used for cross-reference to billing cycles.

tag_set.value: SAP (Systems Applications and Products) Billing Document Number

attributes.name: sap_credit_memo_document
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP (Systems Applications and Products) Credit Memo Document Number
attributes.description: the source system memo document number. Links this record to the source system of record for reconciliation and traceability.

tag_set.value: SAP (Systems Applications and Products) Credit Memo Document Number

attributes.name: tax_credit_amount
attributes.description: Tax portion of the credit memo. Reverses or adjusts the tax charged on the original invoice.

attributes.name: vehicle_model
attributes.description: Model name or code of the vehicle associated with this credit memo, if applicable.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who created the credit memo record in the system.

products.name: debit_memo
products.description: Formal debit note issued to a dealer or account to charge additional amounts not captured in the original invoice, such as freight adjustments, PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) charges, homologation fees, or price corrections. Captures debit memo number, originating invoice reference, debit reason code, charge amount, tax amount, issue date, approval status, and the source system memo document reference. Complements credit_memo for bilateral billing adjustments.

attributes.name: debit_memo_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the debit memo record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Debit memos adjust balances on a specific customer billing account; essential for accurate account reconciliation.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Debit memos require a GL account to record additional charges.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice that this debit memo adjusts or supplements. Links to the invoice product.

attributes.name: primary_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer or account being debited. Primary counterparty for this debit memo.

attributes.name: primary_debit_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer or account being debited. Primary counterparty for this debit memo.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Debit memos for parts or service are vehicle‑specific; FK enables accurate cost allocation and audit trails.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the debit memo. DRAFT indicates initial creation, PENDING_APPROVAL indicates awaiting finance approval, APPROVED indicates ready for posting, REJECTED indicates declined by approver, CANCELLED indicates voided before posting.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved the debit memo for posting. Null if not yet approved or approval not required.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the debit memo was approved. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: the source system representing the legal entity issuing the debit memo. Used for multi-entity financial consolidation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the debit memo record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this debit memo (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount being debited to the dealer or account before tax. Represents the base charge amount.
attributes.references: SAP FI Accounting Document Line Item Amount

attributes.name: debit_memo_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the debit memo, typically following a format like DM followed by 10 digits. Used for communication with dealers and in financial documents.

attributes.name: debit_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the business reason for issuing the debit memo. Common values include FREIGHT (freight adjustments), PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection charges), HOMOLOGATION (regulatory certification fees), PRICE_CORRECTION (price adjustments post-invoice), TOOLING (special tooling charges), ACCESSORY (additional accessory charges), LATE_FEE (late payment penalties), OTHER (miscellaneous charges). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FREIGHT|PDI|HOMOLOGATION|PRICE_CORRECTION|TOOLING|ACCESSORY|LATE_FEE|OTHER — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Billing Type / Reason Code

attributes.name: debit_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual explanation of why the debit memo was issued. Provides context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date when the dealer formally disputed the debit memo. Null if never disputed.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the dealer has disputed this debit memo. True if disputed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation provided by the dealer for disputing the debit memo. Null if not disputed.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: the source system channel through which the debit memo was issued (e.g., dealer network, fleet sales, direct sales).

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: the source system or product line associated with the debit memo (e.g., passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, parts).

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the dealer is expected to settle the debit memo amount. Calculated based on payment terms.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the debit memo was issued. Typically 1-12.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the debit memo was issued, based on the company's fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the debit memo was officially issued to the dealer. Represents the business event date for accounting and aging purposes.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the debit memo record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the debit memo record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form internal notes or comments about the debit memo for operational reference. Not shared with dealer.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the debit memo was fully paid or cleared by the dealer. Null if still unpaid.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment settlement status of the debit memo. Tracks whether the dealer has paid the debited amount.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the debit memo was posted to the financial ledger in the source system differ from issue_date due to batch processing.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number such as a purchase order, delivery note, or contract number that provides additional context for the debit memo.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when a disputed debit memo was resolved (either upheld, adjusted, or cancelled). Null if dispute is still open or never disputed.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Notes documenting how the dispute was resolved, including any adjustments or corrective actions taken.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: the source system organization responsible for the debit memo. Represents the selling unit or region.

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: the source system document number generated when the debit memo was posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: sap_sd_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Document Number
attributes.description: the source system document number for the debit memo. System-of-record reference for integration and reconciliation.

tag_set.value: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Document Number

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the debit memo. Includes sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of the debit memo including tax. Sum of debit_amount and tax_amount. This is the net amount charged to the dealer.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the debit memo record in the system.

products.name: account
products.description: Billing account master record representing the financial relationship between Automotive and a billing party (dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account). Captures account number, account type (dealer/retail/fleet/corporate/government), account name, billing address, payment terms, credit limit, credit exposure, currency, tax registration number, VAT ID, account status (active/suspended/closed), assigned credit controller, the source system account reference, and DMS account linkage for dealer accounts. Distinct from the customer identity record owned by the customer domain.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing account. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns a default cost center to the billing account for expense allocation.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Default GL account for all transactions posted from a billing account for consistent accounting.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Financial reporting requires mapping each billing account to a jurisdiction for tax and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent billing account for hierarchical account structures. Used for corporate accounts with multiple subsidiaries or dealer groups with multiple locations. Null for standalone accounts.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Account Management Report requires linking each billing account to its owning customer party for credit limits, statements, and compliance.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique account number assigned to the billing party. Used on invoices, statements, and payment correspondence. Typically alphanumeric format following internal numbering scheme.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing account. Active accounts can transact normally. Suspended accounts have temporary restrictions. Closed accounts are permanently terminated. Pending approval accounts await credit review. Blocked accounts cannot transact due to payment issues. Dormant accounts have no recent activity.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account based on the nature of the billing party. Dealer accounts are for franchise dealerships, retail for individual consumers, fleet for commercial fleet operators, corporate for B2B accounts, government for public sector entities, and export for international distributors.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in automatic payment processing. True when account has authorized automatic ACH, direct debit, or credit card charges for recurring invoices.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for billing correspondence and invoice delivery. First line of the billing party's registered address.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, apartment, building, or additional location details for billing correspondence.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary billing contact person. Used for invoice inquiries, payment confirmations, and account correspondence.

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary billing contact person at the billing party organization. Accounts payable manager, controller, or designated billing representative.

attributes.name: billing_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the billing contact. Used for payment inquiries, dispute resolution, and collections communication.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the billing address country (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, DEU, CHN, JPN).

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the billing address. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional administrative division for the billing address. Format varies by country (e.g., two-letter US state codes, Canadian province codes).

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the billing account was permanently closed. Null for active, suspended, or dormant accounts. Set when account status transitions to closed after final settlement.
attributes.references: SAP FI Customer Master Deletion Date

attributes.name: consolidated_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account receives consolidated invoices combining multiple transactions or sub-accounts into a single statement. Common for fleet and corporate accounts with multiple locations or cost centers.

attributes.name: credit_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent credit review or credit check performed for this account. Credit reviews are typically performed at account opening, annually, or when credit limit increase is requested.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Current total outstanding receivables balance for this account, including open invoices and unbilled charges. Updated in near-real-time as transactions post. Compared against credit limit for credit control decisions.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding receivables balance allowed for this account before credit hold is triggered. Expressed in the account's base currency. Set by credit management based on creditworthiness assessment.

attributes.name: credit_rating_code
attributes.description: Internal or external credit rating assigned to the billing party. AAA is highest creditworthiness, D is default, NR is not rated. Used for credit limit determination and risk management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D|NR — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account's base transactional currency (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD, MXN, CNY, JPY). All invoices and payments for this account are denominated in this currency unless explicitly converted.

attributes.name: dispute_count_ytd
attributes.description: Number of billing disputes or invoice challenges raised by this account in the current fiscal year. Used to identify problematic accounts and improve billing accuracy.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: the source system code indicating how products reach this account (e.g., direct sales, dealer network, fleet sales, export). Affects pricing and terms determination.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: the source system representing the product line or business unit (e.g., passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, parts, service). Used for revenue segmentation and reporting.

attributes.name: dms_account_code
attributes.description: External account identifier from the dealer management system (CDK Global DMS) for dealer accounts. Used to link billing account to dealer inventory, service, and F&I transactions. Null for non-dealer account types.

attributes.name: dunning_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated dunning (collections) notices are blocked for this account. True when account is in dispute resolution, payment plan, or has special handling requirements.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning (collections) level for overdue accounts. Ranges from 0 (no overdue) to higher numbers indicating escalating collection actions. Drives automated dunning letter generation and collection workflow.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for delivering invoices and statements to the billing party. Email for electronic delivery, postal mail for paper, EDI for automated B2B integration, portal for self-service access, fax for legacy systems.

attributes.name: invoice_email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic invoice and statement delivery. Used when invoice delivery method is email or as backup contact for portal notifications.

attributes.name: last_invoice_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent invoice issued to this account. Used to identify dormant accounts and track billing activity patterns.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment received from this account in the account's base currency. Used for payment pattern analysis and collections strategy.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received from this account. Used for credit assessment, collections prioritization, and customer relationship management.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Legal or registered name of the billing party. For dealers, this is the dealership legal entity name. For retail customers, the individual or household name. For fleet/corporate, the company legal name.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the billing account was first established and activated. Marks the beginning of the financial relationship.
attributes.references: SAP FI Customer Master Creation Date

attributes.name: payment_method_preference
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for this account. Wire transfer and ACH for electronic payments, check for paper payments, credit card for retail, direct debit for recurring charges, letter of credit for export accounts.

attributes.name: payment_performance_score
attributes.description: Calculated score (0-100) representing the account's payment timeliness and reliability. Based on historical payment patterns, days sales outstanding, and dispute frequency. Higher scores indicate better payment performance.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount conditions (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30). Maps to the source system terms master data.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date until payment is due. Derived from payment terms code but stored for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was first created in the data platform. System-generated audit field.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was last modified in the data platform. System-generated audit field updated on every change.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: the source system code responsible for this billing account. Defines the organizational unit for sales and distribution processes, pricing, and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: sap_customer_number
attributes.description: the source system account number (KUNNR) in the ERP system. Ten-digit numeric identifier used for financial postings, invoice generation, and payment application. Primary system of record reference.

attributes.name: ssot_governance_note
attributes.description: SSOT owner for invoice_line entity. Other domains reference this via FK.

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the billing party. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., EIN in USA, GST number in Canada, RFC in Mexico, VAT number in EU). Used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: vat_number
attributes.description: VAT registration identifier for EU and other VAT jurisdictions. Required for cross-border invoicing and VAT reclaim. Format follows country-specific VAT ID structure.

products.name: receivable
products.description: Open accounts receivable item representing an outstanding amount owed by a billing account against a specific invoice. Tracks original invoice amount, outstanding balance, due date, days past due, aging bucket (current/30/60/90/120+), dunning level, last dunning date, dispute flag, dispute reference, write-off flag, and the source system item reference. SSOT for AR aging and collections management across dealer, retail, and fleet receivables.
products.reference: SAP FI Accounts Receivable Open Item

attributes.name: receivable_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable item. Primary key for the receivable product. Represents a single open item in the AR ledger.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account (dealer, retail customer, or fleet account) that owes this receivable. Represents the debtor party.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source invoice that generated this receivable. Links to the originating billing document in the source system

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active payment plan agreement if payment_plan_flag is true. Links to payment plan schedule and terms.

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collections agent or team assigned to pursue this receivable. Used for workload distribution and performance tracking.

attributes.name: receivable_collector_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collections agent or team assigned to pursue this receivable. Used for workload distribution and performance tracking.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Standard aging classification bucket based on days past due. Used for AR aging reports, bad debt provisioning, and collections prioritization.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date the receivable was fully closed (paid, written off, or otherwise resolved). Null for open receivables. Used for DSO calculation and historical analysis.

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current status of collection efforts for overdue receivables. Tracks progression through collections workflow from initial contact to legal action. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|in_progress|on_hold|escalated|legal|resolved|abandoned — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center responsible for the revenue transaction that generated this receivable. Used for profitability analysis and management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this receivable record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the debtor account is on credit hold due to this or other overdue receivables. Credit hold blocks new orders and shipments.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the receivable amounts. Supports multi-currency operations across global dealer networks and export markets.

attributes.name: customer_type
attributes.description: Segment classification of the debtor. Distinguishes dealer network, retail consumers, fleet operators, government entities, rental companies, and leasing firms.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the receivable is overdue. Calculated as current date minus due date for unpaid balances. Zero or negative for current receivables.

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Dealer code if the receivable is from a dealer network transaction. Links to dealer master data for dealer-specific AR aging and floor plan management.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date the dispute was raised by the debtor. Used to track dispute aging and resolution SLA compliance.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the receivable is currently under dispute by the debtor. Disputed receivables are excluded from dunning and may be placed on payment hold.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the dispute if dispute_flag is true. Categorizes the nature of the customer objection for resolution tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pricing_error|quantity_discrepancy|quality_issue|delivery_problem|warranty_claim|incentive_disagreement|billing_error|not_disputed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: External reference number for the dispute case. Links to dispute resolution system or customer service ticket.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which payment is expected. Calculated from invoice date plus payment terms. Used to determine days past due and aging bucket.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning escalation level for overdue receivables. Increments with each dunning run. Zero indicates no dunning action taken.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code where this receivable is posted. Typically an AR control account in the balance sheet.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the originating invoice was issued. Represents the business event timestamp when the receivable was created.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent contact attempt with the debtor regarding this receivable. Includes phone calls, emails, and letters.

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent dunning notice was sent to the debtor. Used to calculate next dunning run eligibility and escalation timing.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this receivable record. Tracks changes to balance, status, or dispute information.

attributes.name: next_dunning_date
attributes.description: Calculated date for the next dunning notice. Based on dunning frequency configuration and last dunning date.

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: Original gross amount of the receivable at invoice creation. Represents the initial debt obligation before any payments or adjustments.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid balance remaining on the receivable. Calculated as original amount minus payments, credits, and adjustments. SSOT for AR aging reports.

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the debtor is on an approved payment plan for this receivable. Payment plan receivables follow modified dunning rules.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms governing the receivable. Defines the number of days until payment is due and any early payment discounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_30|net_45|net_60|net_90|due_on_receipt|2_10_net_30|custom — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center for internal P&L reporting. Represents the business unit or product line that earned this revenue.

attributes.name: receivable_number
attributes.description: Business-facing document number for the receivable item. Externally visible identifier used in collections correspondence and dunning letters.

attributes.name: receivable_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the receivable. Tracks progression from open through payment, dispute, collections, or write-off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|partially_paid|paid|disputed|written_off|under_collection|legal_action — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: receivable_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receivable by business transaction type. Distinguishes vehicle sales, parts, service, warranty, fleet, incentive recovery, and finance charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vehicle_sale|parts_sale|service_charge|warranty_reimbursement|fleet_invoice|incentive_recovery|finance_charge — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: Geographic sales region where the transaction occurred. Used for regional revenue and collections performance analysis.

attributes.name: sap_fi_company_code
attributes.description: the source system representing the legal entity that owns this receivable. Used for multi-entity consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: the source system document number for the open item. SSOT reference for reconciliation with the source system and subledger.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character VIN if the receivable is related to a specific vehicle sale. Links to vehicle master data for vehicle-level revenue tracking.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount written off as bad debt. May differ from outstanding balance if partial recovery was achieved before write-off.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date the receivable was written off. Represents the accounting period when the bad debt expense was recognized.

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the receivable has been written off as uncollectible bad debt. Written-off receivables are removed from active AR aging.

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the write-off decision. Documents the business justification for recognizing bad debt expense. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bankruptcy|insolvency|uncollectible|customer_closure|legal_settlement|small_balance|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: dispute
products.description: Formal dispute record raised by a dealer, fleet operator, or retail customer contesting an invoice charge, credit memo, or payment application. Captures dispute number, dispute type (pricing/quantity/quality/duplicate/unauthorized_charge/warranty), disputed invoice reference, disputed amount, dispute open date, dispute status (open/under_review/resolved/escalated/closed), resolution type (accepted/rejected/partial_credit), resolution date, resolution notes, assigned dispute analyst, and escalation history. Supports the source system management integration.

attributes.name: dispute_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing dispute record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Dispute management tracks which billing account a dispute concerns, required for account‑level dispute reporting.

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Reference to the credit memo issued as a result of the dispute resolution, if applicable. Null if no credit was issued.

attributes.name: dispute_assigned_analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispute analyst or customer service representative assigned to investigate and resolve the dispute.

attributes.name: disputing_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer, dealer, or fleet operator who raised the dispute. Links to the appropriate master data entity based on disputing_party_type.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice being disputed. Links to the billing invoice record in the billing domain.

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispute analyst or customer service representative assigned to investigate and resolve the dispute.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or division responsible for the disputed invoice (e.g., Parts, Service, Vehicle Sales, Fleet).

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date when the dispute was formally closed in the system after resolution and all follow-up actions completed.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the disputing party for correspondence regarding this dispute.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person at the disputing party for verbal communication regarding this dispute.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dispute record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: credited_amount
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount credited back to the disputing party as a result of the resolution. May be less than, equal to, or zero relative to disputed_amount.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the disputed amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: dispute_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the dispute, formatted as DSP- followed by 10 digits. Used in customer and dealer communications.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dispute: open (newly raised), under_review (being investigated), resolved (solution agreed), escalated (sent to higher authority), closed (finalized), withdrawn (cancelled by disputing party).

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dispute reason: pricing (incorrect price applied), quantity (billed quantity mismatch), quality (defective parts or service), duplicate (duplicate billing), unauthorized_charge (charge not authorized), warranty (warranty coverage dispute).

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value being contested by the disputing party, in the invoice currency.

attributes.name: disputing_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity raising the dispute: dealer (authorized dealer), fleet_operator (commercial fleet customer), retail_customer (individual buyer), internal (internal business unit).

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date when the dispute was escalated to a higher authority level. Null if never escalated.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The current escalation tier of the dispute: 0 (no escalation), 1 (supervisor review), 2 (manager review), 3 (director review), 4 (executive review).

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the dispute required escalation beyond the initial analyst level.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dispute record was last updated in the system, in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: The date when the dispute was formally raised and entered into the system.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the dispute based on amount, customer tier, and business impact: low, medium, high, critical.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text explanation provided by the disputing party describing the reason for the dispute and supporting details.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the dispute was received by the billing department, in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter geographic region code where the disputing party is located (e.g., USA, EUR, CHN).

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date when the dispute was resolved and a final decision was communicated to the disputing party.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the resolution decision, actions taken, and justification for the outcome.

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: The outcome classification of the dispute resolution: accepted (dispute valid, full credit issued), rejected (dispute invalid, no action), partial_credit (compromise reached), adjustment (invoice corrected), waiver (charge waived as goodwill).

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying cause identified during dispute investigation: billing_error, system_error, data_entry_error, policy_misunderstanding, delivery_issue, quality_issue.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute resolution exceeded the SLA target resolution time. True if breached, False if within SLA.

attributes.name: sla_target_resolution_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Resolution Days
attributes.description: The number of business days within which the dispute should be resolved according to the applicable SLA policy.

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Resolution Days

attributes.name: supporting_document_count
attributes.description: The number of supporting documents (invoices, delivery notes, quality reports, photos) attached to the dispute case.

products.name: dealer_statement
products.description: Periodic account statement issued to a dealer summarizing all invoices, credit memos, debit memos, payments, and open balances within a statement period. Captures statement number, dealer account reference, statement period start/end dates, opening balance, total charges, total credits, total payments received, closing balance, statement status (draft/issued/acknowledged), and CDK Global DMS statement reference. Supports dealer reconciliation and floorplan financing reporting.

attributes.name: dealer_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer statement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: dealer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Dealer statements are issued per dealer account; linking to the master account removes the redundant dealer_account_number column.

attributes.name: dealer_issued_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that issued this statement.

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership receiving this statement.

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that issued this statement.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_30_days_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is 1-30 days past due.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_60_days_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is 31-60 days past due.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_90_days_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is 61-90 days past due.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_current_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is current and not yet past due.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_over_90_days_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is more than 90 days past due.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle or schedule under which this statement was generated.
attributes.references: SAP SD Billing Schedule Master Data

attributes.name: cdk_statement_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier from CDK Global DMS linking this statement to the dealer management system record.

attributes.name: closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding balance at the end of the statement period, calculated as opening balance plus charges minus credits and payments.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: the source system representing the legal entity issuing this statement.
attributes.references: SAP FI Company Code Master Data

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dealer statement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this statement.

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount under dispute by the dealer, if any.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer has raised a dispute or discrepancy regarding this statement.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Code representing the reason for the dispute, such as pricing error, quantity discrepancy, or missing credit.
attributes.references: SAP FI Dispute Reason Master Data

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: the source system code indicating the route to market for this statement.
attributes.references: SAP SD Distribution Channel Master Data

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year for this statement.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this statement period falls, used for financial reporting and period alignment.

attributes.name: floorplan_financing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this statement includes floorplan financing charges or is relevant for floorplan reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dealer statement record was last updated.

attributes.name: opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding balance carried forward from the previous statement period.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the dealer is expected to remit payment for the closing balance.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms applicable to this statement, such as net 30, net 60, or custom terms.
attributes.references: SAP SD Payment Terms Master Data

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dealer acknowledged and reconciled this statement with their own records.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: the source system code responsible for this dealer statement.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Organization Master Data

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statement was generated and issued to the dealer.

attributes.name: statement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or instructions related to this statement.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the dealer statement, externally visible and used for dealer reconciliation and reference.
attributes.references: SAP SD Billing Document Number Standard

attributes.name: statement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the billing period covered by this statement.

attributes.name: statement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the billing period covered by this statement.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dealer statement indicating its processing stage.

attributes.name: statement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the statement based on its frequency or purpose.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Statement Type Classification

attributes.name: total_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all manual adjustments applied to the dealer account during the statement period, including corrections and write-offs.
attributes.references: SAP FI Manual Journal Entry Standard

attributes.name: total_credit_memo_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all credit memos issued to the dealer during the statement period, reducing the amount owed.

attributes.name: total_debit_memo_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all debit memos issued to the dealer during the statement period, increasing the amount owed.

attributes.name: total_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all dealer incentives, rebates, and promotional credits applied during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_invoice_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all invoices issued to the dealer during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_parts_sales_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all parts sales invoices included in this statement period.

attributes.name: total_payment_received_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all payments received from the dealer during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_service_charges_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all service and labor charges included in this statement period.

attributes.name: total_vehicle_sales_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all vehicle sales invoices included in this statement period.

attributes.name: total_warranty_reimbursement_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all warranty claim reimbursements credited to the dealer during the statement period.

products.name: fleet_statement

attributes.name: fleet_statement_id

attributes.name: customer_fleet_account_id

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fleet statement was approved for issuance to the customer.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address for the fleet account customer.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address for the fleet account customer.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the billing address for the fleet account customer.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing cycle covered by this statement.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_start_date

attributes.name: billing_postal_code

attributes.name: billing_state_province

attributes.name: contact_name

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fleet statement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this statement.

attributes.name: delivery_email
attributes.description: Email address to which the statement is sent, if delivery method is email.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the statement is delivered to the fleet account customer.

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of charges currently under dispute on this statement.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any charges on this statement are currently under dispute by the fleet account customer.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment for this statement is due from the fleet account customer.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which this statement was issued.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this statement was issued, used for financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: fleet_management_fees
attributes.description: Recurring or one-time fleet management and administration fees charged during the billing cycle.

attributes.name: fuel_charges
attributes.description: Total fuel charges billed to the fleet account during the billing cycle, if applicable.

attributes.name: insurance_charges
attributes.description: Insurance premium charges for fleet vehicles during the billing cycle, if managed by OEM.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fleet statement record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this fleet statement, such as special instructions or explanations.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Total amount due from the fleet account after applying charges, credits, and payments.

attributes.name: parts_charges
attributes.description: Total charges for parts supplied to the fleet account during the billing cycle.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms applicable to this statement, such as Net 30, Net 60, or custom negotiated terms.

attributes.name: previous_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding balance carried forward from the previous billing statement.

attributes.name: service_charges

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fleet statement was issued to the customer.

attributes.name: statement_number

attributes.name: statement_status

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: tco_summary_flag
