products.name: homologation_variant
products.description: Defines market-specific homologation variants of a base SKU required to meet local regulatory standards (UNECE, FMVSS, ADR, etc.). Captures homologation variant code, base SKU reference, target market/country, regulatory standard (UNECE/FMVSS/ADR/CARB), required modification description, homologation approval number, approval authority, approval date, expiry date, and variant status. Bridges the commercial product catalog to the compliance domain's regulatory approval records.

attributes.name: homologation_variant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the homologation variant record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aftersales_trim_level_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific trim level or configuration within the nameplate that this homologation variant applies to. Nullable if variant applies to all trims.

attributes.name: nameplate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle nameplate (model line) that this homologation variant applies to. Links to the nameplate master data.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the base commercial SKU that this homologation variant is derived from. Links to the product catalog SKU master.

attributes.name: adas_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Automation Level
attributes.description: SAE automation level for the ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) features included in this homologation variant, ranging from Level 0 (no automation) to Level 5 (full automation).

tag_set.value: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Automation Level

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency, regulatory body, or authorized technical service that issued the homologation approval. Examples include NHTSA, EPA, CARB, TÜV, or national transport ministries.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority officially granted homologation approval for this variant. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approval_number
attributes.description: Official approval or certification number issued by the regulatory authority upon successful homologation. This number is typically required for vehicle registration and sales in the target market.

attributes.name: bom_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this homologation variant requires changes to the base SKU Bill of Materials. True if BOM modifications are needed, False if only calibration or documentation changes are required.

attributes.name: cafe_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this homologation variant is certified for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) compliance in the United States market. Applicable to US market variants only.

tag_set.value: Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) Compliance Flag

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to regulatory compliance, testing requirements, or market-specific considerations for this homologation variant.

attributes.name: cost_delta_amount
attributes.description: Incremental cost associated with implementing this homologation variant compared to the base SKU, including parts, labor, testing, and certification fees. Expressed in the currency specified in cost_delta_currency.

attributes.name: cost_delta_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_delta_amount field.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this homologation variant record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this homologation variant becomes valid and vehicles can be legally sold or registered in the target market. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: emissions_standard_target
attributes.description: Specific emissions standard or tier that this homologation variant is designed to meet, such as Euro 6d, EPA Tier 3, CARB LEV III, or China 6b.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this homologation approval expires or becomes invalid, requiring renewal or re-certification. Nullable for approvals without expiration. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this homologation variant record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Typical lead time in days required to obtain homologation approval for this variant from the date of submission to the regulatory authority.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year designation for which this homologation variant is applicable. Aligns with the automotive industry model year convention.

attributes.name: modification_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the technical modifications, component changes, or configuration adjustments required to meet the target market regulatory requirements. May reference specific parts, calibrations, or design changes.

attributes.name: modification_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the type of modification required for homologation compliance, such as hardware changes, software updates, calibration adjustments, documentation updates, labeling changes, or additional testing.

attributes.name: ncap_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Car Assessment Programme (NCAP) Safety Rating
attributes.description: Safety rating achieved by this homologation variant under the applicable NCAP (New Car Assessment Programme) testing protocol, such as Euro NCAP, US NCAP, or ANCAP. Typically expressed as a star rating or score.

tag_set.value: New Car Assessment Programme (NCAP) Safety Rating

attributes.name: ota_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this homologation variant includes OTA (Over-the-Air) update capability for software and firmware updates. Relevant for regulatory compliance with evolving software update requirements.

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Type of powertrain for which this homologation variant is certified. ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle).

attributes.name: regulatory_category
attributes.description: Classification of the primary regulatory domain this variant addresses, such as safety standards, emissions controls, environmental compliance, or fuel economy requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Safety|Emissions|Environmental|Fuel Economy|Crash Test|Lighting|Braking|Occupant Protection — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_standard
attributes.description: Primary regulatory standard or framework that this homologation variant must comply with. Examples include UNECE (United Nations Economic Commission for Europe), FMVSS (Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards), ADR (Australian Design Rules), CARB (California Air Resources Board). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UNECE|FMVSS|ADR|CARB|EPA|Euro NCAP|IATF 16949|ISO 14001 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this homologation approval requires periodic renewal or re-certification. True if renewal is mandated by the regulatory authority, False if approval is perpetual or tied to model year.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer
attributes.description: Name of the engineer or technical specialist responsible for managing the homologation process and regulatory compliance for this variant.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the homologation application and supporting documentation were submitted to the regulatory authority for review. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: target_market_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code representing the target market or jurisdiction for which this homologation variant is certified.

attributes.name: target_region
attributes.description: Broader geographic region classification for the target market, used for regional compliance grouping and reporting.

attributes.name: test_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the official test report(s) submitted as part of the homologation application. Links to laboratory test results, crash test data, emissions testing, or other certification evidence.

attributes.name: testing_laboratory
attributes.description: Name of the accredited testing laboratory or technical service that conducted the homologation testing and issued the test reports.

attributes.name: variant_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying this specific homologation variant within the product catalog. Used for internal tracking and cross-referencing with regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: variant_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation for this homologation variant, typically including market and regulatory standard identifiers.

attributes.name: variant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the homologation variant in the approval and production process. Tracks progression from initial submission through approval, active use, and eventual expiration or withdrawal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Draft|Submitted|Under Review|Approved|Active|Suspended|Expired|Withdrawn|Rejected — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `automotive_ecm`.`_metrics`.`aftersales_dtc_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Quality and compliance metrics derived from diagnostic trouble code events"
  source: "`automotive_ecm`.`aftersales`.`aftersales_dtc_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "dtc_category"
      expr: dtc_category
      comment: "High‑level category of the DTC"
    - name: "dtc_code"
      expr: dtc_code
      comment: "Specific DTC code identifier"
    - name: "dtc_status"
      expr: dtc_status
      comment: "Current status of the DTC (e.g., active, pending)"
    - name: "severity_level"
      expr: severity_level
      comment: "Severity rating of the DTC"
    - name: "service_center_id"
      expr: service_center_id
      comment: "Service center where the DTC was recorded"
    - name: "event_type"
      expr: event_type
      comment: "Type of diagnostic event"
    - name: "event_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('day', event_timestamp)
      comment: "Date the DTC event occurred"
    - name: "warranty_covered_flag"
      expr: warranty_covered_flag
      comment: "Indicates if the DTC is covered under warranty"
  measures:
    - name: "total_events"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of DTC events captured"
    - name: "distinct_vehicles_affected"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT vin_registry_id)
      comment: "Number of unique vehicles that generated DTC events"
    - name: "cleared_event_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN cleared_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of DTC events that have been cleared"
    - name: "emission_related_event_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN emission_related_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of DTC events related to emissions"
$$
metric_views.description: Quality and compliance metrics derived from diagnostic trouble code events

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`aftersales_parts_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Aftersales parts order fulfillment and revenue metrics. Tracks parts order volume, value, backorder rates, and freight costs to optimize parts supply chain and dealer profitability."
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`aftersales`.`aftersales_parts_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "parts_order_status"
      expr: aftersales_parts_order_status
      comment: "Current status of the parts order (e.g., open, confirmed, shipped, delivered, closed)"
    - name: "parts_order_type"
      expr: aftersales_parts_order_type
      comment: "Type of parts order (e.g., stock, emergency, warranty, recall)"
    - name: "backorder_flag"
      expr: backorder_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the parts order has backordered items"
    - name: "priority_flag"
      expr: priority_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the parts order is marked as priority"
    - name: "shipping_method"
      expr: shipping_method
      comment: "Shipping method used for the parts order (e.g., ground, air, express)"
    - name: "freight_terms"
      expr: freight_terms
      comment: "Freight terms for the parts order (e.g., FOB, CIF, prepaid)"
    - name: "order_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the parts order was placed"
    - name: "requested_delivery_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', requested_delivery_date)
      comment: "Month when delivery was requested"
    - name: "actual_delivery_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', actual_delivery_date)
      comment: "Month when the parts order was actually delivered"
  measures:
    - name: "total_parts_orders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of parts orders placed"
    - name: "total_parts_order_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_order_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total value of all parts orders, key aftersales revenue metric"
    - name: "total_net_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_total AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net amount of parts orders excluding tax"
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount on parts orders"
    - name: "total_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total discount amount applied to parts orders"
    - name: "total_freight_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(freight_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total freight cost for parts orders, key logistics cost metric"
    - name: "avg_parts_order_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_order_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average value per parts order"
    - name: "avg_freight_cost_per_order"
      expr: AVG(CAST(freight_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average freight cost per parts order"
    - name: "backorder_orders"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN backorder_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of parts orders with backordered items"
    - name: "backorder_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN backorder_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of parts orders with backorders, indicating parts availability issues"
    - name: "priority_orders"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN priority_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of priority parts orders"
    - name: "priority_order_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN priority_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of parts orders marked as priority, indicating urgency level"
    - name: "discount_penetration_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_order_value AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Discount amount as a percentage of total order value, indicating pricing pressure"
    - name: "freight_cost_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(freight_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_order_value AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Freight cost as a percentage of total order value, key logistics efficiency metric"
    - name: "unique_dealerships_ordering"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT primary_aftersales_dealership_id)
      comment: "Number of unique dealerships placing parts orders, indicating network engagement"
$$
metric_views.description: Aftersales parts order fulfillment and revenue metrics. Tracks parts order volume, value, backorder rates, and freight costs to optimize parts supply chain and dealer profitability.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`aftersales_repair_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core aftersales service revenue, labor efficiency, and customer satisfaction metrics derived from repair orders. Tracks service revenue, labor hours, parts costs, warranty vs. retail mix, and customer feedback scores."
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`aftersales`.`aftersales_repair_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "service_type"
      expr: service_type
      comment: "Type of service performed (e.g., scheduled maintenance, repair, diagnostic)"
    - name: "service_priority"
      expr: service_priority
      comment: "Priority level of the repair order (e.g., urgent, standard, low)"
    - name: "repair_order_status"
      expr: aftersales_repair_order_status
      comment: "Current status of the repair order (e.g., open, in-progress, completed, closed)"
    - name: "warranty_flag"
      expr: warranty_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the repair order is covered under warranty"
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Payment status of the repair order (e.g., paid, pending, unpaid)"
    - name: "customer_feedback_score"
      expr: customer_feedback_score
      comment: "Customer satisfaction score for the repair order"
    - name: "open_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', open_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the repair order was opened"
    - name: "close_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', close_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the repair order was closed"
    - name: "service_center_region"
      expr: service_center_region
      comment: "Geographic region of the service center"
  measures:
    - name: "total_repair_orders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of repair orders"
    - name: "total_service_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue from all repair orders including labor, parts, and tax"
    - name: "total_labor_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(labor_total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total labor cost across all repair orders"
    - name: "total_parts_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(parts_total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total parts cost across all repair orders"
    - name: "total_labor_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(labor_total_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total labor hours consumed across all repair orders"
    - name: "avg_labor_hours_per_ro"
      expr: AVG(CAST(labor_total_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average labor hours per repair order, indicating service complexity"
    - name: "avg_service_revenue_per_ro"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average revenue per repair order, a key aftersales profitability metric"
    - name: "warranty_repair_orders"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN warranty_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of repair orders covered under warranty"
    - name: "warranty_penetration_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN warranty_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of repair orders that are warranty claims, indicating warranty cost exposure"
    - name: "labor_revenue_mix"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(labor_total_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Labor cost as a percentage of total service revenue, key margin driver"
    - name: "parts_revenue_mix"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(parts_total_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Parts cost as a percentage of total service revenue, key margin driver"
    - name: "avg_labor_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(labor_rate_per_hour AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average labor rate per hour charged across repair orders"
    - name: "unique_vehicles_serviced"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT vin_registry_id)
      comment: "Number of unique vehicles serviced, indicating service network reach"
    - name: "unique_customers_serviced"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT primary_party_id)
      comment: "Number of unique customers serviced, indicating customer base engagement"
$$
metric_views.description: Core aftersales service revenue, labor efficiency, and customer satisfaction metrics derived from repair orders. Tracks service revenue, labor hours, parts costs, warranty vs. retail mix, and customer feedback scores.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`aftersales_service_appointment`

LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Service appointment scheduling, utilization, and customer experience metrics. Tracks appointment volume, no-show rates, labor time, and customer satisfaction to optimize service center operations."
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`aftersales`.`aftersales_service_appointment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "service_appointment_status"
      expr: aftersales_service_appointment_status
      comment: "Current status of the service appointment (e.g., scheduled, confirmed, in-progress, completed, cancelled)"

      expr: service_type
      comment: "Type of service scheduled (e.g., maintenance, repair, inspection)"
    - name: "service_category"
      expr: service_category
      comment: "Category of service (e.g., routine, diagnostic, warranty)"
    - name: "service_priority"
      expr: service_priority
      comment: "Priority level of the service appointment"
    - name: "warranty_flag"
      expr: warranty_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the service appointment is for warranty work"
    - name: "recall_flag"
      expr: recall_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the service appointment is for recall work"
    - name: "no_show_flag"
      expr: no_show_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the customer did not show up for the appointment"
    - name: "is_first_time_customer"
      expr: is_first_time_customer
      comment: "Indicates whether this is the customer's first service appointment"
    - name: "is_repeat_service"
      expr: is_repeat_service
      comment: "Indicates whether this is a repeat service for the same issue"
    - name: "required_parts_flag"
      expr: required_parts_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether parts are required for the service"
    - name: "transportation_option"
      expr: transportation_option

    - name: "customer_feedback_score"

    - name: "scheduled_month"

    - name: "check_in_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', check_in_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the customer checked in for the appointment"
    - name: "source"
      expr: source

  measures:
    - name: "total_service_appointments"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of service appointments scheduled"
    - name: "total_actual_service_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_actual_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual revenue from completed service appointments"
    - name: "total_estimated_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated revenue from service appointments"
    - name: "total_estimated_net_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated net amount from service appointments"
    - name: "total_parts_actual_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(parts_actual_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual parts cost from service appointments"
    - name: "total_labor_time_actual_minutes"
      expr: SUM(CAST(labor_time_actual_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual labor time in minutes across all service appointments"
    - name: "total_estimated_duration_minutes"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_duration_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated duration in minutes for all service appointments"
    - name: "avg_actual_service_revenue"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_actual_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual revenue per service appointment"
    - name: "avg_labor_time_actual_minutes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(labor_time_actual_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual labor time per service appointment in minutes"
    - name: "avg_estimated_duration_minutes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_duration_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated duration per service appointment in minutes"
    - name: "no_show_appointments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN no_show_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of service appointments where the customer did not show up"
    - name: "no_show_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN no_show_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of service appointments with no-shows, indicating scheduling efficiency"
    - name: "warranty_appointments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN warranty_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of service appointments for warranty work"
    - name: "recall_appointments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN recall_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of service appointments for recall work"
    - name: "first_time_customer_appointments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_first_time_customer = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of service appointments for first-time customers"
    - name: "repeat_service_appointments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_repeat_service = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of service appointments for repeat service on the same issue"
    - name: "repeat_service_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_repeat_service = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of appointments that are repeat services, indicating quality issues"
    - name: "unique_vehicles_serviced"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT vin_registry_id)
      comment: "Number of unique vehicles serviced via appointments"
    - name: "unique_customers_serviced"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT primary_party_id)
      comment: "Number of unique customers with service appointments"
$$
metric_views.description: Service appointment scheduling, utilization, and customer experience metrics. Tracks appointment volume, no-show rates, labor time, and customer satisfaction to optimize service center operations.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`aftersales_warranty_claim`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Warranty claim cost, approval rates, and quality feedback metrics. Tracks warranty expense, claim approval/rejection patterns, and goodwill adjustments to inform warranty reserve planning and quality improvement."
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`aftersales`.`aftersales_warranty_claim`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "warranty_claim_status"
      expr: aftersales_warranty_claim_status
      comment: "Current status of the warranty claim (e.g., submitted, approved, rejected, paid)"
    - name: "warranty_type"
      expr: warranty_type
      comment: "Type of warranty coverage (e.g., powertrain, bumper-to-bumper, extended)"
    - name: "warranty_claim_category"
      expr: aftersales_warranty_claim_category
      comment: "Category of the warranty claim (e.g., mechanical, electrical, body)"
    - name: "goodwill_flag"
      expr: goodwill_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the claim includes a goodwill adjustment outside warranty terms"
    - name: "adjusted_flag"
      expr: adjusted_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the claim amount was adjusted after initial submission"
    - name: "rejection_reason_code"
      expr: rejection_reason_code
      comment: "Code indicating the reason for claim rejection, if applicable"
    - name: "submission_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', submission_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the warranty claim was submitted"
    - name: "failure_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', failure_date)
      comment: "Month when the failure occurred that triggered the warranty claim"
    - name: "repair_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', repair_date)
      comment: "Month when the warranty repair was completed"
  measures:
    - name: "total_warranty_claims"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of warranty claims submitted"
    - name: "total_warranty_claim_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_claim_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount claimed under warranty, a key warranty reserve and cost metric"
    - name: "total_approved_labor_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(approved_labor_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total approved labor cost for warranty claims"
    - name: "total_approved_parts_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(approved_parts_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total approved parts cost for warranty claims"
    - name: "total_approved_labor_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(approved_labor_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total approved labor hours for warranty claims"
    - name: "avg_warranty_claim_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_claim_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average warranty claim amount, indicating typical warranty cost per incident"
    - name: "avg_approved_labor_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(approved_labor_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average approved labor hours per warranty claim"
    - name: "avg_labor_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(labor_rate_per_hour AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average labor rate per hour for warranty claims"
    - name: "approved_claims"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN aftersales_warranty_claim_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of approved warranty claims"
    - name: "rejected_claims"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN aftersales_warranty_claim_status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of rejected warranty claims"
    - name: "claim_approval_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN aftersales_warranty_claim_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of warranty claims approved, indicating claim quality and policy adherence"
    - name: "goodwill_claims"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN goodwill_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of warranty claims with goodwill adjustments"
    - name: "goodwill_claim_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN goodwill_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of claims involving goodwill, indicating customer satisfaction intervention"
    - name: "adjusted_claims"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN adjusted_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of warranty claims that were adjusted after initial submission"
    - name: "unique_vehicles_with_claims"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT vin_registry_id)
      comment: "Number of unique vehicles with warranty claims, indicating quality issue spread"
    - name: "unique_customers_with_claims"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT primary_party_id)
      comment: "Number of unique customers filing warranty claims"
$$
metric_views.description: Warranty claim cost, approval rates, and quality feedback metrics. Tracks warranty expense, claim approval/rejection patterns, and goodwill adjustments to inform warranty reserve planning and quality improvement.

      expr: CASE WHEN compliance_gap_mpg > 0 THEN 'Below Target' WHEN compliance_gap_mpg < 0 THEN 'Above Target' ELSE 'On Target' END

      comment: "Average actual CAFE fuel economy achieved across fleet - key performance indicator"
    - name: "avg_required_cafe_mpg"
      expr: AVG(CAST(required_cafe_mpg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average required CAFE fuel economy target - regulatory benchmark"
    - name: "avg_compliance_gap_mpg"
      expr: AVG(CAST(compliance_gap_mpg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average gap between required and actual CAFE MPG - compliance risk indicator"
    - name: "total_credit_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(credit_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total CAFE credit balance across all records - regulatory asset value"
    - name: "total_fine_liability_usd"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fine_liability_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total potential fine liability for CAFE non-compliance - financial risk exposure"
    - name: "avg_fine_liability_usd"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fine_liability_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average fine liability per compliance record - cost of non-compliance"
    - name: "records_below_target"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN compliance_gap_mpg > 0 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of records where actual CAFE is below required target - compliance failures"
    - name: "records_above_target"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN compliance_gap_mpg < 0 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of records where actual CAFE exceeds required target - over-compliance"
    - name: "compliance_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN compliance_gap_mpg <= 0 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of records meeting or exceeding CAFE targets - overall compliance effectiveness"

metric_views.description: CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) compliance metrics tracking fleet fuel economy performance, regulatory gaps, and credit balances for emissions compliance steering.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`compliance_test_event`

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`compliance_zev_credit`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

    - name: "compliance_program"
      expr: compliance_program
      comment: "Regulatory compliance program (e.g., California ZEV, EU CO2 pooling, China NEV)"
    - name: "powertrain_type"
      expr: powertrain_type
      comment: "Powertrain type generating the credit (e.g., BEV, PHEV, FCEV)"
    - name: "model_year"
      expr: model_year
      comment: "Model year of the vehicle generating the credit"
    - name: "credit_vintage_year"
      expr: credit_vintage_year
      comment: "Vintage year of the credit for tracking and expiration"
    - name: "region"
      expr: region
      comment: "Geographic region where the credit is valid"
    - name: "regulatory_body"
      expr: regulatory_body
      comment: "Regulatory authority administering the credit program"
    - name: "counterparty_role"
      expr: counterparty_role
      comment: "Role of the counterparty in the transaction (e.g., buyer, seller, pooling partner)"
    - name: "credit_basis"
      expr: credit_basis
      comment: "Basis for credit calculation (e.g., per vehicle, per kWh battery, per mile range)"
    - name: "transaction_year"
      expr: YEAR(transaction_date)
      comment: "Year the credit transaction occurred"
  measures:
    - name: "total_zev_credit_transactions"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of ZEV credit transactions - trading activity volume"
    - name: "total_credit_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(credit_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity of ZEV credits across all transactions - credit portfolio size"
    - name: "total_credit_value_usd"
      expr: SUM(CAST(credit_quantity AS DOUBLE) * CAST(credit_price_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total value of ZEV credits in USD - regulatory asset value and revenue potential"
    - name: "avg_credit_price_usd"
      expr: AVG(CAST(credit_price_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average price per ZEV credit in USD - market pricing indicator"
    - name: "credits_generated"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Generated' THEN CAST(credit_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total credits generated from ZEV sales - compliance asset creation"
    - name: "credits_sold"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sold' THEN CAST(credit_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total credits sold to other manufacturers - revenue generation"
    - name: "credits_purchased"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchased' THEN CAST(credit_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total credits purchased from other manufacturers - compliance cost"
    - name: "credits_retired"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Retired' THEN CAST(credit_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total credits retired for compliance - regulatory obligation fulfillment"
    - name: "net_credit_position"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type IN ('Generated', 'Purchased') THEN CAST(credit_quantity AS DOUBLE) WHEN transaction_type IN ('Sold', 'Retired') THEN -CAST(credit_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Net ZEV credit position (generated + purchased - sold - retired) - compliance surplus/deficit"
    - name: "distinct_counterparties"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT party_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct counterparties in credit transactions - market participation breadth"
$$
metric_views.description: Zero Emission Vehicle (ZEV) credit metrics tracking credit generation, trading, and retirement for regulatory compliance and revenue optimization.

      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(request_timestamp), '-', YEAR(request_timestamp))
      comment: "Quarter and year when change was requested"
    - name: "approval_year"
      expr: YEAR(approval_timestamp)
      comment: "Calendar year when change was approved"
    - name: "implementation_year"
      expr: YEAR(implementation_date)
      comment: "Calendar year when change was implemented"
  measures:
    - name: "total_change_count"

    - name: "approved_change_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN change_status = 'approved' THEN change_id END)
      comment: "Count of approved engineering changes"
    - name: "rejected_change_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN change_status = 'rejected' THEN change_id END)

    - name: "implemented_change_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN change_status = 'implemented' THEN change_id END)

    - name: "change_approval_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN change_status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN change_status IN ('approved', 'rejected') THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of changes approved - change governance effectiveness metric"
    - name: "total_cost_estimate_gross"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cost_estimate_gross AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross cost estimate of all changes - financial impact metric"
    - name: "total_cost_net"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cost_net AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net cost impact of all changes after adjustments"
    - name: "avg_cost_per_change"
      expr: AVG(CAST(cost_estimate_gross AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average cost per engineering change"
    - name: "critical_change_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN priority = 'critical' THEN change_id END)
      comment: "Count of critical priority changes"
    - name: "high_risk_change_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN risk_level = 'high' THEN change_id END)
      comment: "Count of high-risk changes - program risk indicator"
    - name: "compliance_driven_change_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN compliance_flag = TRUE THEN change_id END)
      comment: "Count of changes driven by regulatory compliance"
    - name: "compliance_change_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN compliance_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of changes driven by compliance - regulatory pressure indicator"
$$
metric_views.description: Engineering change order metrics tracking change volume, cost impact, and approval cycle time for design stability and cost control

    - name: "detection_rating"

    - name: "avg_occurrence_rating"

      comment: "Average occurrence rating - likelihood of failures"
    - name: "avg_detection_rating"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`engineering_milestone`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Engineering program milestone metrics tracking on-time delivery and critical gate performance for program execution management"
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`engineering`.`milestone`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "milestone_name"
      expr: milestone_name
      comment: "Name of the program milestone"
    - name: "milestone_code"
      expr: milestone_code
      comment: "Milestone code identifier (P0, P1, P2, SOP, etc.)"
    - name: "milestone_type"
      expr: milestone_type
      comment: "Type of milestone (gate, phase exit, approval, launch, etc.)"
    - name: "milestone_status"
      expr: milestone_status
      comment: "Current status (planned, achieved, delayed, at-risk)"
    - name: "is_critical"
      expr: is_critical
      comment: "Whether the milestone is critical for program success"
    - name: "risk_level"
      expr: risk_level
      comment: "Risk level assessment (high, medium, low)"
    - name: "gate_review_outcome"
      expr: gate_review_outcome
      comment: "Outcome of gate review (approved, conditional, rejected)"
    - name: "compliance_standard"
      expr: compliance_standard
      comment: "Compliance standard or framework governing the milestone"
    - name: "planned_year"
      expr: YEAR(planned_date)
      comment: "Calendar year of planned milestone date"
    - name: "actual_year"
      expr: YEAR(actual_date)
      comment: "Calendar year of actual milestone achievement"
    - name: "on_time_flag"
      expr: CASE WHEN actual_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_date <= planned_date THEN 'On-Time' WHEN actual_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_date > planned_date THEN 'Delayed' ELSE 'Pending' END
      comment: "Whether milestone was achieved on time"
  measures:
    - name: "total_milestone_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT milestone_id)
      comment: "Total number of program milestones"
    - name: "achieved_milestone_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN milestone_status = 'achieved' THEN milestone_id END)
      comment: "Count of achieved milestones"
    - name: "delayed_milestone_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN milestone_status = 'delayed' THEN milestone_id END)
      comment: "Count of delayed milestones"
    - name: "critical_milestone_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_critical = TRUE THEN milestone_id END)
      comment: "Count of critical milestones"
    - name: "on_time_delivery_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_date <= planned_date THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of milestones achieved on or before planned date - program execution metric"
    - name: "critical_on_time_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_critical = TRUE AND actual_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_date <= planned_date THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_critical = TRUE AND actual_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "On-time delivery rate for critical milestones - program risk indicator"
    - name: "at_risk_milestone_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN milestone_status = 'at-risk' THEN milestone_id END)
      comment: "Count of milestones currently at risk"
    - name: "avg_open_action_items"
      expr: AVG(CAST(open_action_items_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of open action items per milestone - gate readiness indicator"
$$
metric_views.description: Engineering program milestone metrics tracking on-time delivery and critical gate performance for program execution management

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`engineering_part_master`

  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`engineering`.`part_master`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "part_number"
      expr: part_number
      comment: "Unique part number identifier"

      comment: "Classification of part type (mechanical, electrical, electronic, software, etc.)"

      expr: part_family

      expr: part_classification
      comment: "Part classification (A/B/C, critical/non-critical, etc.)"
    - name: "lifecycle_status"
      expr: lifecycle_status
      comment: "Current lifecycle stage (development, active, phase-out, obsolete)"
    - name: "criticality"
      expr: criticality
      comment: "Criticality rating (critical, high, medium, low)"

      expr: material
      comment: "Primary material composition"

      expr: quality_rating
      comment: "Quality performance rating (A/B/C or numeric score)"

      comment: "Current inspection or validation status"

      expr: is_active

    - name: "reach_compliance"
      expr: reach_compliance
      comment: "REACH regulation compliance flag"
    - name: "rohs_compliance"
      expr: rohs_compliance
      comment: "RoHS directive compliance flag"
    - name: "obsolescence_notice"
      expr: obsolescence_notice
      comment: "Whether an obsolescence notice has been issued"
    - name: "weight_category"
      expr: CASE WHEN weight_kg < 0.1 THEN 'Micro (<0.1kg)' WHEN weight_kg < 1.0 THEN 'Light (0.1-1kg)' WHEN weight_kg < 10.0 THEN 'Medium (1-10kg)' ELSE 'Heavy (>10kg)' END
      comment: "Part weight classification for lightweighting analysis"
    - name: "cost_category"
      expr: CASE WHEN cost_usd < 1.0 THEN 'Low (<$1)' WHEN cost_usd < 10.0 THEN 'Medium ($1-10)' WHEN cost_usd < 100.0 THEN 'High ($10-100)' ELSE 'Very High (>$100)' END
      comment: "Part cost classification for cost reduction targeting"
    - name: "lead_time_category"
      expr: CASE WHEN CAST(lead_time_days AS INT) <= 7 THEN 'Short (<=1wk)' WHEN CAST(lead_time_days AS INT) <= 30 THEN 'Medium (1-4wk)' ELSE 'Long (>4wk)' END

      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active = TRUE THEN part_master_id END)

      expr: SUM(CAST(cost_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cost of all parts in USD - key cost reduction target metric"
    - name: "avg_part_cost"
      expr: AVG(CAST(cost_usd AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "total_part_weight_kg"

      comment: "Total weight of all parts in kilograms - key lightweighting metric"
    - name: "avg_part_weight_kg"
      expr: AVG(CAST(weight_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average weight per part in kilograms"
    - name: "avg_lead_time_days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(lead_time_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average procurement lead time in days - supply chain agility metric"
    - name: "reach_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN reach_compliance = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of parts compliant with REACH regulation - regulatory risk metric"
    - name: "rohs_compliance_rate"

      comment: "Percentage of parts compliant with RoHS directive - regulatory risk metric"
    - name: "obsolescence_risk_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN obsolescence_notice = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of parts with obsolescence notices - supply continuity risk indicator"
    - name: "critical_part_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN criticality = 'critical' THEN part_master_id END)
      comment: "Count of parts classified as critical - focus area for risk mitigation"
    - name: "critical_part_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN criticality = 'critical' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of parts classified as critical"
    - name: "avg_volume_cm3"
      expr: AVG(CAST(volume_cm3 AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average part volume in cubic centimeters - packaging efficiency metric"

    - name: "passed_test_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN result IN ('pass', 'passed', 'Pass', 'Passed') THEN validation_test_id END)
      comment: "Count of tests that passed"
    - name: "failed_test_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN result IN ('fail', 'failed', 'Fail', 'Failed') THEN validation_test_id END)
      comment: "Count of tests that failed"
    - name: "test_pass_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN result IN ('pass', 'passed', 'Pass', 'Passed') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN result IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of tests passed - key quality and program risk metric"
    - name: "critical_test_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_critical = TRUE THEN validation_test_id END)
      comment: "Count of critical validation tests"
    - name: "critical_test_pass_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_critical = TRUE AND result IN ('pass', 'passed', 'Pass', 'Passed') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_critical = TRUE THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Pass rate for critical tests - program launch readiness indicator"
    - name: "regulatory_test_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN regulatory_compliance_flag = TRUE THEN validation_test_id END)
      comment: "Count of regulatory compliance tests"
    - name: "regulatory_test_pass_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_compliance_flag = TRUE AND result IN ('pass', 'passed', 'Pass', 'Passed') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_compliance_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Pass rate for regulatory tests - homologation risk metric"
    - name: "avg_test_duration_minutes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(duration_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average test duration in minutes - test efficiency metric"
    - name: "avg_emission_co2_g_per_km"
      expr: AVG(CAST(emission_co2_g_per_km AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average measured CO2 emissions in grams per kilometer"
    - name: "avg_noise_db"
      expr: AVG(CAST(noise_db AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average measured noise level in decibels"
    - name: "avg_torque_nm"
      expr: AVG(CAST(torque_nm AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average measured torque in Newton-meters"
    - name: "avg_variance_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(variance_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average variance percentage from target - test accuracy indicator"
$$
metric_views.description: Engineering validation test performance metrics tracking test pass rates, compliance, and quality outcomes for program risk management

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`quality_apqp_plan`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Advanced Product Quality Planning metrics tracking program milestone completion, quality goal achievement, PPM performance, and gate readiness for new vehicle program launches."
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`quality`.`apqp_plan`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "apqp_phase"
      expr: apqp_phase
      comment: "Current APQP phase (Plan, Design, Develop, Validate, Launch)"
    - name: "milestone_gate"
      expr: milestone_gate
      comment: "Program milestone gate (P0, P1, P2, P3, SOP)"
    - name: "gate_status"
      expr: gate_status
      comment: "Status of milestone gate (not started, in progress, passed, failed, conditional)"
    - name: "compliance_status"
      expr: compliance_status
      comment: "Compliance status of APQP plan (compliant, non-compliant, under review)"
    - name: "lifecycle_status"
      expr: lifecycle_status
      comment: "Lifecycle status of APQP plan (active, on-hold, completed, cancelled)"
    - name: "risk_level"
      expr: risk_level
      comment: "Risk level assessment (low, medium, high, critical)"
    - name: "model_year"
      expr: model_year
      comment: "Model year of vehicle program"
    - name: "sop_year"
      expr: YEAR(sop_date)
      comment: "Year of planned Start of Production"
  measures:
    - name: "total_apqp_plans"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of APQP plans"
    - name: "gates_passed"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN gate_status = 'Passed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of milestone gates successfully passed"
    - name: "gates_failed"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN gate_status = 'Failed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of milestone gates failed requiring corrective action"
    - name: "avg_target_ppm"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_ppm AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target parts-per-million defect rate goal"
    - name: "avg_actual_ppm"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_ppm AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual parts-per-million defect rate achieved"
    - name: "avg_quality_goal_ppm"
      expr: AVG(CAST(quality_goal_ppm AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average quality goal PPM target set for program"
    - name: "plans_meeting_ppm_target"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(actual_ppm AS DOUBLE) <= CAST(target_ppm AS DOUBLE) THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of APQP plans meeting or exceeding PPM quality targets"
    - name: "high_risk_plans"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'High' OR risk_level = 'Critical' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of APQP plans with high or critical risk levels requiring mitigation"
    - name: "plans_with_mitigation"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN mitigation_plan IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of APQP plans with documented risk mitigation plans"
$$
metric_views.description: Advanced Product Quality Planning metrics tracking program milestone completion, quality goal achievement, PPM performance, and gate readiness for new vehicle program launches.

      comment: "Actual month of opportunity closure"

      expr: fiscal_year

      expr: sales_stage
      comment: "Current stage of the sales opportunity (prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, closed)"
    - name: "opportunity_type"
      expr: opportunity_type
      comment: "Type of sales opportunity (new business, upsell, renewal)"
    - name: "model_year"
      expr: model_year

    - name: "powertrain_type"
      expr: powertrain_type
      comment: "Powertrain type of the vehicle (ICE, HEV, PHEV, BEV)"
    - name: "financing_type"
      expr: financing_type
      comment: "Type of financing discussed (cash, finance, lease)"
    - name: "region"
      expr: region
      comment: "Geographic region of the opportunity"
    - name: "lead_source"
      expr: lead_source
      comment: "Source of the sales lead (web, referral, event, advertising)"
    - name: "competitor_brand"
      expr: competitor_brand
      comment: "Competitor brand being considered by the customer"
    - name: "is_won"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_won = TRUE THEN 'Won' ELSE 'Not Won' END
      comment: "Whether the opportunity was won"
    - name: "is_active"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_active = TRUE THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END
      comment: "Whether the opportunity is currently active"
    - name: "test_drive_completed"
      expr: CASE WHEN test_drive_completed = TRUE THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether a test drive was completed"
    - name: "quote_generated"
      expr: CASE WHEN quote_generated = TRUE THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether a quote was generated for the opportunity"
    - name: "priority"

      comment: "Priority level of the opportunity (high, medium, low)"
  measures:
    - name: "total_opportunities"

      comment: "Total number of sales opportunities"
    - name: "total_pipeline_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated value of all opportunities in the pipeline"
    - name: "weighted_pipeline_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_value AS DOUBLE) * CAST(probability AS DOUBLE) / 100.0)

    - name: "avg_opportunity_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_value AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "total_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total discount amount across all opportunities"
    - name: "total_incentive_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(incentive_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total incentive amount across all opportunities"
    - name: "total_trade_in_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(trade_in_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total trade-in value across all opportunities"
    - name: "won_opportunities"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_won = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of opportunities that were won"
    - name: "active_opportunities"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of currently active opportunities"
    - name: "opportunities_with_test_drive"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN test_drive_completed = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of opportunities where a test drive was completed"
    - name: "opportunities_with_quote"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN quote_generated = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of opportunities where a quote was generated"
    - name: "win_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_won = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active = FALSE THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Win rate as percentage of closed opportunities"
    - name: "avg_probability"
      expr: AVG(CAST(probability AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average probability of closure across all opportunities"

    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code

      expr: CASE WHEN financing_offered = TRUE THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

    - name: "lease_offered"

    - name: "has_trade_in"

      comment: "Whether the quote includes a trade-in vehicle"
  measures:

      expr: COUNT(1)

    - name: "total_quote_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_amount_due AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total value of all quotes"
    - name: "total_msrp_base"
      expr: SUM(CAST(msrp_base AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total base MSRP across all quotes"
    - name: "total_net_selling_price"

      comment: "Total net selling price across all quotes"
    - name: "total_options_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(options_total AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total value of options across all quotes"
    - name: "total_accessories_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(accessories_total AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total value of accessories across all quotes"
    - name: "total_incentive_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(incentive_total AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total incentive value across all quotes"
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount across all quotes"
    - name: "total_trade_in_allowance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(trade_in_allowance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total trade-in allowance across all quotes"
    - name: "avg_quote_value"

    - name: "avg_net_selling_price"
      expr: AVG(CAST(net_selling_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average net selling price per quote"
    - name: "converted_quotes"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN converted_to_order = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of quotes converted to orders"
    - name: "quote_conversion_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN converted_to_order = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Quote-to-order conversion rate as percentage"
    - name: "quotes_with_financing"

    - name: "quotes_with_lease"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN lease_offered = TRUE THEN 1 END)

    - name: "quotes_with_trade_in"

    - name: "order_status"
      expr: vehicle_order_status
      comment: "Current status of the vehicle order (confirmed, in production, delivered, cancelled)"
    - name: "order_type"
      expr: vehicle_order_type
      comment: "Type of vehicle order (retail, fleet, demo, stock)"
    - name: "financing_type"
      expr: financing_type
      comment: "Type of financing (cash, finance, lease)"
    - name: "powertrain_type"
      expr: powertrain_type
      comment: "Powertrain type of the ordered vehicle (ICE, HEV, PHEV, BEV)"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency code for the order transaction"
    - name: "has_trade_in"
      expr: CASE WHEN trade_in_value > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether the order includes a trade-in vehicle"
    - name: "has_field_service_package"
      expr: CASE WHEN field_service_package_flag = TRUE THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
      comment: "Whether the order includes a field service package"
  measures:
    - name: "total_orders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of vehicle orders"
    - name: "total_order_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total order value across all vehicle orders"
    - name: "total_selling_price"
      expr: SUM(CAST(selling_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total selling price before taxes and fees"
    - name: "total_msrp"
      expr: SUM(CAST(msrp AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) across all orders"
    - name: "total_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total discount amount applied to vehicle orders"
    - name: "total_incentive_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(incentive_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total incentive amount applied to vehicle orders"
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount collected on vehicle orders"
    - name: "total_trade_in_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(trade_in_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total trade-in value credited across all orders"
    - name: "avg_order_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average order value per vehicle order"
    - name: "avg_selling_price"
      expr: AVG(CAST(selling_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average selling price per vehicle order"
    - name: "avg_discount_per_order"
      expr: AVG(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average discount amount per vehicle order"
    - name: "discount_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(msrp AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Discount rate as percentage of MSRP"
    - name: "orders_with_trade_in"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN trade_in_value > 0 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of orders that include a trade-in vehicle"
    - name: "orders_with_field_service"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN field_service_package_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of orders that include a field service package"
    - name: "cancelled_orders"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_order_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of cancelled vehicle orders"
    - name: "delivered_orders"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of vehicle orders that have been delivered"
$$
metric_views.description: Core sales order metrics tracking vehicle orders, revenue, discounts, and delivery performance across channels, regions, and time periods

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`supply_ckd_kit`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Completely Knocked Down (CKD) kit KPIs: kit value, volume, weight, quality status, and regulatory compliance for global CKD operations and export/import management."
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`supply`.`ckd_kit`"

    - name: "kit_type"
      expr: kit_type
      comment: "Type of CKD kit (e.g., Full CKD, Semi-CKD, SKD) for product mix and assembly strategy analysis."
    - name: "quality_status"
      expr: quality_status
      comment: "Quality status of the kit (e.g., Approved, Pending Inspection, Rejected) for quality gate tracking."
    - name: "ppap_status"
      expr: ppap_status
      comment: "PPAP status of the kit (e.g., Approved, Pending, Not Required) for supplier readiness and launch tracking."
    - name: "regulatory_approval_status"
      expr: regulatory_approval_status
      comment: "Regulatory approval status (e.g., Approved, Pending, Rejected) for export/import compliance tracking."
    - name: "inspection_result"
      expr: inspection_result
      comment: "Result of kit inspection (e.g., Pass, Fail, Conditional) for quality assurance tracking."
    - name: "hazardous_material_flag"
      expr: hazardous_material_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating presence of hazardous materials, for compliance and special handling tracking."
    - name: "model_year"
      expr: model_year
      comment: "Model year of the vehicle for which the kit is intended, enabling program-specific CKD analysis."
    - name: "target_plant_code"
      expr: target_plant_code
      comment: "Code of the target assembly plant, for destination-based logistics and operations analysis."
    - name: "incoterms"
      expr: incoterms
      comment: "Incoterms (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP) defining cost and risk transfer, critical for pricing and logistics."
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency of kit value, enabling multi-currency revenue and cost analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "kit_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of CKD kits, tracking CKD export volume and global operations scale."
    - name: "total_kit_value_usd"
      expr: SUM(CAST(kit_value_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total value of CKD kits in USD, the primary CKD revenue and transfer pricing KPI."
    - name: "avg_kit_value_usd"
      expr: AVG(CAST(kit_value_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average value per CKD kit in USD, for pricing strategy and product mix analysis."
    - name: "total_weight_kg"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_weight_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total weight of CKD kits in kilograms, for freight cost estimation and logistics capacity planning."
    - name: "total_volume_cbm"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_volume_cbm AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total volume of CKD kits in cubic meters, for container utilization and shipping cost optimization."
    - name: "avg_weight_per_kit_kg"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_weight_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average weight per CKD kit in kilograms, for kit design and logistics efficiency analysis."
    - name: "avg_volume_per_kit_cbm"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_volume_cbm AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average volume per CKD kit in cubic meters, for packaging optimization and container loading analysis."
    - name: "hazardous_material_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(hazardous_material_flag AS INT))
      comment: "Proportion of kits containing hazardous materials, for compliance and special handling cost tracking."
    - name: "supplier_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT supply_supplier_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of suppliers providing CKD kits, tracking CKD supply base and sourcing strategy."
    - name: "target_plant_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT plant_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of target assembly plants, tracking global CKD distribution network breadth."
    - name: "model_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT model_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of vehicle models covered by CKD kits, tracking CKD product portfolio breadth."
    - name: "configuration_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT configuration_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of vehicle configurations covered by CKD kits, tracking CKD complexity and SKU proliferation."
$$
metric_views.description: Completely Knocked Down (CKD) kit KPIs: kit value, volume, weight, quality status, and regulatory compliance for global CKD operations and export/import management.

  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`vehicle`.`model`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "model_name"
      expr: model_name
      comment: "Name of the vehicle model for portfolio segmentation"
    - name: "brand_name"
      expr: brand_name
      comment: "Brand under which the model is marketed"
    - name: "segment"
      expr: segment
      comment: "Market segment classification (e.g., compact, midsize, luxury SUV)"
    - name: "body_style"
      expr: body_style
      comment: "Body style of the model (e.g., sedan, SUV, coupe)"

      expr: powertrain_type
      comment: "Powertrain type (e.g., ICE, hybrid, BEV, PHEV) for electrification tracking"
    - name: "fuel_type"
      expr: fuel_type
      comment: "Fuel type for the model (gasoline, diesel, electric, hydrogen)"
    - name: "model_status"
      expr: model_status
      comment: "Current lifecycle status of the model (active, discontinued, planned)"
    - name: "launch_model_year"
      expr: launch_model_year
      comment: "Model year when the model was first launched"
    - name: "sop_year"
      expr: YEAR(sop_date)
      comment: "Calendar year of start of production for program timing analysis"
    - name: "lifecycle_phase"
      expr: CASE WHEN sop_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Pre-Launch' WHEN eop_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'End-of-Life' ELSE 'Active Production' END
      comment: "Derived lifecycle phase based on SOP and EOP dates for portfolio health monitoring"
  measures:
    - name: "total_models"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT model_id)
      comment: "Total count of distinct vehicle models in the portfolio for portfolio breadth tracking"
    - name: "active_models"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN model_status = 'Active' THEN model_id END)
      comment: "Count of currently active models for active portfolio size monitoring"
    - name: "electrified_models"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN powertrain_type IN ('BEV', 'PHEV', 'Hybrid', 'FCEV') THEN model_id END)
      comment: "Count of electrified powertrain models for electrification strategy progress tracking"
    - name: "electrification_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN powertrain_type IN ('BEV', 'PHEV', 'Hybrid', 'FCEV') THEN model_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT model_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of models with electrified powertrains for strategic electrification KPI"
    - name: "avg_model_lifecycle_days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(eop_date, sop_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from SOP to EOP for model lifecycle duration analysis"
$$
metric_views.description: Vehicle model portfolio and program performance metrics for product planning, lifecycle management, and strategic portfolio decisions
